phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gtor ba'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu thul ba'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mime tog nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog phung po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkar ba'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi smon pa'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par phye ba'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes pa'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i yan lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa med par gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don gcig tu gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don du gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa cagazigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang du'ang mi 'jigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa med par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal 67—56

lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang 3)bral ba 5)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa rnam par spangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa// //bam po gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad rnam par bsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mang du ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum rnam par 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang bar 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phun sum ma ri spangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'phro ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu sbyangs pa'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i 5)gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu sprul pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lte ba mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba dri mchog gi lte srib la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dus gsum chug pa netshol phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nye bar zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yid kyi rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa dam pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo / /ri:de bzhin gshegs pa yid kyi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—57

gshegs pa sems kyi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'ishesems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yid du 'ong b.rasnyigasung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor lo'ishegasung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung brtan pas ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brjid pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu brjid pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu mchod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i lhas mchod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' sgrubartan pa'i sde 'joms dgra spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pas6)spangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa cis47 bzhin pa rjes su ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa yid du 'ong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smon pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho 'byung bar gsung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra thul ba 9la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thog mar sems bskyed pa'i the tshom sngagacod pa nyon mongs pa spong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yi / dam kun bsgrags the tshom nyugegacod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde chen thob pa 3 la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs 67—58

su mya ngan las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu snyems pa la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kauṇ+ḍilkonyu)n+ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skrag pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byin gyis rlob pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu mtshan smos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes pa'i rigs can la phyag 'tshal lo / de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes pa'i dbyangs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nade bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu nan tan mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od shar bsil la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog man dā ra'i dri bsungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa'i tshul 'dzin sgra 'byin dbyangs snyan skar ma'i rgyal po me tog mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa the tsom chornam par 'byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig tu ma nges pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtse 5)mo ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi dra bas sku brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor dmigs pas brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkar ba nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu snang ba 'gyed 'ul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /7 de bzhin gshegs pa 67—59

rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thos par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'tshe ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smred pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa sems can nam mkha'i semasalgegazugs brnyanadza gyi gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dul dka' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'du shes can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dper stag lta bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro rnams dga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba skyedam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bskyed 4pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par sbyor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa du mar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthor gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha lo sgyur geb la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgo dbyangs mdzod mang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu spyod 45pa'i ye shes kun tum mi nor ba 67—60

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gog par gzhol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rdzogs pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi tshugs ye shes gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ze ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par brjid pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par brgyan 17pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa thams cad spyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa bal glang rna la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bal glang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gdul dka' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma byang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi spyan bden pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i gzis brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtsol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems rtse gcig tu thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden par gsung ba nal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud sde rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma rig snarnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu brjid pa la 67—61

phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcur grags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ta ma la'i lo ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas rnam par sprul 1)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan ma med pa 5la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bal glang 'gying ba'i 'gros bzhin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal mtshan 'gyesam snyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros thogs pa med gi)la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rab chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mun bsal ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu bo 'dzam bu56)gser la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rtsa ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ud pal ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu stod rin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag nyid bsgoms pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra ba med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu brjid pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nye bar zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma rgya chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' 'dul nyu)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbu na rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor dmigs pa'i rgyan sems khol phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge 67—62

brlad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar sbyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs rnam par bsgrags pa 917la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud sde'i dgra rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dam pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dam pa rnams rab tu sgrol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rang bzhin nges pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bsod nams mtha' med grangs med pa las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan mang po 'di dag 'dzin tam/ klog rigam/ kun chub par byed dam/ rjes su dran zhing bsgoms na/ de dag la mig nad med par 'gyur/ rna 3nad med/ sna nad med/4 lce nad med/ lus nad med cing sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'byang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis gnod pa byed pa mi 'byung / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las slar mi ldog par 'gyur/ phyogs thams cad kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dgongs par 'gyur/ de dag gis de la rtag tu bsrung ba dang ske/ bskyab pa dang / sbed par mdzad do/ /mngon du 'am chung ngu na rmi lam du yang 5rung ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i shes rab dang / thabs la 67—63

mkhas par mngon du ston te/ ci nas myur du ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo mo so sor thob par mdzad do/ /nam yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan 1pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ rin po che'i pad mo las rdzus 5te skye bar 'ong / nam yang skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cubartsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu nanodang ldan par 'gyur(ge/ mngon par shes pa rnams dang / spyan lnga dang / sems can smin par bya ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu 6rtsa bdun dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang / so so kun tu rig pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang ske/ dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/sangs rgyas kyi chos grangs med tshad med pa gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur te / ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gi yon tan dang / grags pa phun sum tshogs pa de bzhin du de dag la yang yon tan du mi 'gyur ba ma yin te / de dag la yang phun sum tshogs pa ring por 7༄mi thogs par 'gyur zhing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde bar myur du mngon sum bar byang chub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi nadabyings kyi gzugs brnyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dha re dha 67wa 64

re dharma dhā tu pra tiṣ+ṭha nyu)te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs thams cad tu mar me'i 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ pra dī pe pra dī pe dz+nyā na pra dri pe swā hā/ / de bzhin gshegs pa snying po'i gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo 95)tabya thā/ te dze te dze/ /dz+nyā na te dze/ /bud dha te dze/ /dharma te dze/ /sang gha te dze swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dka' thub rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā / pra te pra te/ sarba pra te/ pa ri sumagur ṇi bud dha sa mu dra dar sha riṇi swā hā / de bzhin gshegs pa chos ltabarjod pa'i dkyil 'khor mar me la phyag 'tshal lo / /tabya thā/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi / sarba kurma ā 7rib ra ṇa ni / bud dha sa649na / dharma sarkye / stan/ sang gha sarkye /1na swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dkyil hu 'khor 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ tsan+d+ra pra bho/ srur+ya pra bho/tsan dra srur+ya sha ta swā hā/ sri ti ri ka pra 1nabho/ bi shodha saya dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba mang ba tshal phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/dharma byu 9nye/ ga ga na byu sna he dz+nyā na byu 18te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi 'od rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dā ra dā 19ra/ dz+nyā na kā ya pa ri sho dha ni/ dz+nyā na pa ri pū 2 ra ṇi ta tha tā 21a ba bo dha ni shī gh+ra 22ma swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ bi bu le lha / go tsa re/ gu ra ya/ pū ra ya byu/ sarba ā sha 25dz+nyā na a dhi khri 0te/sarba bud dha a dhi khriri ci te/ sarba bo dhi satwa a dhi ṣ+ṭi 28te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho shugs rdul 27med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ be ge be ge/ /dharma sa mu dra be ge / ga gas na sa mu dra be ge /pā ra mi tā be ge /sarba ā shā pi ra pu ra ṇi01be ge /bud dha a dhi khyipo te swā hā/ sangs rgyas 'di 67wa 65

dag sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe smon lam 'di skad ces gsungs te/nam bdag cag byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa na sems can gang gis nged kyi ming thos sam/ 'dzin tam/ bklags ༅tshon de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /mi khom pa brgyad las yongs su 'das shing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mngon sum du dgongs te ri yongs su dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar shog shig /de nas shi 'phos nas cayang lhar 5bcas pas yongs su 'dzin par shog shig /'jigs nipa thams cad las shin tu 'das par shog shig /gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi mtshan 'dzin pa de dag gis gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di yang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par zung shig /de ste byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mthong bar 'dod na des ci nus par mchod pa byas te 'bum du bzlas par tsobya'o/ / kun tu yang gtsang zhing byams pa'i sems su bya/7 de ste kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'dod na yang des de bzhin mchod de nyis 12'bum bzlas par sna bya'o/ /de ste yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad mthong bar 'dod na/ de ltar mchod de sum 'bum bzlas par ngabya'o/ /kun tu yang gtsang zhing byams pa'i sems su bcas la/ nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / khro ba 8dang / sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i tshamachog 'od gsal dpal gzi brjid snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ci subye subye / dz+nyā na sruru swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po rnam pa du ma'i rgyal po dpal 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri/ te dza shi ri swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa bskal pa bye ba grangs med par bsags pa'i sangs rgyas la 67—66

phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ sa mu dra sna ye sa mu dra ye/ dz+nyā nan sa mu dra g.ye swā hā / de bzhin gshegs pa chos tshul thams cad rnam par sprul pa'i gzi brjid 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gar+bhe gar+bha/ dz+nyā na gar+bhe 5swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang nam mkha' sgra mang gzi brjid 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ga ga ne snyog ga de ci/ ga ga na bi shud dhe swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ me ru me ru/rat+na me ru swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gu ṇi gu rtedu sdu/ gu ṇa sa mu dre swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos dbyings dbyangs tshedapal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ge thu ge thu/ dz+nyā na ge thu swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho sgra 'byin la phyag 'tshal lo /tabya thā/ sa mu dre sa mu dre/ dz+nyā na sa mu dre swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dh+wa dze dh+wa nyi dze dharma dhā 1stodze swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa sa'i nyi gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dha re dha re / dhā ra ṇimo/rtenu dre swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos stobs 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ pra bho pra sgyes/ dharma pra bho saswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas nam mkha'i dpal tshal phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ bud dhe bud dhe / su bud dhe swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chos kyi 'od zer ri rab rtse mo snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ artsi artsi/ dz+nyā na artsi swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ me gha me gha/ ma hā me gha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma mar me dpal rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo / /tar+ya thā/ pra dī pe pra dī pe/ tshwa na pra dī pe swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 67—67

zhing du sangs rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sa me sa me/ sa ma sbri ①te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa shing gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ dru me dru me/ dz+nyā na dru me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ gu ṇi gu rten / gu ṇa me ru shi kham rire swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ni me ni 4)me/ dz+nyā na ni me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo /tabya thā/ bi ri bi ri/ be+e 5ro tsa na swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ byu he byu tshone te/ dz+nyā na byu he swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sa ma sa ma sa stomu dra bi kra ma ṇi naswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dbu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ te dzo te dzo9/ dz+nyā na te dzo laswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ yin dre yin dre(nya/ yin dra bi /tsho kra me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dpal bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ bha dre bha dre/ su bha dre swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kun 'od rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ pra sgye pra bhe/ dz+nyā na pra bho swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ badz+ra badz+ra/badz+re na.ud ta re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ a sang ge a sang ge/ bud dhe swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos dbyings gzugs brnyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ dharme dharmeng / dharma dha re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs kun tu mar me 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ di ne di ne/ di na maka ra ṇi laswā hā/67—68

de bzhin gshegs pa snying rje'i gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ te dze te dze/ ma hā te dze swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dka' thub rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ pra te pra te/ pra ta pa ri pū 1ra ṇi swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzod pa'i dkyil 'khor mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ k+ṣa me k+ṣa me/ dz+nyā du na k+ṣa me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ pra bho pra bho/ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la pra sgye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba'i rgya mtsho mnga' ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/sa ra sa ra/ sarba bud dha a dhi khyi te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi 'od rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ pra shān te pra shān te/ u pa pra shān te 5swā hā / de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rnam par rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā / bi pu le bi pu le/ dz+nyā 6na bi pu le swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho shugs kyi rtse mo rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ sa ma sa ma sa ma sbri 7 te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /tabya thā/ ma ra ma ra/ ma ra ti ka re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ nas me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri/ shi ra ye 9swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i cod 1 pan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ mu ku ṭi mu ku ṭi/ dharma mu ku ṭi 11swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od zer gzi brjid dpal la 12phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya ba ti swā hā / de bzhin gshegs pa rkang gnyis dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/dhu ma dhu ma/ ma hā dhu me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' sgra la phyag 67—69

'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ga ga ne 1ga ga ne / ga ga na sa me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'byung ba'i mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sam bha ba sam bha ba/ bud dha sa twe na swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa smin mtshams dpal snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ u me u me/ u ma ba ti swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba grags par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gho ṣe gho ge / bud dha sto ṣe 5swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sa ra sa ra/ sa 'dir shi be peswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ te dze te dze/ te dza ba ti swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shi be shi be/ pu shi be naswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan nyid ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ k+ṣa ye k+ṣa ye/ kurma k+ṣa ye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin sgra dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ru he ru he/ sto ga49)ru ho swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa chos dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ yin dre yin dre/ yin dra 1 ba ti swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gu ṇi gu ṇi/nya/ gu ṇa sa mu di 1 te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams ri bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ pu ra ya pusto/ger ya / sarba ma nor thā nā thā rmeg hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gsung zhi ba skul phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sha me sha me/ sha ma ma ti 8swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ pra bha nyu tshosra sa ra pra sa ra ṇi lha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa me tog bzang ba bzhin dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ku mu ku mu/ ku mu de lke//swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgya 67—70

mtsho'i77snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gar+bhe garjen / ta thā ga ta gasgom swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/sam bha ba sam bha ba pra ṇi dhā na casam bha ba swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i dbang po gtsug tor nor bu'im snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ de be de be / de be na dra pu (6/tsi te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi ri bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ kun tsa ne 7 kan tsa den/ kun tsa na sa tri she swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ rata ne rata ne/ dz+nyā na rata ne swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dharma dharma/ dharma dharma 9su hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nor gyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shi ri te dze shi ri te jo1 / shi ri swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dza be dza be/ dza ba ne nya1swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shān te shān te/ pra shā 12ma ne swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi gnas dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ki ri ki ri/ ke tu 1 rā dza swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mar me sprin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ pra sha ma ri 0pu pra sham ri dpu shan to bha ba ri pu paswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ a ba bhā sa 1 a ba bhā 32se/ a ba bhā sa79ka ra ṇi swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin bshol 2 ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ bi bi bi 51ma le bi ma le 22te swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ su ru su ru sru r+sā te dze〈 naswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi mar me dpal ri rab la ciphyag 67—71

'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dri pe dī pe3/ dharma pra ti swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ tsi rimarka hrītsi ri/ tsi ri tsi swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i dpal gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ de be de be / de ba pu dzi te pa swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge bsgragasalogaglog gi mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ si me si me/ bud dha sing ha si mamoyeswā hā / de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu yon tan mang po'i ri sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ me ru me ru/ bud dha me ru swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i nacisems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ga ga na1tsho/ ga ta ya swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu rigs pa mang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sam bha be 'isam bha be/ sam bha ba 11 he pu swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rgya mtsho 12dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gardza gardza ni swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos dbyings nga ro dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dhā re dhā ra ṇi ban dhe naswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa bstsal 7ba'i sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ni me ni me/ dz+nyā na ni me swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa lha sgra dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ swa re swa tshare bud dha swa 9re swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu kun gyi gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ta ra ta ra/ bud dha a dhi khri te na sna swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ sa mu dre sa mu dre/ dharma dhā /8tu sa mu dre swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sam bha be sam bha be/ sa ma bha ba tu/ bud dha adhi khyi te na 30swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ gu ṇi gu ṇi/ bud dha sam bha 67—72

ba gu ne0)swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri/ pra dī tshonapra shi ris kyiswā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ dzi na dzi na dzi na sru la/bya swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rnam par mang55)ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/bi pu 76)/ ga gan bi pu le swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal mar me'i yon tan gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ pra dī pe pra dri pe/ shi ri te dza dra ri dri pe swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa dka' thub grubs la phyag 'tshal lo / /tabya thā/ sid dhe su sid dhe / mo tsa ni mo k+ṣa ni/ mug ti bi mug te'i / a ma le/ bi ma le/ māng ga lha11/ nyir t+ma gar bho rat+na gar te12/sarba arba sā dha ni pa ra ma ra tha sā 1 dha ni/ ma na 7se/ ma hā ma 1gan se/ ad bhu te / a t+yad bhu te/ bī ta nyi bha ye/ su brte pra h+ma gho ṣe/ pra h+ma argyu ge 18te / sarba a ze/ 6 a pa rā dzi 37te/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te/ tsa tu shiṣ+ṭha bud+dha ko ṭi bhā ṣi 3 ༷te/ namaḥ sarba 31sid dhi nā tsho 2ma ta thā ga tā nā na 3lhag hā/gzungs 'di brjod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ chogs so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis 24de ltar 'di 'dra lhaba'i gzungs sngags zab mo brjod pa ni legs so/ /gang gis gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin tam/ klog gams/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rgyas par yid la byed na/ rigs kyi bu pho de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri med 'od gsal gyis ljags kyi nadabang pos stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yog par mdzad nas byang chub 67wa 73

sems dpa' dung phyur phrag bdun cu po 17rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu po'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang gis gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / ci nus su mchod par byed pa de dag la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis ji ltar bsams 3pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri med 'od gsal la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu gleng ba zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji lta bur na de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la mchod pa bgyis par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol /ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis kun tu gleng ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gang su yang rung ste/ las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'dod na/ nang par sngar langs te ba lang gi gertsi bas dkyil 'khor byas la/ me tog dang / bdug pa pa dang / dri dang /phreng ba dang / byug pas ci nus su mchod pa byas te/ 'du 'dzi mang po spangs la nyin gsem dben mtshan gsum dben par de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi mtshan dang / gzungs ri sngags kyi tshig 'di dran par byas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi chosabaden pa'i tshig gis byin gyis brlabs rin/pas na/ de'i da ltar gyi tshe 'di 9nyid la las kyi sgrib pa mthams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ tsan dre su tsan dre ma hā tsan dre/ tsan dra ki ri ni/rte/ mi li mi li/ bud+dha a dhi ṣ+ṭṛ te12 / si li si li/ dharma a dhi ṣ+ṭṛ 1 te/ ki li ④kyi li saṃ gha a dhi khri 8te swā hā/rigs kyi bu pho'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang su yang rung ba de bzhin gshegs pa 67—74

de'i mtshan brjod pa 'chang zhing rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par nang par langs shing yid la byed na de bskal pa stong phrag bzhi bcur tshe rabs dran par 'ong ngo / /nam du yang byang chub kyi sems mi brjid 1par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/sho dha ne sho dha dege/ sarba pā paṃ /bi sho dha ni / shurnye bi shudhe/ sarba ka rma ā 5)ba ra ṇa bi shudhe'i3 swā hā/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan 'chang zhing rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par yid la byas na de da ltar gyi tshe 'di nyid du las thams cad dang sdig pa thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro / /mthar phyin 8 par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 9kyis lo bye ba phrag 1 bcu bzhi'i bar du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ mthar byang chub kyi dkyil 'khor la thug gi bar du de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mig yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu/ dz+nyā 11na tsak+ṣa swā hā/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'di'i 12mtshan 'dzin na de lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa'i mig lta bur 'gyur te/ bskal pa bzhi bcur tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ni byang chub kyi dkyil 'khor du thug gi bar du mi zad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bal glang dri 'od gsal rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ ga dze ga dze/ ga 1 dze yirje swā hā/ de nas tshabacom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i phung pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rigs kyi bu pho 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 7dri 'od gsal rgyal po de'i mtshan brjod pa 'dzin na de'i lus las lo brgya phrag bcu gsum gyi bar du dri 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi sems nam du yang 67—75

brjed par mi 'gyur ro1/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo / /tabya thā/ puspe pukhye/ su pudhe swā hā/ de'i cho ga du ni me tog ji lta bur bshams pa de la salan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsngags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la gtor na/ de'i bsams gepa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'byang bar 'ong / de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'dzin rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ dha re dha re/ dha ra ṇi brnye swā hā/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan dang / gzungs ltasngags kyi tshig 'di 'dzin na/ des bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams bab par 'ong / sngags kyi tshig 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas te byin na ci 5snyed pa mi byams / de bzhin du smon lam thams cad kyang 2)'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig tu mang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phar ba'i khyu mchog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phar bas shin tu rnam par 'phar ba'i khyu mchog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab phung po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i don la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtse mo mang po 9ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkhar 'thun tshal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od rab tu 'gyed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa las 'byung yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sna tshogs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ba nyu1spu ldang ba 67—76

dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu gsal nya)ba'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i bal glang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa'i 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun rdzob phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ud pa la dmar po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes me tog 'od dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba las 'byung ba'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs 5pa thams cad skrag cing 'joms par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer bcus lhag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od zer mngon du 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ud pa la'i ri67—77

dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rab tu gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rnam par bsgrags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā 1la'i dbang po rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pade bzhin gshegs pa rin chen sā ri ril la byaphyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha lo sgyur rin ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen sil snyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar yongs su grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 'byung ba kyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blta rimo dka' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i 'od gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra 'byin 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rtse mo mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mngon 8du 'phags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mngon gedu 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri 'od gsal ba skal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcur grags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu yon tan dbang po'i /1sprin phyug mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas ye shes 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo /67—78

de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa mang du sprul pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i mchog mnga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas 'odas3)me tog tshogs kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas me tog 'byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i dpal kun tu grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan brtson 'grus mtha' yas pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems bskyed ma thag tu sems can kun gyi sems kyi rgyun tsho tu 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ri'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgyal po'i 4'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan pha rol phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tha mi dad pa'i shing rta la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i 'chi'od las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes ud pa la'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smon lam mtha' yas go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas brtan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpung mgo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i 6dbang po rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—79

de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas pa'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sde mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 1)'phags pa bzhud pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad mos pa'i go cha bgos pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs mngon du 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor mchog mnga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba mngon du 'phags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs kun tu bsgrags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ka ling ku'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor brtan pa'i yon tan rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa cisnel phyag 67—80

'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dpal 17la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dmigs pa med pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phan par dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu brtags 5pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ud pa la'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grags pa'i stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od mtha' yas dri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sna tshogs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bud med skyes par bsgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can kun gyi sems dad par 'gyur ba'i ye shes ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan ma med pa'i gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes zla ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 67—81

tshugs pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs rab tu gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs shetshol phyag 'tshal lol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rtsol ba khyu mchog ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo// //sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ bam po bzhi pa/de bzhin gshegs pa grags ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun yid na'ajoms zhing 'jigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba snye'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsir 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dga' bar rtsol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sbyor ba kun tu cagacod pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par sprul pa mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo las byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs kun nas 'byung geb la phyag 'tshal 67—82

lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa sems can snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gnas 3)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bral ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa sman pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa go chabatha mis dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes mtha' yas par grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cade bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dri dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas me tog dpe med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu brjid 5)pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba las mngon du 'phags pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha lo sgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyon med rnam par skye ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mos rilas mngon du 'phags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog rab tu 'thor ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri 'od kun tu 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan rab tu mdzes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer spros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri parab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 67—83

pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar mda' 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mngon du 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rab bdud rtsi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu snang ba'i bdud rtsi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen sna tshogs kyi me tog shin tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor mchog dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul med rdul dang bral ba rnam par grol ba'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sna tshogs 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yi ge'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—85

bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'phags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshig gis dgrol 3)bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'phags pa'i ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gog pa med pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma dang bral ba'i zla ba'i gzi brjid rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grags pa'i stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gyi rgyal po 'od gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dogasashogepa thams cad gtan du bsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rab tu gtong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo 'od rikun tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges par spyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab rgya mtsho las mngon du 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 4gdon mi za bar ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa spyan bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 67—91

rin po che'i mdzod gcig po 1 la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul med rdul dang bral ba rnam par grol ba dus gsum por ma chags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i 2me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'odamagudapag tu med par casnang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od ridapag tu med par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i ri 6cirab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma bzang ba la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gsal ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /)ride bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mngon 8du 'phags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas par 'phar ba'i khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chags pa med pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 67—92

sangs rgyas me tog 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog pad mo'i ①me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i yon tan dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rab tu spros pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa bzang por bsgoms pa'i phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges par ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug las mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges par sgrol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar rnam par 'pharasaXgeb la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan 'das ride bzhin gshegs pa nges par mi mthun pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chode bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā sbrula'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa brtan pa dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i grogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs tre gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar 7ma'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan gyi gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan gyi dri rab tu gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas par snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa'i spyan la phyag 67—93

'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba )tshol phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas me tog 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros shin tu brtan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mu med rnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyan dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan ma med pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzem pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i ba spu langs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgyal po 'od gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi blo nges pa'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i rgyan gyi dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan che ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i nadapal 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—94

de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor shin tu brtan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa don grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges pa'i tshig rnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i glang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor shin tu gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa so sor shin tu gnas pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā7la'i dbang po rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar mda'i mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i brtson 'grus la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu brtags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can gyi kha lo sgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtso bo rab tu brtan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul mtha' yas pa 5las mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus las mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—95

gshegs pa the tsom 1)yongs su 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar rim bzang ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang bar mdzad pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gsal bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i phreng ba la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan gyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gsal snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā ril dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cade bzhin gshegs pa dogs pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i paspu 'greng 6ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lan mi ldon pa'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba 'od kyi 7dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi nasku ston pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—96

de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo rgyan gyi khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas me tog 'od 'byung mtha' yas pa 1 la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen skar ma khyu mchog sman gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sman la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'phags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa'i ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu gtor ba'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu mdzes pa'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi gom pa rnam par 'bar nab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gom pa rnam par 'phar ba mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smon lam mtha' yas pa cal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa tshad med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa stobs tshad med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /5de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa'i khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma nges pa'i smon lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba sgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgyur ba'i smon lam mi 6skye ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rtsol 7ba'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 67—97

'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa go cha grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu brtan pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan nyid kyi go cha la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu dul ba'i0)go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(bde bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdzod gcig pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa sku mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dra ba 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyi bo nas mngon du 'phags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs pa ril phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs shing bag tsha ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas rab tu gsal ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rgol ba thams cad shin tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud kyi yul thams cad shin tu non pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhal du med pa'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—98

de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra dbyangs dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas bdud rtsi me tog 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor mchog dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snying po thams cad zlos pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzem pa med pa'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du spobs pa rtsol tsho11bar spyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gsung ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i ban 0glang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo las 67—99

mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa go cha shin tu bgos pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa go cha shin tu bgos pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa me tog rab tu gtor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gdugs kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'khrung ba 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can las mngon du 'phags pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad mi skyo bar zlog pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge bar spyod pa'i go cha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun tu rab tu gtong ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog rab tu 'thor bar 'byung ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs gcig gis g.yogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu sgyur ba'i phung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu chags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye 67—100

shes mtha' yas pa'i khyu mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i go cha bgos pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa med pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sems dang po bskyed ma thag tu mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gsal bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gsal ba'i 1'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu sems can thams cad la spobs pa mi gcod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul med rdul dang bral ba'i narnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gom pa rnam par 'phar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gyi rgyal po rab tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa'i dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnas kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen ud pa la'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ku mu da 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis bkur ba'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dam pa dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—101

gshegs pa rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'joms pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul sprugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags kyi rdul bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa bshes gnyen dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis tu mi khyab pa'i don la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs don la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs don la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyab pa'i nyi ma la gephyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs ripa rnam par sgra 'byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cade bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgra 'byinam5)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes nernam par sgra 'byin la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa gces pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang ba'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba kun la mngon du 'byung ba'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gtsug tor la phyag 67—112

'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba mnyam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu bkra shis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi tshugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi tshugs pa'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal 1la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ded dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ded dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phan par dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten thams cad la phan par dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rje bo gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla med chos kyi spyod yul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu ye shes 'od dam pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma sku dam pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor chen ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi shing rta la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe zhi ba'i shing rta la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs brtan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa'i 2stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—113

jug /'phags pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo1)/ci)lhun /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya saṃ myaka tsār+ya bṛt+ta ga ga na war+ṇa 'bi na ya k+ṣarnyi dunā ma ma hā yā ④na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i sa)dus gcig 45)na/bcom ldan 'das byed pa can na rnyog pa sel ba zhes bya ba'i byed pa can gyi grong rdal medu snang ba 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i ri la drang srong rta rlung zhes bya ba dka' thub la gnas pa na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyis 'u)rnam par sprul pa/ tshad med pa'i byams pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyi 1)stobs rjes su 67—221

thob pa/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can gyi chu bo kun tu 'chang bar rnam par sprul pa/ tshad med pa'i dga' ba'i byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyisatusems can thams cad la bde ba'i dran pa'i char rab tu 'bab ②pas kun tu ngoms pa/ tshad med pa'i btang snyomasasakyi ye shes kyis chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'jug pa la mkhas pa/ chos kyi sprin dang / lhag mthong dang / rigasapa dang / ye shes kyisastobs kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa chen po rnam par 'jig pa la mkhas pa/ bsdu ba rnam pa bzhis sems can rnams chu bo bzhi las bsgral bar bya ba'i ye shes dang / sems can thams cad la mtshungs par sems pa'i phyir byams pa dang / khong khro ba med pas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi lam yongs su dag pa/ chos kyis yang dag par 'jug pa/ ye shes chen po la mkhas pa/ 'jig rten la mchog gi lam yang dag par ston pa/sems can rnam par rgyas shing dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su sredakyipa'i chu brkamakhuzhing ye shes kyi las kyi mtha' la rab tu 'jug pa/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i ye shes rnam par rtse ba mngon par shes pa zla ba lta bu/ sems can thams cad kyi sems mtshungs par shes pa'i bsam pa mngon par yang dag par mgu ba'i phyir thabs la mkhas pa 'phel ba yang dag par ston pa/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i gzungs kyis tshad med pa'i snod chos rin po ches yongs su bkang zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyir skye bo thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhis rkang pa'i shugs chen pos7chos kyi tshul gyi lam zab mo'i rjes su zhugs pa/ mtshungs pa'i chos kyis gzhan gyi〈rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod pa/ bskal pa brgya stong grangs med pa'i mthar byang chub sems 67—222

dpa'i spyod pa thug pa med cing rgyun matubacad pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung ba / rlung dang mtshungs pa'i sems 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyis gos pa med pa/ bag chags thams cad rjes su 'brel pa'i nyon mongs pa rab tu spangs pa/ tshad med grangs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ gzungs dang / bzod pas rnam par rtse ②ba la mkhas pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rta dang glang po che mi dkar ba zhes bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' ri rab kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri rab zla ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bsgyings pa mi zad pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mig sngon po zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' ngur smrig seng ge sgra 'byin ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' nor gyi 'od kyi tshogs zhesashebya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri rab mtshams zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgyal mtshan rnam par sprul pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' glog gi phung po zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yon tan gyi gzi brjid dri ma med pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri rab stobs kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' gtogs 'dod mthu bo che zhes bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcu dang / sngon du 'gro ba drang srong rta rlung dang /drang srong stong phrag sum cu ④dang / lha bran brgya stong phrag bco ⑤brgyad kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yongs su bskor nas lhan cig tu 'khod do/ /67—223

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa legs par 'ongs pa la bka' stsal pal/ legs par 'ongs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i khri bshams pa de la bdag 'dug ste/ nyan thos rnams la nyan thos kyi gtam smra bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs par 'ongs pa phyir mnyan tegyo)/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir pho brang zlum po byas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor thams cad dang ldan pa la rnam par kun tu bltas te/ pho brang zlum por bshams pa nyid du bzhugs so/ /de nas dge slong gzhan dag kyang stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal zhunas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten zhes bgyi ba btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten zhes bgyi ba ni gang lags / de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten du btags pas btags pa ni ji lta bu lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag 'jig rten 'jig rten zhes bya ba dang / de de gebazhin gshegs pas 'jig rten du btags pas btagasalgepa ni ji tsam zhes dge slong khyod 46)de skad 'dri'am/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin rnal/ /de'i phyir dge slong khyod legs par nyon la shin tu yid la zung shigatsodang ngas bshad 8 do/ /btsun pa de bzhin no zhes gsol te/ dge slong de bcom ldan 'das la phyir nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong 'jig rten zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten rnam pa gnyis te9ske/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang / 'du byed kyi 'jig rten skruno/ /dge slong de 67—224

la snod kyi 'jig rten ni gang / 'du byed kyi 'jig rten ni gang zhe na/ sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams ji tsam pa ni snod ces bya'o/ /dge slong de la nang gi sa'i khams yod de/ dge slong de la nang gi sa'i khams gang zhe na/ gang nang gi sra ba'i ①sba ba nyid zin pa ni 'di lta ste/ rus pa dang / sen mo dang / so'i bar du ste/ 'di dag ni nang gi sa'i khams zhes bya'o/ / de lasaphyi rol gyi sa'i khams gang zhe na/ gang lus kyi phyi'i rol gyi sa'i khams ni 'di lta ste/ 'gron bu dang / gser dang / nor bu dang ske/ mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya gedang / dung dang / rdo dang / byi meru dang ske/ dngul dang / sa le sbram dang / gram bu dang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo dang / shing dang / rtswa dang / sman dang / phyag dar dang / 'di dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams zhes bya'o/ /chu'i khams gang zhe na/ phyi rol gyi chu'i khams yod/ gyenang gi chu'i khams kyang yod de/ de la nang gi chu'i khams gang zhe na/ lus 'di la chu dang / chu'i khams kyi mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang /rnag dang / khrag dang / gladam3)pa dang / gladangonargyas dang / mchil 1)ma dang ske/ rngul dang / ngar snabs dang / snabs dang / rgyungs pa dang /rkang hunye dang / gcin yod pa kun tu len pa 'di ni nang gi chu'i khams zhes bya'o / /de la phyi rol gyi chu'i khams gang zhe na/ gang lus kyi phyi rol gyi chu'i khams ni 'di lta ste/ chu dang / chu'i khams kyi snum pa dang / 'o ma dang /zho dang / dar ba dang / bu ram dang / shing gi ro dang / chang dang /rtsab mo dang / bu ram chang dang / me tog chang dang / lus kyi phyi rol gyi chu'i khams ji tsam pa kun du len pa 'di ni phyi rol gyi chu'i khams so/ /de la 67—225

nang gi me'i khams gang zhe na/ lus 'dinyel gang skye bo'i mdog gi dro ba kun tu len pa des lus 'di dro ba nyid du ba dang / gdungs pa dang / rims dang /yongs su tshig pa dang / des zos ②pa dang / 'thungs pa dang / 'chos pa dang ske/ myangs pa de'i yang dag par yongs su smin par 'gyur ba 'di ni nang gi me'i khams zhes bya'o/ /de la phyi rol gyi me'i khams gang zhe na/ gang me'i gdung bsnyedang / nyi ma'i gdung ba dang / nor bu'i gdung ba dang / 'bru dang ske/ sman dang / shing dang / rtswa'i dro ba dang / lci ba'i dro ba dang /phyag dar gyi dro ba dang / 'di dag ni phyi rol gyi me'i khams zhes bya'o/ /de la nang gi rlung gi khams gang zhe na/ gang lus 'di la gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung dang /thur du rgyu ba'i rlung dang / ma zhu ba'i rlung dang / yan lag dang / nying lag tu rgyu ba'i rlung dang / 'di ni nang gi rlung rnams zhes bya'o/ /de la phyi rol gyi rlung gang zhe na/ gang phyi༄rol tu yang dag par rgyu ba'i rlung dang / rnam par rgyu ba'i rlung dang / gyen du rgyu ba dang / grang ba dang / dro ba'i dmu rlung phyed palamang po dang / sa 'dzin pa'i rlung dang / phyi rol gyi rlung gi khams gang yang rung ba 'di ni phyi rol gyi rlung gi khams zhes bya ste/ de ltar phyi dang nang gi 'byung ba chen po bzhi po 'di ni snod kyi 'jig rten zhes bya'o/ /'di gang gi snod ce na/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i snod do/ /dge slong dag phyi dang nang gi 'byung ba chen po bzhi po 'di dag la gang mos pa'am/ dga' ba'am/byams pa'am/ chagasalgepa'am/ rgya che ba'am/ nga yir bya ba'am/ bdag gir bya ba de thams cad spang bar bya'o zhes so sor bslabasnyepar bya'o/ /gang la la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i phyi dang nang gi'am/67—226

che ba'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ bzang ba'amanya/ gang ring ba'am/gang nye ba'a'akho/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi po de thams cad de bzhin du so sor bslabasnyepar bya'o/ /gang la la 'byung ba chen po bzhi po de dag ni bdag gi ma yin / bdag kyang de'i ma yin/ de yang dubadag ⑤ma yin no zhes de ltar de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag dge slong gang la la 'byung ba chen po bzhi po 'dishidag la de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis shin tu brtan par byed do/ /shin tu yid la byas pa'i dge slong de sred pa dang / rgyad pa dang / lus kyi sbyor ba'i rgyun gcod cing sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed pa ste/ dge slong dag 'di ni snod kyi 'jig rten no/ /dge slong dag de la 'du byed kyi 'jig rten gang zhe na/ nye bar len⑧pa'i phung po lnga ni 'du byed ces bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs nye bar len pa'i phung po dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang ske/ rnam par shes pa nye bar len pa'i phung po ste/ dge slong dag 'di ni 'du byed kyi 'jig rten no/ /dge slong dag sems can ji tsam pa gang sems can gyi bsdu bas yang dag par bsdus pa de thams cad phung po 'di dag gis bsdus pa dang / ldan pa 'di ni 'du byed kyi 'jig rten zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag nye bar len pa'i7phung po lnga po de la gang mos pa'am/ /dga' ba'am/byams pa'am/ chags pa'am/ rgya che ba'am/ nga yir bya ba'am/ bdag gir bya ba de thams cad spang bar bya'o zhes so sor bslabalge par bya'o/ /gang cung zad 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'am/ phyi'i 'am/nang gi'am/ che ba 'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ bzang nyunyaba'am/ gang 67—227
