ring ba'am/ gang nye ba'i gzugs de thams cad bdag gi ma yin/ bdag kyang de'i 3)ma yin/ de yang bdag ma yin no zhes de ltar de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /gang la la 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'am/ phyi'i 'am/ nang gi'am/che ba'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ bzang ba'am/ gang ring ba'am/gang nye ba tshor ba dang mi/ gang la la 'du shes dang / gang la la 'du byed dang ske/ gang cung zad rnam par shes pa de thams cad ni bdag gi ma yin/bdag kyang de'i bam yin/ de bdag ma yin no zhes de ltar de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis (geji lta ⑤ba bzhin du blta bar bya ba ⑥'di ni dge slong dag snod kyi 'jig rten dang 'du byed kyi 'jig rten zhes bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang ba 'khor der 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' phung po rnam par 'jig pa la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa phung po rnam par 'jig pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phung po lnga po 'di 'jig rten du bstan pa ni 'di lta ste/ gzugs kyi phung po dang / tshor ba'i phung po dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa phung po lnga po de dag ni ji lta bu/ gzugs kyi phung po ni gang / 'dod pa'i khams mig dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang〈mig dang ske/ gzugs kyi 'gog pa yang dag par gzhol ba zhig gam/ gzugs dang /gzugs med pa'i khams kyi dus mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba dang / de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /67—228

lus dang yid kyi mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral bas yang dag par gzhol ba ni gang / ci gzugs kyi phung po 'dod pa'i khams mig dang /gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral bshogeyang dag par gzhol ba dngaspob/ /rna ba dang ske/ sna dang / lce dang / lus dang yid kyang mig dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba'am/ 'on te tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa 'dod pa'i khams mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba dang / gegazugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba'am/ci 'das pa gzugs kyi phung po'am/ mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba dang / rna ba dang / sna dang lce dang /lus dang / yid nas mig gi bar du'am/ gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams mig dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag par gzhol ba zhig gam/ 'on te geratshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa yang dag par gzhol ba zhig gam/ 'on te da ltar byung ba gzugs kyi phung po 'am/ mig dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i mig nas yid kyi bar du yang dag par gzhol ba zhig gam/'on te tshor ba nas yid kyi bar du'am/ 'on te ma 'ongs pa ⑥gzugs kyi phung po'am / mig dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / de rna ba nas 67—229

yid kyi bar du yang dag par gzhol ba zhig gam/ 'on te tshor ba nas yid kyi bar du'am/① de nas byang chub sems dpa' phung po rnam par 'jig⑧pas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 'god pa'i chos ltos/ mig gi ③bu gar gzugs kyi phung po dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba 'phos pa'ang ma yin/ mig gi ④bu gar tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / 'dod chags dang ⑤bral ba 'phos pa yang ma yin/ skye mched ni mi rtog rnam par ⑥mi rtog cing ldang〈peba'ang ma yin/ phung po ni ngag gi lam dang / dbyangasalgedang ske/ sgra dang brjod pa las yang dag par shin tu 'das7pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu chos thams cad ni skad cig ma ste/ dngos po dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni dbyangs med pa'o/ /dbyangs dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i lam ste mtshan ma med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni yi ge med pa'o/ /smon pa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ /stong pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni thob pa med pa'o/ /tshig med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni rtog pa dang bral ba'o/ /mi khom pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni chags pa dang bral ba'o/ /rkyen med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni sbyor ba dang bral ba'o/ /dmigs pa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni lta ba dang bral ba'o/ /mtshan nyid dben pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni dmigs pa dang bral ba'o/ /bdag med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag dang bral ba'o/ /brjod du med pa'o / /chos thams cad ni yi ge dang bral ba'o/ /rab tu zhi ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni chos nyid mi thob 7pa'o/ /mi snang ba thob pa'o chos thams 67—230

cad ni snang ba dang bral ba'o/ /shin tu yul med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni yul dang bral ba'o/ /shin tu rtsa ba med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni dbang po med pa'o/ /shin tu rang bzhin med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni spyod pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /gnyen po med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni sems med pa'o/ /chags pa dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni shin tu 'phros0)pa'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'jungs pa med mipa'o/ /spros pa dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni shin tu bsam gtan dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yo ba dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni shin tu sgrib pa med pa'o/ /rdul dang bral ba'o/ /shin tu bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni nyon mongasalgepa dang bral ba'o/ /stobs chung ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni rtsom5gepa dang bral ba'o/ /dngos po med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni dngos po dang bral ba'o/ /byed pasnyimed pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni las mi ston pa'o/ /tshor ba med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni nam mkha' dang ldan pa'o/ /thosalgepa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni dbyangs dang bral ba'o/ /gzungashedu med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis sdug pa'o/ /shes pa med pa'og/ chos thams cad ni tshor ba chags pa med pa'o/ /smig rgyu lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'du shes dang bral ba'o/ /brag ca7lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni rab tu snang ba'i 'od rnam par dag pa chu7zla lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni gzugs brnyan dang bral ba'o/ /gzugs brnyan la brten5nyapa'o/ /chos thams cad ni sprin mi dmigs pa'o/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni gzugs brnyan hurteno/ /bstan du 67—231

med pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'o/ /dngos po dang bral ba'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa nas/ mtshan nyid med pa dang / mtshan nyid dang bral ba dang / mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mtshan nyid gcig pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i bar du'o / /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag tu mi dmigs pa'o/ /ngar sems pa0)med pa'o/ /rten med pa'o/ /brjod du med pa'o / /chos thams cad ni yi ge med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'du byed thams cad ni skad cig ma zad pa dang bral ba'o zhes nyon mongs pa dang 'khrug pa med par bya ba'i phyir bdag dang gzhan la gnod pa med pa spros pa med pa'i bzod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di la rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' de'i dbang gi bzod pa bsgom (mipa na yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zhes bya ba thob bo/ /bzod pa 'di thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' skad cig ma gcig dang yang dag par ldan pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las lhag par lus yongs su sprul to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi niphyogs bcu stong pa dang / rnyog pa lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du song ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer yang rdul ④shin tu phra ba snyed kyisnyirnam pa sna tshogs kyi char gtong ba ni 'di lta ste/ zas kyi char ram/ skom gyi char ram/ gos sam/ lhab lhub bam/ dri'am/ me tog gam/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi char yang rab tu 'ong ngo / /gang sems can zas dang / skom de yongs su zos pas zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba 'thobashepa'i sems can de 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ bdag med pa / stong pa nyid kyi dran pa dang / tshul khrims thob bo/ /khyim gyi bcings pa 67—232

thams cad dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spangs te byung nas ri'i sul dang /khyim med pa stong pa'i nags tshal stug por gnas par 'gyur ro/① /drang srong gi cha byad kyi rtswasadang / rtsa ba dang 'bras bu'i zas la gnas par 'gyur ro/ri —no /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po de dag la mi bzadatswapar mos shings3)/ brtson 'grus rtsom ⑥pa la spro bar byed do/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di dag la nad dang / shu ba dang / zug rngu dang / mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ stong pa dang / bdag med par yid la byed do/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob bo/ /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gos nas rin po che yongs su sbyang ba'i sribar du tsheyongs su spyod par byed do/ /de shes pas zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba thob pa nas tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bar du gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ltar de bzhin du gang yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis hu3 'dul ba'i bzod pa 'di dag thob pa de snyim pas me tog nam mkha' la gtor ba'i me tog de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi stong pa dang / rnyog pa lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skad cig ma gcig gis song ba'i me tog re re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing humardul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi chos kyi sgo brjod pa'i dbyangs 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad dbyangs med pa'o/ /bdud bzhi'i yul las 'da' ba'o3lhe/ /chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i lam mo/ /gnas yang dag par spong ba'o/ /yi ge med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni chags pa yang dag par gzhol ba'o/ /mi skye ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni nyon mongs pa yang dag par gzhol ba'o/ /ma 'gags / pa'o/ /chos 67wa 233

thams cad ni7sngon gyi dam tshig mi gtong ba'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni chags pa yang dag par gtong ba'o/ /rkyen med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni kun tu sbyor ba yang dag par gtong ba'o/② /gnas med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni rtsom pa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag gir bya ba dang /nga yir bya ba yang dag par gtong ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni dben pa'o/ /'du 'dzi yang dag par gtong ba'o/ /bdag med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag dang bral ba nas brjod du med pa'i bar du'o/ /rab tu zhi ba'o/ /mi snang ba thob pa'o/ /mi gnas pa'o/ /shin tu yul med pa'o/ /shin tu rtsa ba med pa'o/ /shin tu rang bzhin med pa'o/ /gnyen po med pa'o/ kha zas med pa'ol/ /shin tu 'thor ba med pa'o/ /'jungs pa med pa'o/ /shin tu bsam gtan byed pa'o/ /shin tu bsgribasalgepa med pa'o/ /shin tu 'ong ba med pa'o/ /nyam chung ba'o/ /dngos po med pa'o/ /byed pa med pa'o/ /tshor ba med pa'o/ /zag pa med pa'o/ /'dzin pa med pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa med pa'o/ /smig rgyu lta bu'o/ /brag ca57lta bu'o/ /mig yor lta bu'o/ /chu zla lta bu'o/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa nas mtshan nyid med pa dang / mtshan nyid dang bral ba dang /mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mtshan nyid gcig pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i bar du'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /ngar sems pa med pa'o / /gzung du med pa'o/ /brjod du med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni skad cig ma'o/ /'du byed zad pa dang bral ba'o zhes bzod pa'i sems bsgom par bya'o / /chos thams cad ni skad cig ma zhes zhi ba'i sems bsgom par bya'o/ /67—234

mnyam pa'i sems dang / rnam par zhi ba'i sems dang / 'dzin pa med pa'i sems dang / 'byung ba med pa'i sems dang / sgrib pa med pa'i sems dang / chod patumed pa'i sems dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i sems dang / rten med pa'i sems dang / mnyam par bzhag⑧pa'i sems dang / sdug bsngal gyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du nye bar zhi bshestong pa phyi dang nang gi 'jig pa brjod pa'i chos kyi sgo dang / tshad medartsomagrangs med pa'i chos kyi sgo me tog de dag lasa'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de yang chos kyi sgo de thos nas zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba thob pa de 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ bdag med pa/ stong pa nyid kyi dran pa dang ske/ tshul khrims thob bo/ /khyim gyi bcings pa thams cad dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yang dag par spangs te byung nas ri'i sul dang / khyim med pa stong pa'i nags tshal stug por gnas par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong gi cha byad kyis 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba dang / rtswa'i zas la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po de dag la mi bzadam༅par mos shing brtson 'grus rtsom〈kyepa la spro bar byed do/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di dag la nad dang / shu ba dang / zug rngu dang / mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang ske/ bdag med par yid la byed do/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob bo/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di 'dra ba'i bzod pa sgom pa de ni ming mi dmigs sems can mi dmigs / srog mi dmigs/ gso ba mi dmigs/ gang zag mi dmigs/gzugs mi dmigs/ tshor ba ma yin/ 'du shes ma yin/ 'du byed ma yin/67—235

rnam par shes pa'ang mi dmigs/ mig mi dmigs/ rna ba'angatum yin/sna'ang ma yin/ lce'ang ma yin/ lus kyang mi dmigs/ yid kyang mi dmigs so/ge /gzugs mi dmigs/ sgra mi dmigs/ dri mi dmigs/ ro mi dmigs / reg ri mi dmigs/ chos mi dmigs/ yid mi dmigs/ lus mi dmigs/ tshig mi dmigs/ sems mi dmigs so/ /stong pa nyid mi sogs rtso)pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ thub pa/ khams gsum gtong ba med pa/mngon par 'du mims)byed pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma bsgoms4)pa/ ma byang ba'i bzod pa 'di smras so/ /ma byas pa/ bya ba med pa de sngon gyi mtha' la bya ba med pa/ phyi ma'i mtha' la chu'adas pa med pa/ dbus kyi mtha' la yang dag par med pa/ mi gnas pa/ mi dmigs pa/ yid la mi byed pa'i bzod pa 'di bsgom pa na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i bzod pa thob po/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa 'di thob pas ji lta bur gong du bshad ④pa'i rtsal 'di 'dra ba bya bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' phung po rnam par 'jig pa 'di bstan pa ston cing brjod pa na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi rtog pa zhes bya bas legs so zhes bya ba byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag cang mi smra bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas zhal gyis bzhes par gyur pa dang / de nas dge slong drug cu tsam 'di snyam du sems te/rigs kyi bu phung po rnam par 'jig tho)pa ci la bsams te 0rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sgyu ma 'dra ba'i 'du byed thams cad ston/ gal te gzugs bdag med pa/ mi snang ba/ kun nas ldang ba med pa/ yid la mi byed pa/ mi rtog pa/ rnam 67—236

par mi rtog pa/ dmigs pa med pa/ rgyu ba med pa'am/ 'on te 'di lta ci/sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba'am/ gso ba'am/ gang zag gam/shed las skyes ①pa'am/ shed can nam/ byed pa po'am tshor ba po'am/tshor ba gzhan nam/ skye ba'am/ yang dag par skye ba'am/ gang mi dga' ba dang ske/ mi 'byung ba med par mi 'gyur ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang du byung / snying rje chen po ni gang na/ chos 'chad padzageni su zhig /chos kun shes pa ni gang zhig /bslab pa sdom pa ni gang na gnas/ gal te phung por mi 'gyur na de ltar khams dang skye mched rnams kyang dge ba rnams kyi chos kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin par mi 'gyur na/ legs par byas pa dang / nyes par byasalgepa'i las kyi 'bras bu ni gang du smin/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gang du 'byung / nyan thos dang ske/ rang rgyal ba ④rnams dang / lha dang mi rnams dang / gang gzhan ⑤yang sems can gyi lus skye mched drug gis bzung ba ni gang du byung /bdag ni stan las langs te 'gro bar bya snyam mo/ /de nas dge slong drug cu tsam stan las langs te dong nas dge slong gzhan dag kyang cang mi smra bar gyur parnyudang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' phung po rnam par 'jig pa bcom ldan 'das la ngo tsha zhing mi spobs pa dang gnong bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na mar me 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur pa des/byang chub sems dpa' phung po rnam par 'jig pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /don gyi dbang gang mthong na 'khor smra ba dang bcas pa la chos kyi tshul rnam pa 'di lta bu zab mo yang dag par ston/ rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo 67—237

sde gzhan dag lasashegang zag lnga rnams la chos kyi gtam dang / gtam ngan pa dang ske/ dad pa med pa la dad pa'i gtam dang / gtam ngan pa dang /'jungs pa la gtong ba'i gtamasadang / gtam ngan pa dang / tshul khrims ngan pa la tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / gtam ngan bsnyedang / le lo la brtson 'grus kyi gtam dang / gtam ngan pa dang / 'chal pa'i shes rab la shes rab kyi gtam dang / gtam ngan pa'o zhes 'di ltar gsungs so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde gzhan lasasnyibastan pa/ mtshams med par7byed pa rnams la stong0pa'i gtam mi smra bar bya'o/ /log par lta ba'i lus canashernams la lus dran pa nye bar gzhagashepa mi smra bar bya'o/ /brkam pa rnams la tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mi smra bar bya'o/ /nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang /kha zas la chags pa rnams la sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mi smra bar bya'o/ /ngo tsha ba'i chos kyi rtsa ba spong ba rnams la chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mi smra bar bya'o / /mi thob par 'dod pa rnams la lhar skye ba'i yon tan mi smra bar bya'o/ /'dod pa la ④spyod pa'i lhar skye ba yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la mdangs 'phrog pa'i gnod sbyin skye ba'i yon tan mi smra bar bya'o/ /gzugs la spyod pa'i lhar skye ba bzung ba rnams la 'dod pa spyod pa'i lha dang dpal mi smra bar bya'o/ /gzugs hu )med pa'i khams su skye ba yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la gzugs la spyod pa'i yon5ṇ+ḍitan mi smra bar bya'o/ /gzugs la spyod pa'i lhar skye ba7bzung ba rnams la 'dod pa spyod pa'i lha'i〈nyebade ba mi smra bar bya'o/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mi smra bar bya'ol/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la nyan thos 67—238

kyi yon tan dag mi smra bar bya'o/ /theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la ranganyesangs rgyas kyi yon tan mi smra bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par brtson pa rnams la bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pasabazhi mi smra bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i rnam par spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa rnams la tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa bzhi mi smra bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor smra ba med pa la rnam pa 'di lta bu zab mo zhi ba stong pa nyid kyi gtam mi⑧spa bar bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i 'khor rnam pa 'di lta bu smra ba dang bcas pa'i mdun du yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zab mo 'di mi smra bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mang po de thams cad dang ldan pas mgrin gcig tu legs so zhes bya ba byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' lag na mar me la legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis spro ba yang dag par bskyed do/ /legs so legs so shes rab che/ /rnam par shes pas mchog gcod pa/ /mtshan nyid thabs dang7chos rnams kyi//dus ni khyod kyisakurab tu shes/ /'khor rnams shes pa ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ston par byed⑨/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa la/ /chos 'di brjod par mi byed do/ /nam mkha' mtshungs shing mnyam pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mdun dag tu/ /chos 'di rab tu bstan pas na/ /tshul 'di kun du shes par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mtho medarwaskrel/ /dma' ba med cing gzugs med pa/ /shes rab pha rol5)phyin spyod pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid med/ /bskal pa grangs med pa dag gi(nye/ /'das pa'i rgyal ba'i 67—239

spyan sngar ni/ /smra ba med pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /khyod kyi7chos 'di thos pa dang / /ji ltar rgyal ba des bstan pa'i/ /grags pa chen po'i bzod pa 'di/ /brtson 'grus brtan⑧pa'i sems can la/ /'jigs med pa 'di rab tu bstan//byang chub sems dpa' rab dag cing / /yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' med pa/ / skal bsaldan pa'i mdun du ni/ /chos 'di yang ni rab tu bstan/ /nyan thos theg pa mngon brtson dang / /rang rgyal dag gi mngon dga' la/ /chos 'di rab tu bstan pas na/ /de nyid 'tshang rgyar mi 'gyur ro/ /mi shes pas ni spong ba dang / /mos pa med par skyes pas na/ /bsod nams mang po 'byung med cing / /ngan 'gror yang ni myur du 'gro/ /ting 'dzin bzod pa'i⑧gzungs kyis niX/ /gal te de lus sbyang byas te/ /byang chub lam la brtson bya'i7phyir/ /la la thabs dang de bral ba/ /'khor dang gang zag rnams kyis kyang / /sems kyis rtog par mi byed do/ /'chal pa'i shes rab snod min la/ /stong pa zhi ba smra bar byed/ /de yang myur du spangs pas na/ /mun pa'i phung pos bsgribs pa dag /gzhan dag gi ni gnas bcu la/ /myur du yang ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dmyal ba yi dgas7byol song du/ /lha ma yin dang lus srul po/ /gnod sbyin srin po gtum po7yang / /yang dang yang ni 'dir skye'o/ /mir gyur dka' byed thob pa dag /gal te ji ltar thob na yang / /smad pa'i gdol pa rnams dang ni/ /'on pa long ba zhar ba dang / /rtag tu nad dang nyam chung ba/ /skur pa 'debs shing mchod pa med8/ /zas dang skom dang bral ba ste/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis smad par 'gyur/ /pha dang ma la bkur ste med/ /nyes par byas pa rtag tu spyod/ /sems can rnams la snying rje med/ /67—240

ngan 'gror7yang ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni rab tu song ba yi/ /dge slong drug cu tsam 'di dag /yid kyis rtog pa zhe sdang ba/ /ngan 'gror yang ni myur du 'gro/ /lus dbang byas pa'i sems can 'di/ /gang gis bzod pa 'di bstanakhucing / /thabs la mngon sum ma yin pa/ /des ni dge slong de song ngo / /yesheshes thabs dang ldan pa dgadu /pha rol sems la lta ba yi/ /'jig rten la ni sgron 'dzin pa/ /sems can kun la sman0par smra/ /thams cad don dugyi rjes shes pa/ /thog mar yang ni 'khor ltos la/ /ci 'drar 'gyur ba'i 'khor rnams la/ /de 'dra bar ni chos kyang shod/ /de nas yangasnyebyang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po ches 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu ji lta bur nyan thos kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri bshams te/ nyan thos 'dul ba'i phyir smra bar 'gyur ro zhes bdag gis yongs su shes so/ /rigs kyi bu yang 'dis sngon ma thos pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan pa na⑨/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ji lta bur bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul tsonam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa yon tan gyis dmigs pa sbyor ba rgya chen pos bshad par bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba gdab cing / bdag dang sems can gzhan la yang thugs brtse ba'i slad du rjes su gzung bar 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na mar mes byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po che la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu gang gi dus la bab par shes/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na mar me stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas te/ /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs 67—241

su thal mo sbyar te phyag byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ thub pa tshangs7pa rab tu dga' mdzad pa/ /ye shes nyams pa'i 'gro la sgron ma 'dzin/ /grol dang rig la khyod ni dang bar mdzad / /rdul dang bral ba'i chos kyi sgo 'di ston/ /rgyal ba nyi ma grol la mar me mdzad/ /sems can du ma la ni snang mdzad pa/ /lam rnams rab bstan⑧lam ni khyod ston pa/ /mchog gi chos kyi sgo 'di bstan par mdzod/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i thugs/ /thugs dam mi g.yo ji ltar ri brtan⑧bzhin/ /thub pa 'jig rten zla ba'ikhu'od 'dra ba/ /tshul mdog bzod pa'i dge ba 'di yang ston/ /snying rje gnas shing 'gro la bzod mdzodakyipa / /khyod kyi chog shes pa ni mchog tu che/ /rga 'chi nad gsum rab tu zhi mdzad pa/ /bzod pa mchog gi yon tan 'di yang ston/ /thub pa seng ge mu stegs 'jigs0par mdzad/ /'gro ba dga' mdzad ka la ping ku'i skad/ /mu stegs can gyi 'khor mngasashernam 'jig pa/ /mar me'i bzod pa 'di yang bstan ⑧par mdzod/ /sa dang mnyam pa bzod pa mchog gi thugs/ /bde dang sdug bsngal reg la khro mi mdzad/ /mthon po ma yin da ltar mtho min pa/ /yongs min gzigs te bzod pa 'di yang gsungs/ /ye shes mchog gis7nga yi nga rgyal gyiyi/ /rlung langs lta bu'i nyon mongs dgra yang gtor/ /des ni bzod pa'i dam pa 'di thob pa/ / lam gyi5)me yis sred pa'i chu yang bskams8/ /khyod kyis lta ba lcug ma sred chu tshig /klu lta bur ni chos kyi char gtong ba/ /des ni 'khor 'di dga' bar gyur pa ste/ /yongs su smin la gzigs shing bzod 'di gsung / /sems can rnams la rnam grol yon tan skyeda'/ /bzod 67—242

pa mchog gi yon tan 'di ston cing / /gang gi bsam pa dri ma med bzod 'gyur/ /de thob pa yi yon tan 'di mtha' yas/ /spyod yul nam mkha'i mdog gisatu'adul ba yi/ /thub pas 'das pa'i bzod pa 'di gsungs dang / /da ltar gyi yang bzod pa 'di gsungs pa/ /thugs rjer dgongs khyod bzod pa 'di yang gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rin chen lag la cang mi gsungakhubs zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gang na yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan par nga yang dgongs so snyam mo/ /lha bran gyis gsol pa/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzod pa 'di bstanasnyenas ji lta bu'i spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis0'dul ba'i bzod pa 'di bshad par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid ye shes bstan pa la 'jug go /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das skar mda'i bdag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ting nge 'dzin des bcom ldan 'das drang srong gi brtul zhugs dang / spyod lam dang / mtshan ma dang / dbyibs kun tu snang ste/ drang srong de yang rgan po dang / rgas pa dang / 'khogs pa dang / skra ring po'i ral pa 'chang ba dang | ag tsom 0ring po dang / dbyug pa dang / ril ba dang / gtsang ma 'dzin me'i sbyin sreg chen po 'bar bar byed do/ /de las kyang 'od kyi phung bo kha dog sna tshogs dang / kha dog mtha' yas pa dang / kha dog brgya stong du 67—243

ma dang / kha dog rgya chen po shin tu yongs su dag pa dri ma med pa'i 'od 'byung7ngo ske/ /de'i 'od snang bas phyogs bcu'i zhing stong pa dang / rnyog pa lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med pa'i skar ma dang / rin po che dang /glog dang / 'od dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin gyi 'od kyang mi mngon mi snang ngo / /sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song dang / yi dgas kyi lta ba yang mi mngon mi snang ngo / /de'i tshe drang srong thub pa ma gtogs par sems can rnams kyi sgra dang / brjod pa dang / dbyangs dang / tshig dang / yi ge dang / chung ngu na sa dang / chu dang / me dang /rlung gi sgra yang mi grag go/ /de'i tshe na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med pa na sems can gang la la theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa de thams cad drang srong gi brtul zhugs dang / lus dang mtshan ma dang /dbyibs kun tu snang ngo / /yang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i drang srong ma gtogs par nyan thos sam/ rang rgyal ba'i theg pa pa'i drang srong ni kun tu mi snang ngo / /yang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i drang srong des nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas mi⑧mthong zhing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa yang mi⑧mthong ngo / /de'i tshe na gang yang nyan thos 'khor der 'dug pa de de bzhin gshegs pa mi mthong zhing / de byang chub sems dpa' yang duyang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /gang yang 'dir 'dug⑧'dug pa 'dus par gyur pa gzhanarnyudu na cung zad gzugs snang ba yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /snang ba rgya chen pos ni 'jig rten thams cad khyab par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de nas nyan thos chen po 67—244

des kun shes kau di natul smras pa/ gnas brtan kau di na⑧bcom ldan 'das gang na kau di rgyasasasmras pa/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na zhes bya ba ni mi shes so/ /mi mthong ngo / /de nas nyan thos chen po des 'od srung chen po la smras pa/ sbyangs pa smra ba'i nang na bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod mchog tu bstan na/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na ba soms shig /'od srung chen pos smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na0zhes bya ba mi shes so/ /mi mthong ngo de nas nyan thos chen po des tshe dang ldan pa sha ⑦ra dwa ti'i bu la smras pa/ gnas brtan ④shā ri'i bu shes rab dang ldan pa'i nang na bcom ldan 'das dhikyis khyod mchog tu bstan na/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba soms shig /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' med pas bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na zhes bya ba mi shes so/ /mi mthong ngo / /de nas nyan thos chen po des mod gal ya na la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ya na rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i nang na bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod kyang mchog tu bstan na/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na ba soms shig /mod gal ya nas smras pa/ gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos smras pa de nyid na bdag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni〈nyerdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis rjes su shes kyi/bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na bzhugs pa gang du bzhud ces bya ba ni mi mthongasnyingo / /mi shes so/ /de nas nyan thos chen po des tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la smras pa/ lha'i mig gi nang na bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod kyang mchog tu bstan na/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang du bzhud/ gang na gnas/ spyod pa ni ci 'dra ci 'drar spyod/ khyod kyi lha'i mig gis ltos/ ma 'gags pas 67—245

smras pa/ kho bos 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi7mig gis mtha' yas mu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par bltas na/ bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang na bzhugs / gang du bzhud ces bya ba dag kyang mi shes so/ /mi mthong ngo / /des smras pa/ yang tha dad par yang dag par shes pa thob pa'i nyan thos kyi ye shes gang la 'ang mi 'jug gi /bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes ni de la 'jug go/ /bdag gis bcom ldan 'das da ltar gang du bzhud/gang na bzhugs zhes byang chub sems dpa' la dri snyam pa dang / de nas nyan thos chen po des byang chub sems dpa' gcig ④kyang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di la rigs kyi bu gzhan zhig gis phung po bshad par byas pa desnyen dge slong drug cu tsam ④po stan las langs te dong bas/ tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das thugs mi dgyes nas btang snyoms shing 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi ⑤spyod pas rigs kyi bu dang thabs cig57tu spyod do/ /bdag cag ni rang rang gi spyil por zhugs shing bsam gtan bya snyam ste/ de nas nyan thos chen po de dgasherang rang gi spyil por zhugs nas bsam gtan byed do// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med pa na theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can de/ bdag drang srong gi cha byad du mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/gal te bdag cag drang srong du gyur pa na/ gang drang srong las shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa de bdag cag gi mkhan por bzungasango zhes/ bdag cag rnam par blta bar bya'o snyam pa de thams cad rtog pa sel ba zhes bya ba byed pa can gyi 67—246

grong rdal na drang srong chen po shākya thub pa rgas pa/ 'khogs pa/ gtugasalgepa rnams7me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / sman dang / zas dang / skom rnam pa sna tshogs kyis me la gtor ba thag mi ring bar mthong nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ drang srong chen po7'di nus pa chen po mthu chen po 'di'i mthus snang ba chen po 'byung ngo / /drang srong 'di gang na ba de logs su nye bar 'gro zhing drang srong gi brtul zhugs dang spyod pa'i rjes su bslab par bya'o ④snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' drang srong bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du nye bar dong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' drang srong ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang / gzungs dbang du byas pa de sems rtse gcig pa'i stobs kyis gebacom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir brtson pa de nyid kyi tshe/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gang lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi masheyin pa la la theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa de thams cad drang srong gi cha byad kyis drang srong shākya thub pa'i thad du der〈nye bar dong ngo / /'khor thams cad dang ldan pa de bcom ldan 'das ji lta bur spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la bzhud nas de na ⑩yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i tunyamadog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa 'di bstan pa'i phyir/ (rtechos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa la yang 1snye/'jug par bzhed skopa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis ⑩shes so/ /bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi don gyi phyir lam brgyan pa sbyang b.ratsobya zhing lam des 7drang srong gi mchog spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la nye bar 'gro bar bya'o 67wa 247

snyam ste/ de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo dang / rgya mtsho dang / nor mdogatudang / 'jog po dang / yid yodasal sogs pa klu'i rgyal po bye ba phrag drug cu tsam lhan cig tu drang srong gi cha byad kyis lha rdzas kyi rin po che gser dang / dngul dang / bai drur+ya7dang / shel dang / byisarba dang ske/ a sma gar bsnyedang / mu sakyir ga la ba la sogs pa rin po che sna bdun gyi shing takhula'i phreng ba gser gyi shing la dngul gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang 'bras bu dang5khya/ dngul gyi shing la gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu nas mu sa ra gal ba'i 1)shing gi bar du rin po che sna bdun gyi lo ma dang ske/ me tog dang / 'bras bu'i phreng ba'i rgyan gyis lam de brgyan par sprul to / /shing ta la'i phreng ba de la lha rdzas kyi gos stong phrag bye ba rnam pa du ma rnam pa sna tshogs mngon par rab tu 'phyang ngo ⑨ / /lha de dag kyang drang srong gi cha byad kyis dka' thub kyi gnas nas spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri'i bar du lam gyi zhing tunyedapag tshad bcu pa spyangs tsoso/ /lam gyi mu gnyis su lha rdzas kyi gser nas / mu sa ra gal ba'i〈nyebar du rin po che sna bdun gyi stegs bur sprul to/ /gser gyi shing rtachal dngul gyi snying po 'phyang ba nas/ mu sa ra gal ba'i bar du smra bar bya'o/ /'og logs su be+e drur+ya bzang po nas/ gong7logs kyi gnas su shel gyi bar du rgya chen pos mnyebar bya'o/ /sprin gyi lha'i bu drang srong gi cha byad kyis lam ste gyi mu gnyis su rdzing rnyog pa med pa rin po che sna bdun gyi them skas can gyi rdzing de dag la gser gyi phye5nyem bdal ba/ rdzing de dag la yang lha rdzas kyi me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang /phun da rī ka dang / a ti mug tasngo nyeka dang / tsam pa ka dang / a sho ka 67—248

dang ske/ mu tsu kunatud dang / man 'dzushesha ka dang / ba ta li dang / pa ri sha ka dang / lhan dha da nu pa ska ri ②dang / su ma ra ④dang / a mra dang / 'dzam bu0dang / sri na la dang / mchog tu dri zhim pa rnam pa sna tshogs su mngon par sprul toX/ /sa bla na gnam gyisheganod sbyin drang srong gi cha byad kyis lam sbyong bar byed do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis lam gyi mu gnyis la lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyal mtshan mchog 'dzin to/ /rgyal mtshan gyikhumachog de dag la lha rdzas kyi gos dang / do shal dang / rgyan rab tu 'phyang ngo / /'phrul dga'i lha'i bu yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun gyi khang bu brtsegashem mngon par sprul to/ /khang bu brtseg ma de dag gi phyogs bzhi kun tu rin po che sna bdun gyis byas so/ /khang bu brtseg7ma de la yang lha rdzas kyi do shal sna tshogs dang / gos sna tshogs dang / rgyan sna tshogs mngon par rab tu 'phyang ngo / /me tog sna tshogs kyisalgekun tu gtor to/ /khang bu brtsegamatsho/nyem de la lha rdzas kyi rol mo rgya chen po yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs byung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis rol mo dkrol ba dang / glu'inyesgra bsgrags pa des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad sgras khyab par gyur to/ /klu'i bu mo brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad lam mdzes pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir drang srong gi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rin po che sna tshogs kyisngo 7char phab bo /dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis (she'adi lta ste/lha rdzas kyi me tog man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / tsam pa ka dang / ba ri ya tra dang / 'dzo sha dang / 'dzo sha ka chen po dang / ro 67—249

tsa dang / ro tsa ka chen po dang / bal la dang /① bal la chen po dang / tsakra dang / tsakra'uchen po'ikhu'od dri ma med pa/ 'dab ma brgya pa/ 'dab ma stong pa/ 'dab ma brgya stong pa/ kun nas 'od/ kun nas dri/ kun nas rnam par rgyu ba'i dri/ rtag tu me tog 'od snang ba/ kha dog mtha' med pal/ bltar 'os pa mig gis mngon par dga' ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi don dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lam dephumadzes par byas so/ /char pa'i sprin gyi lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dag kyang drang srong gi cha byad kyis chu las skyes pa dang / thang las skyes pa'i me tog gikyichar rab tu phab bo/ /klu'i glang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis yang dag par gnas shing 'di lta ste/ mu tig sngon po'i char dang / go sher sha'i snying po'i char la sogs te/ char sna tshogs rab tu phab bo/ /gang la la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i lha'am/ lha'i dbang po'am/ klu 'am/ klu'i dbang po'am/gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang /grul bum dang / grul bum gyi dbang po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i bar du de thams cad drang srong gi cha byad kyis me tog sna tshogs dang / phreng ba sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang / byug pa sna tshogs dang / rol mo dkrol ba sna tshogs dang brdung ba dang / glu sna tshogs yongs su bzung nas bcom ldan 'das spyan mi 'dzums pa'i zhal la rnam par ltasnyiba'i phyir 'khod do/ /gang la la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi 67—250

khams 'dir lha'i bu mo'am/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo'am/ nam mkha' lding gi bu mo 'am/ lha ma yin gyi bu mo'am/ mi 'am ci'i bu mo'am lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo de thams cad drang srong gi cha byad kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi ①phyir rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba dang / glulayongs su bzung ste/dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shelakhugyi kha dog gi gos kyi0char khad kyis khadakyikyis rab tu phab bo/ /mi 'am ci'i bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa sna tshogs kyi las kyi phyir brtson no/ /tshangs pa'i dbang po sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis bcom ldan 'das la stodalacing spyan sngar 'khod do/ /brgya byin gyi dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis phyag 'tshal bar byed cing / mi 'am ci'i dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis stod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri za'i dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis rab tu gsal ba'i sems kyis zhal la rnam par lta'o/ /klu'i dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis dus dang 'thun⑧pa'i tsan dan gyi phye ma'i char chen po rab tu 'bebs so/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis phyogs bzhir rlung mchog tu 'jam pas kun tu reg pa/ mchog tu dri zhim pa/ mchog tu 'jam pa gtong ngo / /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis me tog gi gdugs 'dzin to/ /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong rgan por gyur nasalgegaser gyi dbyug pa'i gdugs 'dzin cing bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su 'khod de/ bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin du 67—251

lta'o༈ /grul bum brgya stong du ma'ang drang srong rgan po'i cha byad kyis gser gyi dbyug pa'i gdugs 'chang zhing bcom ldan 'das kyisnyegayon logs su 'khod de/bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin du lta'og/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis nam mkha'i dkyil du gser gyi 'phreng ba 'phyangasnyibar gyur to/ /lha'i bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis me tog gi chun po'i char chen po mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /klu'i bu mo brgyasastong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis mu tig dmar po'i char mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /dri za'i bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis mu tig dmar po'i char mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /gnod sbyin gyi bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis tsan dan gyi phye ma'i charasnyemangon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /lha ma yin gyi bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srog gi cha byad kyis rgyan gyi char mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /nam mkha' lding gi bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis 'dzam bu gachu klung gi gser gyi char mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis nam mkha'i dkyil brgyan par byed do/ /sa'i gnod sbyin brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis dbyangs gtong bar byed do/ /bar snang gi gnod sbyin brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis nam mkha' la 'phyen meto/ /bdud brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis lhung lhung ldegs kyi sgra 'byin pa la 'jug go/ /drang srong lha brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rang bzhin gyis brtan ⑨pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par spyod pa dang /drang srong stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rang bzhin gyis brtan pa'i brtul zhugs 67—252

yang dag par spyod pa dag lha rdzas kyi me tog man dā ①ra ba chen po blangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyi don gyi phyir rnyog pa sel ba nas spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri'i bar du mtshams sbyor ba'i char rab tu 'byin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bzhud pa'i zhabs kyis ②me tog gi snying po kun tu gnon par gyur to/ /lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis me tog gi chun po'i char mngon par rab tu 'bebs so/ /dri za bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis ③rol mo dkrol bas drang srong thub pa'i sku la 'od zer bye ba brgya stong 'byung ngo / /de nas lha yon tan can zhes bya ba spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la gnas pa lha bran brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang lhan cig tu drang srong gi cha byad kyis bcom ldan 'das gangasnyen ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mgrin gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /sems can mi srun grol byed rkang gnyis mchog /mnyes dka' rgyal ba gzungasashengan 'dren mdzad cing / /sdug bsngal gzir la bde ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ /rgyal ba rkang gnyis dam pa 'dir gshegs gsol/ /sred pa rab spangs rnam thar gsum ston cing / /'gro la dus gsum nang na ye shes kyis/ /bslab pa gsum ston dri mashegasum spangs pa/ /khams gsum las 'das thub pa 'dir gshegs gsol/ /'gro la phyin ci log bzhi rnam par gro'akho/ /'khor bzhi dag gis zhabarme la bsnyen bkur zhing / /'gro la 'phags pa'i bden bzhi rab ston pa/ /zla ba bas kyang lhag pa 'dir gshegs gsol/ /thub pa phung po lnga 'di rab ston pa/ /'dod pa lnga las skye bo rnam grol zhing / /'phags pa'i shes rab yan lag lnga ston pa/ /'gro ba lnga 67—253

yi btsonamanyar rnam par bkrol(gye/ /dbang po drug 'dul gnas pa skyon med cing ske/ /sredas lus drug la shin tu rnam grol shes/ /sum cu rtsa drug dran ston sems can mchog /spos kyi ngad ldan ri 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba mnyam bzhag ④rab tu dul ba'i thugs/ /shin tu bsgoms pa byang chub dam pa mchog /ye shes sems can bye ba rab dul mdzad/ /kha lo rab sgyur spos ngad ri 'dir spyon/ /rgyal ba ye shes sems can rab stonasnyipa/ /ye shes kyis ni 'jig rten snang mdzad nas/ /khyod ni mun pas bsgribs la ye shes ston/ /thub pa dgon pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / 'dzam bu'i7gling 'dir sangs rgyas 'byung ba dag /'di la sngonashegyur la la thar 'dod cing / / mi yeshedabang po byang chub 'dir thob pa/ / mi yi0'dren mkhan khyod ni 'dir gshegs gsol/ /sbyin dang 'dul ba gtong zhing dul ba'i thugs/ /sems can nang mun gtso bo stobs bcu'i mchog /sems can dbul la gnyen pa 'phags pa khyod/ /spos kyi ngad ldang ri 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bar 'ga' khyod kyis lo drug dka' mdzad cing / /bar 'gar5)rgyal ba bdud phyir shing la bzhugs / /dpa' bo tshul gcig tu ni lam ston pa/ /thub pa 'dir gshegs bzod pa rab tu ston/ / bā rā ṇa sīr〈rte'akhor lo dam pa bskor/ /shes rab dam pa dag /2gi mdzod cig bogasungs/ /'jig rten thams cad 'di la khur bor ba/ /spos kyi ngad ldang ri 'dir bzod pa gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha du mas mdun du 15bdar cing byang chub sems dpa' du mas bskor nas gdan las bzhengs pa dang / de nyid kyi tshe na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lan drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen 67—254

po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gang sems can nyan thos sam/ nyan thos kyi thegatub pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'am/gang yang sems can gzhan thams cad gang nam mkha' la rgyu ba'am/ gang sa la rgyu ba 'am/ gang chu la rgyu ba de thams cad dran pa rgya chen po so sor thob bo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di lag mthil ②du skyes pa snang ba rgya〈(chen pos khyab par mthong ngo / /mig gi5gegazugs la ni cung zad kyang snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang yang sems can dka' thub ngan pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa de yang ngo mtshar chen po thob bo/ /'di lta ste/ me'imanyebartul zhugs can dang / zla ba'i brtul zhugs can dang / nyi ma'i brtul zhugs can dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi brtul zhugs can dang / de la sogs pa'i〈sems can gang la la lta ba nyam nga ba rnam pa sna tshogs thob pa⑦/ log pa la lta ba can de thams cad dka' thub ngan pa spangs nas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su bltasalaso/ /ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis na rnam pa de 1)lta bu'i sa g.yo bshi'adi dang / snang ba chen po 'di 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur(lha/ de nas bcom ldan 'das drang srong chen po'i spyan sngar gang me'i phung po chen po 'dug pa de yungs kur 8gyi 'bru tsam du mngon par sprul te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang / ma dag pa tshad med grangs med pa rnams su gtor to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag bzhugs te 'tsho skyong ba'i sangs rgyas de dag gi spyan sngar mer0)snang ba de me tog man tāchar ba chen por kun tu gnas par 'dug par gyur7to/ /'khor ji tsam pa 'dus pa dang / gang sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de thams cad 67—255

drang srong gi cha byad kyis ①sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing chu bo gang gā gnyis kyi bye ma snyed las shin tu 'das te/ de na⑧rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams der ③de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /de na de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi 'khor de las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shesasredapal zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bza' shing gi ⑤ra ba'i dpal zhes bya ba de drang srong gi gzugs dang / lus dang / dbyibs kyis bdag mthong ngo / /gzhan yang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu thams cad drang srong gi gzugs dang lus dang dbyibs kyis mthong ngo / /mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi dpal la yongs su zhus7pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i rgyu / ci'i rkyen gyis na gang me tog mer snang balgebo drur+ya'ishedabyig pa 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur() / theg pa chen po 'di dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu de thams cad drang srong gi cha byad 'dzin par grub / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi dpal gyis rigs kyi bu de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya methub pa zhes bya ba nub phyogs kyi mi mjed7kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na 'dug cing rnyog pa lnga'i 'jig rten du 'jug pa na dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma 'khor bzhi dag la theg pa gsum gyi chos ston par 67—256

byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de da7ltar yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan par 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de'i rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das7bzod pa 'di'i⑧thog ma dang tha ma ji lta bu zhig bka' stsal pa/ bzod pa 'di ni mu stegs can thams cad la 'jug pa'o/ /de⑥ltar mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing derasnyisems can chu bo bzhis khyer ba rnams las7sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /chu bo bzhi gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i chu bo dang / lta ba'i chu bo dang / srid pa'i chu bo dang ske/ ma rig pa'i chu bo 'dishedag las sems can sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /dad pa mi phyed pa bzhi yang dag par len du 'jug pa/ 'jug par byed pa/so sor dgod par byed pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas la dad pa mi phyed pa / sems can rnams yang dag par len du 'jug pa/ 'jug par byed pa/so sor dgod par byed pa'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi la sems can rnams sbyor bar byed pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi phung pos sems can rnams7'dod pa'i chu bo las sgrol ⑨bar byed pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phung pos sems can rnams lta ba'i chu bo las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi phung pos sems can rnams ma rig pa'i chu bo las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /rnam par grol ba'i phung pos sems can rnams srid pa'i chu bo las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas la dad pa mi phyed pas sems can rnams theg pa chen pos sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /chos la dad pa mi phyed pas sems can rnams rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pas sems can rnams nyan 67—257

thos kyispyitheg pas sgrol bar byed pa'o/(gye /'phags pa yid du 'ong ba'i tshul khrims kyis lta bar song ba thams cad spong ba la ston par byed pa'o/ /sbyin pas sems can rnams che'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /ngag snyan⑧pas lta ba'i rgya byamatsho las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /don bya bas sems can rnams nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /don 'thun pas 0sems can rnams shes rab kyi pha rol du sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis ④gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la bka' stsal du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya〈thub pa de la blta7ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i phyir bdag cag nye bar mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi dpal des yang rigs kyi bu gang gi dus la dbabarwa )par shes na zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de nas rigs kyi bu ye shes dpal dang / bza' shing gi ra ba'i〈medapal de gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cu lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyi dpal de la drang srong gi cha byad5)kyis rkang pa gnyis la〈pespyi bos phyag 'tshal nas g.yas phyogs nas snyibaskor ba byas te 'khod do/ /skad cig ma gcigalatsam gyis mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das drang srong shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal te 'khod par gyur to/ /de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs med pa rnams drang srong gi cha byad kyis shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi ⑩zhing rnam par dag pa dang / rnam par ma dag pa tshad med grangs med pa 'dir skad cig ma gcig gis lhags so/ /de bzhin du lho tunyephyogs kyi sangs 67—258

rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing chu bo gang gā'i bye ma snyed las shin tu 'das te/ de na ri rab kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ 'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de natubyang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' glog gi mchog ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis drang srong gi cha byadasnyedang / lus dang / gzugasaladang ske/ dbyibs kyis bdag mthong ngo / /sngon ma byung ba'i thub pa chen po gzhan yang drang srong gi cha byad kyis mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab chen po de la yongs su zhus pa de bzhin du ji lta bur gong du bshad pa nas de bzhin du nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di las shin tu 'das pa'i bar du ste/ de na 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa dpal snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te ④'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /de na 0byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don yod par mthong ba dang / ku mu da'i glang po zhes bya ba gnyis kyang ji ltar gong du bshad pa nas/ byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing chu bo gang gā gsum gyi bye ma snyed las shin tu 'das pa'i bar du ste/ de na rgyan gcig ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa rgyan po che zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /de natswabyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdul dang bral ba'i 'od dang / tshangs pa'i 'od ces bya ba gnyis kyang ji ltar gong du bshad pa nas/ 'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing chu bo gang gā gcig gi bye ma las shin tu 'das pa'i bar du ste/ de na me 67—259

tog chen po zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpal chen po zhes bya ba gnyis kyang ji ltar gong du bshad pa nas/ yang steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing chu bo gang gā bdun gyi bye ma snyed nas shin tu 'das pa'i bar du ste/ de na 'od snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho skyong ba chos kyang ston to/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyangasatudang / bdud rtsi dbyangs zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyang ji snyedasnyegong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' drang srong gi cha byad 'dzin pas mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhuzhing thams cad dang ldan pa 'di ⑤kun tu rgyas nas/de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong chen po7shākya thub pa gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas 'khod do/ /mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sems can gang la la theg pa chen po la yang dag par ma zhugs pa ni drang srong gi cha byad kyis ma gyur pa'o/ /rgyan de dag la nyan thos sam/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pas kyang7mi mthong na/ sems can gzhan gyis7mthong bar mi 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das drang srong chen po gdan de las bzhengs te/ thub pa dbang po'i 'gros dang / tshangs pa dbang po'i 'gros dang / tshangs pa drang srong gi 'gros dang / gnya' shing du lta ba'i 'gros dang / nye bar zhi ba'i 67—260

'gros dang / rab tu zhi ba'inye'agros dang / dge slong rnams mos pa chen po'i 'gros dang / lha dga' ba'i 'gros dang / gnod sbyin dul ba'i 'gros dang / lha ma yin dga' bar byed pa'i 'gros dang / klu dul ②ba'i 'gros dang / rgyal ba nyon mongs pa med pa'i 'gros dang / rnam par grolasaba'i 'gros ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i 'gros su bzhud cing sangs rgyas chen por rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'gros dang / rgyan chen po'i 'gros dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs0chen po'i 'gros su bcom ldan 'das spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la me tog gi ze ba la zhabs 'degs pa dang 'dor bas bzhud nas spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la byon to/ /dka' thub kyi gnas gtsang ma dri tha dad pa med cing dri ma med pa'i phyogs su 'gro sel gyi lha mo chen mo 'od 'dres pa zhes bya bshegang na ba de na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs te/ glang po'i rnam par ltasnyiba'i tshul gyis rnam par bltasalgepar gyur pa de'i dus na yang 'di brjod do/ /la la gang 'dir bstan dang ldan pa la/ /byang chub dam pa mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ /bdag gis yang dag spyad pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /de dag thams cad bdag gi mdun du 'ongs7/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs spangs med gang / /da dung du yang 'khor ba'i bde 'dod cing / /chos la bdag med rab tu mi shes pa/ /bdag ni de dag thams cad 'ong na ston/ /kun tu sbyor ba spangs med gang dag dang / /sgyu ma'i phung ltar shin tu sngonatshwanyemathong zhing / /thabs la mkhas par yang ni mi shes pa/ /de dag thams cad 'ong na bdag ston to/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa bsod nams mdzod mngacapo/ /thabs la mkhas pas7sems can rnams 'dul zhing / /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog rtag spyod7pa/ /bzod 67—261

nyan thos phyir de dag thams cad 'ong / /gang gis sangs rgyas du ma sngon bsnyenatubakur / /'dus byas thams cad 'di la rten⑧pa med/ /chu zla lta bur rab tu su ston pa/ /rang bzhin rnam par 'jug pa 'dir yang 'ong / /gang rnams thabs dang yang dag sbyor phyir zhugs/ /thams cad dngos la sems pa ①rten med cing / /mtshan ma spangs la rtog par 'gyur med pa/ /dran par byed pa dag ni 'dir yang 'ong / /bdagashegis bzod pa mchog 'di rab bstan nas/ /ji bltar sdug bsngal kun la mi yiganas pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo la yang khyod myur 'jug /srid mtshoshelas kyang sems can rab thar byed/ /phyogs bcur thub pa'i dbang po gang dag kyang / /'gro ba rnams la phan phyir 'khor lo skor(she/ /da dung theg pa'i dam tshig gang 'dod pa/ /bdag gi gan du byang chub sems dpa' mthong / /lan gnyis su yangashe'akhor lo bdag skor te/ /phyir mi ldog la sems can bye0tshebakod pa/ /rnam par grol ba'i blo mtshan rab thogs shing / /bdag bdag zhing rnams su yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'dir 'ongs pa gang dag kyang / /byang chub mchog gi spyod phyir bzod pa bstan/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa can mthong ste/ /de bas mu stegs gzhan kun 'dir 'dul lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor de yang de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi yi ge dang / don dang / tshig brjod pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mu med par song ngo therte/ /de na sems can gang la la theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa de thams cad nyan cing de phyogs bcur yang lta bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gis blta ba'i sems can de sems can gang gi dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor de ltar yid 67—262

du 'ong ba de ltar dga'apheb/ de ltar mngon par dga' ba/ de ltar zab cing sems can gyi dbugs 'byin pa/ de ltar tshim pa/ de ltar 'khor ba'i pha rol tu 'gro ba/ don⑧dang tshigasadang / yi ge brjod pa'i⑧dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin du smra bar bya ba ji lta ba der de phyogs bzhi kun tu bltas te/sangs rgyas kyi mthus spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i ri la drang srong thub pa dbang po zhi zhing thugs zhi ba/ dul ba dang / zhi ba'i mchog thob pa/ gser gyi phung po ji ltar 'bar ba la drang srong bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang pos mngon sum du phyag 'tshal te/ ha cang yang mi ring bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ drang srong 'di ni mthu chen po drang srong gi 'khor chen po 'di ni snying rje chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ba zhig snyam ste/ gal te snying rje dang ldan par 'gyur ba de'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /drang srong gi cha byad dang /lus dang / dbyibs kyis bdag gikelus su gyur pa de dgalamathong nas/ de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag kyang drang srong du gyur na/ drang srong chen po de la bsnyen bkurasheb dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o/ /de dag kyang sems bskyed ma thag pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med ⑧pa las drang srong gi cha byad tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab/mtshungs pa med cing dpag tu med pa/ chu bo gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir mngon par lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshogs sna tshogs kyi shedrang srong thub pa la mchod pa byas nas/ drang srong thub pa gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal nas bstod de 'khod do/ /la la smon lam gyi dbang dang / la la nganas67—263

du spyod pa'i rkyen gyis gang yang ngan song du skyes pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi mthus dran pa so sor thob nas drang srong gi cha byad kyis kun tu 'khod do/ /drang srong chen po thub pa'i dbang po gang na ba de logs su yang thal mo sbyar te 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya thub pa bzhugs shing ji lta bur 'khor yang dag par 'ongs pashel yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa 'di gang na ston par 'gyur/ de nas de nyid kyi tshe na shar phyogs kyi nam mkha'i lam las khang pa brtsegs pa blta na sdug pa/rin po che sna bdun gyis gang ba sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ dper na brgya byin lha'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa lta bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu lhags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po khang pa brtsegs pa de mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis khang palabartsegs pa 'di lta ste/ dper na tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po'i khang pa brtsegs pa dbyangs zhi ba 'di 'dra bar sprul te/ drang srong thub pa gang na bzhugs pa der bdag bzod pa 'di bstan snyam pa dang / de nyid kyi tshe na lho phyogs nas zhunam mkha'i lam las khang pa brtsegs pa blta na sdug pa/rin po che sna bdun gyis gang ba sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ dper na tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po'i khang pa brtsegs pa dbyangs zhi ba lta bu dubye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu lhags pa mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis 'di lta ste dper na tshangs pa chen po glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa de 'dra 67—264

bar mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das de na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam pa dang / de nas de nyid kyi tshe na nub phyogs nas nam mkha'i lam las 'di lta ste / dper na tshangs pa glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs7pa blta na sdug pa rin po che sna bdun gyis gang ba sna tshogs khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu lhags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po 'di snyam du sems te bdag gis khang pa brtsegs pa 'di lta ste/ dper na tshangs pa ri rab kyi 'od ces bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa de 'dra ba mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das de na bzhugs shing chos ston to snyam pa dngasnye/ de nas de nyid kyi tshe na byang phyogs nas nam mkha'i lam las khang pa brtsegs pa blta na sdug pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis gang ba sna tshogs 'di lta ste/dper na tshangs pa chen posheri rab kyi 'od ces bya ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dor ba med pa dang ldan pa khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu lhags so/ /de nas yang de'i tshe na khang pa brtsegs pa khrag khrig brgya stong du ma nam mkha' la 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'di snyam du sems te/ khang pa brtsegs pa de dag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi don gyi phyir seng ge'i khri dul rnam par bltas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi don gyi phyir seng ge'i khri bshams pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gang zhig snyam stetsho/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid dri ma med pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dag gang du lhags/ su yi ༅byin gyis brlabasal/byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid dudri ma med pas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de bas na chos kyi sgos chags pa thams cad rgyun 67—265

bcad pa'i phyir da dung mi sgrub kyi/ 'di gnyis kyisatu'akhor ba 'khyil pa'i sgrub pa'ol/ /rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis ni 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'o/ /'di gnyis ni 'byung ba dang 'jig pa zhes bya ste/ gang mi skye mi 'byung ba dekhu'agro ba dang 'ong ba'i 'du shes kyang med do/ /de 'jig pa thams cad spangs nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /'khor ba'i rgyun gcodasapa 'di ni gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo'o/ /gang 'gro ba dang 'ong ba zhes bya ba 'di gnyis ni 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu gangasnyibadag tu sgro 'dogs pa med pa dang / srog dang ske/ gso ba dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes pa dang / shed can dang ske/ 'gro ba dang / 'ong ba'i 'du shes su 'jug pa med pa/ du'adi ni gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang skyes pa'am/ma skyes par rtog ⑥pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang 'byung ba dang / 'gog par rnam par mi rtog cing 'gro ba dang 'ong bar dmigs pa med pa dang / tha dad par bya ba med pa dang / 'gyur ba med pa dang / rnam par byang ba 'di ni rigs kyi bu gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa dang /rnam par byang ba dang phung po skye ba dang / 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid 'di ni gnyis pa'i / /gang phung po yongs su shes shing skye ⑦ba dang / 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa rlom sems thams cad bcom pa/ gzugs kyi 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'di ni gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /'gul〈ba dang /rlom zhing sems par rig pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang tshor ba'i 'gul ba med cing rlom sems med pa/ g.yo ba med cing yid la mi byed pa 'di ni gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang tshor bar khyashes pa dang /67—266

tshor ba kun 'byung bar shes pa dang / tshor ba'i 'gog par shes pa dang /tshor ba 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam du shes pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang yang tshor ba kun 'byung bar ①'gog par 'gro bar ②mi shes pa dang /gzugs kyi phung po dang / tshor ba'i phung po'i mtshan nyid tha dad par mi shes pa dang ske/ mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / mtshan nyid tha dad pa dang /① mtshan nyid gcig pa dang / mtshan nyid mang por mi shes pa 'di yang rigs kyi bu gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /yang rigs kyi bu gang phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la nyan thos dang /rang byang chub 'dod pa dang / bla na med pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dod pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyisatheg pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / phung po dang ske/ khams dang / skye mched la brten⑧par mi shes pa dang / yi ge'i tshig gi lam thams cad ni gnas med pa/ yi ge med pa/ spros pa med par rab tu shes pa 'di yang rigs kyi bu gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o⑨/ /rigs kyi bu gang dge ba dang / mi dge bar 'du shes kun tu shes pa dang /pha rol dang tshu rol tu 'du shes pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang dge bsami dge ba 'di yang mtshan ma med pa kun nas ldang ba dang / mi zad pa kun tu rtog pa 'di yang rigs kyi bu gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug ⑨pa'o / /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang tshu rol ni zag pa'o/ /pha rol ni phyin ci log ste gang tshu rol dang pha rol la rtog pa dang / 'dzin pa dang bkrol ba 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang yang tshu rol dang pha rol la 'dzin pa med pa dang / bkrol 67—267

ba med pa dang / ci la7yang btags ②pa med pa dang / btangakhub med pa 'di ni gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang gang phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la zag pa dang bcas pa'am/zag pa med pa'am gezhes rtog pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang yang khams dang /skye mched la zag pa dang bcas pa zhes rtogasagepa med pa dang / zag pa med pa'i 'du shes su bya ba'ang med pa dang / 'du shes dang7'du shes med min thob pa'ang med pa 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas su rtog pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang yang 'du byed skye mched thams cad la mi rtog cing rnam par mi rtog pa dang / chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam par yang dag par rjes su mthong ba 'di yang rigs kyi bu gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang yang 'jig rten pa dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos la snyems ⑧pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang la la 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos la mi 'jug mi 'gro/rnam par mi 'gro/ mi rgal zhing 'gro ba yang med/ rnam par 'gro7ba med pa 'di'ang gnyis su med pa'i chos la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang gang la la ming dang gzugs las phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched 'byung bar rab tu shes pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / ming dang gzugs bral ba la sgyu (7ma'i rang bzhin gyi lta ba kun tu 'gro zhing kun tu mi 'gro/ yongs su mya7ngan las mtshwanye'adas pa 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs7kyi bu 67—268

gzhan yang gang rnam par shes pa 'byung bar rab tu shes pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang yang 'byung ba med pa skad cig ma dang skad cig ma ma yin pa la 'dus byas thams cad du myur du rab tu shes pa 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i chos kyishesgo la 'jug pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bdag gir bya ba dang / rnam par shes par yongs su shes pa dang / nga yir bya ba dang / skye mched la chags pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gang la la bdag dang bral ba'i rnam par shes pa thob pa bdag gi rang bzhin lta ba gnyis dang bral ba/ skye mched nyams pa med pa/ bdag gir bya ba dang / nga yir bya ba dang bral ba 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /gang la la rig pa dang / rnam par grol bar rtog⑧pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu ma rig pa ni rgyu ba med cing bdag med pa'o/ /④rig pa ni glog gi rang bzhin can no/ /rnam par grol ba yang nam mkha'o/ /nam mkha' yang mi rtog pa/ rtog par byed pa med pa/ spros pa med pa 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /gang rnam par shes pa dang /gzugs kun tu spyod pa 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ /gzugs nyid kyang nam mkha' bzhin du stong ste/ nam mkha' yang 'jig pa med do/ /gzugs 'jig pa stong pa nyid gzugs kyi mtshan nyid rab tu rgyu ba stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yang stong pa nyid do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed kyang de bzhin no/ /rnam par shes pa rab tu rgyu ba med pa ni nam mkha' ji lta bur mun pa med cing snang ba med pa rnam par shes pa'ang de bzhin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'jig pashestong pa ma yin te/ rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyang stong pa'o/ /de bzhin du nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga yang nam mkha'i rang bzhin ltar stong ngo / /67—269

nam mkha' ji lta bur skye'adod chags med/ zhe sdang med/ gti mug med/ mi mtho mi dma'/ mi rtog rnam par mi rtog /mi 'gro rnam par mi 'groge /de ltar sems pa'i ②byang chub sems dpa' ni chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la yang 'dod chags med/ zhe sdang med/ gti mug med/ mi mtho mi dma'/ mi rtog rnam par mi rtog /mi 'gro rnam par mi 'gro zhing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ske/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mi rtog④rnam par mi rtog5)/ mi 'gro rnam par mi 'gro ba 'di ni rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i 6riganyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid dri ma med pas 'di bstan pa stonas pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag nadagu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis mi skye ba'i chos kyi ⑨bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag bzhi bcu rtsa drug gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sgo la 'jug pa thob par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang sgron ma dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drang srong gi cha byad ji tsam pa mi snang bar gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan rab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sku yang dag par brgyan te bzhugs so/ /de ltar de bzhin du gang gzhan la la dag kyang drang srong gi cha byad mi snang the )bar gyur te/sngon gyi lus ji lta ba bzhin du 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid dri ma med pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ji lta bur bstan pa de bzhin du gnyis su med pa'i sgo 'di (1 bstan par bya ba legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ni chos kyi sgo 'di la 67—270

lus dpang du btsugs7te/ de ltar khyod kyis tshad med pa'i sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod do/ /gzhan yang lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa sna tshogs byas so// //bam po gsum pa/ de nas de'i tshe na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na bsnyede logs su thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshalasnyenas bcom ldan 'das la chos bstan du gsol ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i yon tan 'di dag gis bstod do/ /rgyal ba mi mnyam zhing mngasasredag khyab pa/ /nyon mongs dgra zhi 'di la mngon par gnas / /thub pa shin tu rnam grol 'dir zhugs shing / /khyod kyis5ge'agro la bzod pa'i mchog 'di stonayi/ /rab tu zhi thugs brtul zhugs yongs su dag /thub pa0mchod sbyin bgyis pa bzod dge gsungs/ /'gro la bde sbyin drang srong shes rab 'chang / /gti mug 'jig mdzad 'di la bdud rtsi char(8)/ /'di la lha klu sems can mi mang po/ /shin tu gsal yid myur du zhing gang ba/ /'gro ba thams cad khyod zhal lta zhing 'dug /nyon mongs yongs su spangs te dam chos gsungasal / /sngon chad rgyal ba khyod kyang kun spyod bstan/ /mig gnyis rkang pa lag pa lce byin zhing / /pags 8pa mgo khrag yan lag dam hu)'bru nor/ /glang rta bu5)grong shingarwanyerta rin chen rnam mang byin/ /zas skom mal dang bran pho hu9bran mo byinasnyi/ /gnyen dang 'gro la sdug bsngal rtag thar byed/ /bsam pa rdzogs shing sems can dga' mdzad pa/ /khyod kyis mchod sbyin brgya byas sems 67—271

can phyir/ /sangs rgyas mang la sngon7chad dge mchod byas/ /byams sems rtag pas ther zug sbyin la dga'/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas7ri rab ji bzhin 'bar / /'gro la brtan phyir bzod pa 'di bstan gsol/ /ngan song gsum spangs sems can mtho ris khrid/ /khyod kyis bstan⑧pa'i smon lam sngon rtag byas / /'gro ba byang chub sdug bsngal zhi mchog rig④ /rgyal ba sngon chad cisabazhin byang chub de thob bo/ /snying rje dpal chus sa rnams ma lus gang / /nyon mongs dri gsum the tsom9)thams cad zhi/ /lam gang zhi bas byang chub thob ston pa/ /ji ltar chos rtogs 'di la khyod kyis dus/ /shin tu skom yid 'gro la chos char phob/ /bdud rtsi'i ros7ngoms yang dag yon tan gsungs/ /lam gang zhi des 'gro ba byang chub reg⑨ /zhing mangs 'di la sems can gang dag 'ongs / /rga shi dag las rnam thar gang yod pa/ /thub pa chen po chos 'di gsung du gsol/ /nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa ston/ /de ni sgyu ma mig rgyu spros par 'gro/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas zhal gyis bzhes nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag rnam pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs〈nyanas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa gang gis khang pa brtsegs pa ji snyed pa de snyed du lus mngon par sprul nas khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad na 'dug ste/ 'khor 'di dag kyang yang dag par dga' zhing skyo bar bya'o snyam pa dang ske/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od shin tu rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i thugs kyis khang pa brtsegs pa ji snyed pa de snyed du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rang rang zhugasalge67—272

te bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ngo mtshar dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' dgra rnam par 'grel pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khang pa brtsegs pa tshad med pa 'di dag ni gang na rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa bdag khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs pa ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis ①khang pa brtsegs par sangs rgyas kyi skuphubazhugs par yang dag par mthong bsheni gang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' dgra rnam par 'grel pas byang chub sems dpa' ngo mtshar dang ldan pa la 'di skad ces smras so//rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i tshig 'di ni smra ba med pa'o/ /ma rig pa yang sangs rgyas kyi chos la sprosalgepa med do/ /rigs kyi bu ci 'das pa'i sems kyis byang chub thob bam/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu ma yin no/ /smras pa/ci ma 'ongs pa'i sems kyis byang chub thob bam/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu ma yin no/ /smras pa/ ci da ltar byung ba'i sems dang / bsam pa'i gnas pa yod dam/du smras pa/ rigs kyi bu med do/ /smras pa/ gal te re zhigashesems dang / bsam pa'i gnas pa med na rnam par mi gnas pa'i dngos po la ji ltar byang chub thobadu/ smras pa/ rigs7kyi bu ci dus gsum gyi chos thams cad spangs pasatso/ de'i tshe cis kyang chos khong du chud pa med dam/ smras pa/rtag pa dang chad pa yongs su spangs pa/ mi 'gro ba/ mi skye ba/ mi 'gog pa/mi reg pa/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas la gnas pa med pa'o/ /dngos po thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la byang chub 'gro ba med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba med cing snyems〈nyepa med pa de bzhin du byang chub kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /67—273

da ltar byung ba med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la rtog pa med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang rtog pa med cing rnam par rtog pa'ang med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la mun pa med cing snang ba med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang mun pa med cing snang ba'ang med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la gzugs med cing bstan du med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang gzugs med cing bstan du yang med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' ma skyes77ma 'gags pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang ma skyesalgem 'gags so/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la 'gro ba med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang 'gro bar dmigs pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la gnas pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang gnas pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la reg pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang reg pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' lamakhulam du dmigs pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang ci la'ang lam du dmigs pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la dngos po med cing mtshan nyid med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang dngos po ④med cing mtshan nyid med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la brjod du med cing yi ge med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang brjod du med cing yi ge med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la rtag pa med cing chad pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang rtag pa med cingasachad pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la lus yimed cing 'byung ba med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang lus gemed cing 'bye'abyung ba med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la gzung bas37med cing gnas pa med pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang 67—274

gzung ba med cing gnas pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' la rten0)pa med pa/gnas pa med pa/ dmigs pa med pa/ rnam par rtog pa med pa/ 'deg pa med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa/ 'gro ba med pa/ 'ong ba med pa/ rtsa ba med pa/ mtha' med pa/ 'khrug pa med pa/ yongs su gdungs pashemed pa/brtags pa med pa/ bkrol zhub med pa/ mthong ba med pa/ rtogasnyipa med pa/mun pa med pa/ dngos po med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ sprul pa med pa de bzhin du rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang rten pa med pa nas mtshan ma med pa'i bar du'o/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni mi skye bar bsgrags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni gnyis su med pa'i cha shas so/ /chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni sems can gyi khams su yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni nam mkha'i khams su yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni rtogasapo)pa dang kun tu rtog pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni gnasasredang / rnam pa'i gnas dang / rab kyi gnas su yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni shes pa dang mi shes pa dang zha rab tu shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa dang / nye bar7shes pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni mtshan ma med pa yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rnam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / nye ba'i mtshan nyid dang ske/ rjes su mtshan nyid la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni 'das pa med pa dang / rnam par 'das pa dang / 'das pa dang /rjes su 'das pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni 67—275

blangs btudang / dor ba dang / kun tu blang ba dang / nye bar blang ba la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni snang ba dang / kun tu snang ba dang / rjes su snang ba dang / yang dag par snang ba med pa dang /rab tu snang ba med pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni yang dag pa dang / shin tu yang dag pa dang / rjes su yang dag pa dang /kun tu yang dag pa ma yin pa dang / rab tu yang dag pa ma yin pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni kun tu smra ba dang / rnam par smra ba dang / shin tu smra ba dang / rjes su smra ba dang / rab tu smra ba dang /nye bar smra ba la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni kun tu rig pa dang / rnam par rig pa dang mtshungs par rig pa dang7rjes su rig pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni kun tu gzugs dang ske/ rnam par gzugs dang / mtshungs par gzugs dang / yang dag par gzugasasnyedang / nye ba'iphugazugs la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ni kun tu spyod pa dang / rnam par spyod pa dang /mtshungs par spyod pa dang / rjes su spyod pa dang / nye bar spyod pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub ni kun tu brjod pa dang / rnam par brjod pa dang / rjes su brjod pa dang / mtshungs par brjod pa dang /nye bar brjod pa la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /rigs0kyi bu byang chub ni bgrang ba dang / rnam par bgrang ba dang / mtshungs par bgrangasreb dang /rjes su bgrang ba dang / nye bar bgrang ba la yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ /byang chub ni kun tu yod pa dang / rnam par yod pa dang / rjes su yod pa 67—276
