'gyur ro/ /sngon de bzhin gshegs pas bstan0)pas sems can dmyal ba'i sgo bcad ces thos te/ gang gis du mdo sde 'di las tshig gcig bton na lha rnams kyangasherab tu dga' ba dang tshim pa skyes te/ rtag tu bsnyen bkur bgyid cing rang bzhin gyis dge ba spyod do/ /gang la las thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyasakyipa'i mdo 'di thos te/ dga' ba skyes nas dad pa dang gus pa'i sems kyis yi ger 'bri 3)'am/ yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ klog gam/ kha ton tu byas sam / blangs sam/ 'chang ngam/ phyag 'tshal zhing chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i nang gi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig gam/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming gcig brjod na gang zag de ni tshe 'di nyid la bde ba thob ste/ sdig pa rnams mi mthong zhing tshe zad de 'chi mu'aphos na yang byang chub sems dpa' bdag cag rnams kyis sngon du lam drangs te/ bdag cag gi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag par gnas gcig tu skye bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ mdo sde 'di blangs pa dang ske/ gzungs su 'dzin pa'i slad du'o/ /mdo sde 'di blangs te/ gzungs su 'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dzin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems dpa' lags 'a par mngon te/ de bas na de dag ni bdag cag dang bslab pa gcig go/ /rgyu dang rkyen des na mdo sde 'di gzungs su 'dzin pa rnams gnas gcig tu skye zhing mi 'bral bar smon to/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang /nye dga' bo dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dbyangs 37can 67—562

dang ske/ 'phrog ma mo dang / ri'i lha dang / shing gi lha dang / klung gi lha dang /mtsho'i lha dang / sa'i lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha la sogs pa grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rang rang gi stan las langs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar cing gus pas hu)phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 40bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa'i mdo sde thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'di la rtag tu bsrung zhing 'dzin par bgyi'o/ /mdo sde 'di gang du gnas pa der bdag cag gis rtag tu mdun du bdar te yongs su dag par bgyi'o/ /mdo sde 'di mchod rten du'am gnas khang du'am/ khyim pa'i khyim du'am/dgon pa na gnas kyang rung ste/ gal te gang zag 'ga' zhig gis sug pa mi gtsang bas mdo sde 'di bzung ngam/ ma gus par bklags gesam/ kha ton du bgyis na bdag cag gis gang zag gde 'gro sdod 'dug nyal spyod lam rnam bzhir lus dang sems mi bde bar bgyi'o/ /de 5tshogang du gnas pa der 'jigs shing skrag pa dang / glopo)bur du gnod pa 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /tshe 'di la mi bde ba sna tshogs dang / tshe 'phos na yang sems can dmyal bar ltung bar bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig gis mdo sde 'di la gus par bgyis te/ sug pa gtsang mas blangs shing 'chang ngam/ khrus bgyis te bdug spos kyis bdug cing bklagasashesam / kha ton du bgyis sam/ 'chang ngam 'dzin tam/ yi ger 'dri57'am/yi ger 'drirashe'ajug gam/ rjes su dran nam sdig pa'i chos rnams ma spyad na bdag cag gis mdo sde 'di bsrung ba'i slad du gang zag de'i rim gro bgyi'o/ /bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /gang zag de nyal na yang de'i mdun du mchis te/ ltas 67—563

ngan pa rnams mi 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /yang gcig tu na dgra ma rungs pa dang ske/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi gnod pas mi tshugs par bgyi'o/ /de gang du gnas pa'i khang khyim yang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /de ste 'gron du mchinyen bdag cag rnams kyis rtag tu phyi nakhu'abrang zhing ci 'tshal ba sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bzhir gang du mchi na yang bgegs ma mchis par rgyun tu dge ba'i chos mthong zhing tshe 'phos na yang lhar skye bar bgyi'o/ /rgyu de dang rkyen des ni sangs rgyas mthong zhing theg pa chen po mi stong du )bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang /lha dang / lha ma yin gyi bdag po la sogs pa la bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin nom/ /de de bzhin te/ khyed rnams kyis bshad pa bzhin te/ mdo sde 'di thos par yang mi 'gyur na mthong bar lta ga la 'gyur/ gal te mdo sde 'di blangs te bzung ngam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gas/ kha ton ⑤du byed par 'dod na khrus dag par byas la gos gtsang ma bgos te/ khang pa dben pa gtsang ma'i nang du ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs kyis brgyan nas bdug pa sna tshogs dang / tsan dan dang / phye ma dang / byug pas mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas de ltar nyin mtshan dus drug tu thog mar mgo btsugs stinas nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du nyin ⑧ro re zhing mdo sde 'di bklags 0te/ sems mi g.yeng ba dang / dran pa mi g.yeng ba dang / rtog pa mi g.yeng ba dang /bsam pa mi g.yeng ba dang / gzungs su 'dzin pa mi g.yeng ba dang / spyod pa mi g.yeng ba dang / bstan cing bslab pa mi g.yeng bar nyin mtshan dus drug tu mdo sde 'di'i nang nas 'byung 7ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' 67—564

dang ske/ mdo sde bcu gnyis rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing klog0)pa'am/ kha ton tu 'don cing mos pa dang gus par byed nus na mdo sde 'di'i nang nas 'byung ba bzhin du ②sdig lci ba kun 'byang chabar 'gyur gyisabya/ de la the tsom mam bhuyid gnyis su ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'di ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi spyad pa spyod pa'o/ /'di ni bsrungakyizhing skyob pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum mo/ /'di ni mdo sde kun gyi rgyal po'o/ /'di ni don dam pa'i snying po'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam mo/ /thar pa chen posko7phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde zab mo 'di ni 'jig rten na chen po drug dang 'dra ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /drug posnyigang zhe na/ sa chen po dang / chu chen po dang / me chen po dang / rlung chen po dang / nyi mashechen po dang / nam mkha' chen po'o⑩/ /mdo sde 'di ni sa chen po dang 'dra ste/ gtsang sme 37dang / bzang ngan thams cad theg par byed do/ /mdo sde 'di ni 32chu chen po dang 'dra ste/ sme btsogarwa thams cad 'khru bar byed do/ /mdo sde 'di ni 8me chen po dang 'dra ste/ nyon mongs pa dang ske/ btsogarwanyepa dang / ljan ljin 8thams cad tshig par byed do/ /mdo sde 'di ni rlung chen po dang 'dra ste/ sme btsogatshwa thams cad bus tho par byed do/ /mdo sde 'di ni0nyi ma chen po dang 'dra ste/ mun nag yod do cog snang bar byed do / /mdo sde 'di nimanyanam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ bzang ngan yod do cog thams cad shong bar byed do/ /de lta bu'i theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'di rgya che ba ni dpe zla med de/ yar byang chub sems dpa' dang ske/ bar du nyan thos dang / mar 'jigasho rtetshogs kyi gzugs can no cog mi 67wa 565

shong ba med do/ /de bas na khyed rnams kyis mdo sde 'di gzungs su bzung ste/chongs shig /kun tu spel bar gyis shig /dad cing gus par byos shig dang /khyed byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams nyasangs rgyas kyi ye shes khong du7chud pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid mngon du mthong bar bya'o/ /khyed lha rnams kyang mdo sde 'di blangs te/ 'chang na rgyun du nga yang mthong la/ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang ske/ dkyil 'khor chen po la zhugs par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de nas 'khor mang po'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad cesakhubya ba de 'khor 'dus pa'i nang nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams gsol zhing zhu ba zhig nomachis na ⑤dpag tu ma mchis pa'i skye bo la sman pa dang /bde ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyisapo)skabs dbye zhing bshad par smon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dadakyil bka' stsal pa/ shin tu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu dri ba yod na ci 'dod pa bzhin snodris shig dang / ngas khyod la bye brag phyed par bshad do/ /khyod kyis dris pa de yang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag dran pa sngon yun ring po57'das pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa tsomatshan rin chen gtsug phud ces bgyi ba de'i mtshan lan cig thos na lhar skye ba thob bo zhes thos te/ de las yun mi ring ba zhig na rgyal po 67—566

lha'i dbang phyug 'od kyi yul khams na dgon pa'i nang zhig la rdzing chen po zhig mchis pa'i chab skams ①nas de na nya chen po stong phrag bcu zhig mchis pa gdugs kyis gdungs te 'gumaladu nye ba las/ drasdo /ma chu 'bebs zhes bgyi bas nya de dag mthong nas sems can la shin tu byams pa dang / snying rje skyes te/chab dang kha zas stsal kyang dgung 'ga' tsam zhig ni gson grangasnyin/ tshe ring por mi thogs par 'tshal ⑤bas bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug phud ⑥kyi mtshan lan gsum brjod pa 975nya de dag gis thos ma thag tu dus las 'das te/sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar laskyes so zhes gda' na deng bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di dag dngashe/ dus slad ma'i sems can rnams kyi slad du sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan bstan cing bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan thos na tshad ma mchis dpag tu ma mchis pa'i skye bo la sman pa dang bde ba dang / dpag tu ma mchis pa'i bsod nams dang / rtag tu longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid kyang mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ sdom pa'i rtsa ba nyams pa dang / nyon mongs pas 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams yongs su grol bar 'gyur ba'i slad du bshad par smon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshan nyid dad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gal te ngas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rgya cher bshad na bskal pa brgya stong khri'i bar du bshad kyang mi rdzogs te/ 'di ltar chu thams cad kyi thigs57pa ni bgrang zhing shes par rung gi〈nyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan ni grangs su shes pa med do/ /ri rab thams cad ni srang grangs su bgrang du rung gi sangs rgyas thams 67—567

cad kyi mtshan ni grangs su shes pa med do/ /nam mkha'i mtshams dang mtha' thug par shes par rung gi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan ni grangs su shes pa med do/ /ngas khyod la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan mdo tsam zhig bstan gyis gang gis rna bar lan gcig thos na gang zag de tshe 'phos ma thag tu lha'i gnas su skye b.ramanya 'gyur ro/ /thos nas kyang mos pa dang gus par byas te④ / yi ger bris la mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal na bskal pa grangs med pa nas 'khor ba'i sdig pa kun 'byang bar 'gyur/ bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang zag de dus zad na yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas gang du dad pa de dang der skye bar 'gyur/ nga yang mthong la dus ma 'ongs pa na bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang 'khor mang po rnamasashel bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams tshul bzhin du gos tshags bcos la/ lus mi g.yeng ba dang / sems mi g.yeng ba dang / dran pa⑥mi g.yeng ba dang /rtog pa mi g.yeng bar byos la chos thos par 'dod na sems rtse gcig tu bsdus dushig /bcom ldan 'das mar me ri rab rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug phudamathol phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad sdud cing 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /brjod dpag 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe zla med la phyag 'tshal lo /67—568

mu med chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam khyab dka' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs la gnas pa'i stobs kyi stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jig pa 0)med pa'i stobs bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad 'dren pa'i ston pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'ching ba kun gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rolasamathar phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun las 'das zin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rgyud dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnam par grol ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' ltar dmigs su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang po'i nang na chos kyi —rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud bzhi'i patshogs 'joms patsha3)la phyag 'tshal lo//bu gcig pa'i ༷pha ltar byams pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo tshe rabs 'chi 'phos gar 'byung ⑦gar skyes kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhal rtag tu mthong zhing sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid mngon par rtogs 8la mya ngan las 'das pa chen por phyin par gyur cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig tshogs can kun la sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid yod pa'i phyir ro/ /kye she'akhor mang po rnams sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyor la yang dag par mnyan cing sems thag pa nas mchod pa phul cig /ngas ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas mtshan rnams bshad kyis nyon/ /sdig pa mtshams med lnga po yang sku/ /rnam grol mtshan nyid bskyed par bya(1/ /dge rtsa med pa'i gang zag la/ /ngas ni dgrol tsho/rtezhing bshad kyis kyang / /des kyang chud par mi nus te/ /sa bon tshig rnams rang bzhin dong hurte/ /grung brtan 'ba' zhig gnas par 'gyur/ /theg pa chung ༄ngu bsal ponas su/ /theg chen nyi tshe yod par 'gyur/ /theg pa gnyis po bsal tshanas su/ /theg pa 67—569

gcig pu yod par 'gyur/ /dge rtsa med pa'i gang zag gis/ /sgra 'di thos par mi 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas grangs med mchod myong bas/ /gdod des sangs rgyas mtshan thos so/ /len cing 'dzin par byed pa ni/ /phyogs tsam rnam par grol ba ste/ /rnamashedag sa la bde bar gnas/ /da yang nga yikhuchos 'di la/ /sangs rgyas spyad pa kun spyad gede/ /sangs rgyas mtshan la phyag 'tshal zhing ske/ /mdo 'di blang zhing klog 'chang na/ /bdud kyi las dang bral bar 'gyur / /rtsa ba bzhi dang mtshams med dang / /log⑧spyod rnams kyi sdig kyang 'byang ske/ /ma 'ongs dus na gang zag de/ /'phags pa'i lam yang nges par 'grub / /gang zhig dad pa ma skyes na/ /ngan song gsum du ltung yang dag /dad skyes brtson 'grus phyag 'tshal na/ /tshad med sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur / /de bas rtse gcig phyag 'tshal zhing / /sdig pa dpag med byang bar smon / /de phyir gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'khor mang po rnams thal mo sbyar te/ yang dag par mnyan nas lus dang sems rtse gcig tu bsdus te/g.yel zhing 'gyur ba med par yan lag lnga sa la gtugs7te sems thag pa nas mnyan rmoto/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas brjod cing bsgrags pa las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas nyi zla mar me gsal nyi khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad sum57khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thogs med ye shes mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rgyal bu bcu drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nam mkha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo / /gshesangs rgyas sprin dbang mar me rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 67—570

byin sgra rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas dge bar bsamasatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sku sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla gsal gyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas pad ma dag pa rgyu skar rgyal po ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam dag brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas klu btsun rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprin⑧'brug sgra rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprin 'brug sgra rgyu skar rgyal po ye shes pad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shing sā5gel rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen bla ma dpal gzi brjid rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas 'od snang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od misnyigayo 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od rgyang ring la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spos tsan dan la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas ri legs rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ri rab lha'i thor tshugs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od snyoms ri rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zla gzugs pu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yang dag pa'i dran pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri ma bral la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas chags med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas klu'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas sa mi g.yoshel phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bai drur+ya'i ⑧me tog mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bai drur+ya7dang gser gyi kha dog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsosangs rgyas sa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo sangs 67—571

rgyas zla ba'i gzugs brnyan0)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rnam grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas blo rgya mtsho mngon par shes pa rgyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas dbyangs chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri ma sgyu ma dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yid skyo spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po chesnye'abar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtsug dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bar 'dzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab yon tan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla'i 'od sgrib la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla be+e dūr+ya'i bya'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bla med bai drur+ya'i ge'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rab mchog gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byang chub me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zla gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog mdog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas chu zla'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yisangs rgyas the tshom mun sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sdug bsngal bsgral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mos pa dang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sngon legs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bzhad sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas klu'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—572

sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༷sangs rgyas 'od mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od thogs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zla med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od 'bar rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i rtsa ba la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas rnam dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②sangs rgyas rab tu dga' ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od rgyun mi 'chadaphul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od bsam dka' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od brjod med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla'i 'od 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mtshan bzangasamagogaser btso ma'i mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ring du brtag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dbyangs dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zil dngar ⑤gyi ro la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas klu'i rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri ma dang bral ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpal mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jam dpal ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog bla med 46)la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas 'jigs med stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas klu rje dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i gzi brjid rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 67—573

'od khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu gtsang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spos ta ma ra ba ra tsan dan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas spos tsan dan 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①sangs rgyas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog brtsegs rab tu dga' ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus chen po bla na med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan mar me'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab sgron ma snang la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sra brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser 'od kun tu dgra ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus che btsan ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpa' brtulaphul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byams pa'i snying po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas tsan dan gyi phug rnam par bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bzang legs gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas legs par sad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi ri bo rin po che'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi me tog 'bar ba'i 'od kyi mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sgron chen 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i bla re ④stong pa nyid du brtags dupa'i stobs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi me tog gi 'od la phyagashe'atshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nam mkha'i rin chen me tog gi 'od la 67—574

phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bai drur+ya rnam ①par bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sku kun tu mngon par ston pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas ye shes 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bdud kyi rgyal po rnams〈tshar gcodasnyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od snang stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byams pa'i shes rab rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byams pa'i 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten dag pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dge dben zla ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mchog btsun ye shes7rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas gdugs rin po che'i rgyal por gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas klu'i rigs bla na med pa ye shes gtso bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas nyi zla'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla nor bu'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyi ba dan mchog tu brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyagasnye'atshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri med mdzod kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas 'od snang mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser 'bar ba'i 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser 'od snang ba'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas seng ge'i sgra'i stobs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / sangs rgyas mchog dbyangs dam pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ba dan 'od rtag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten rnam par rtog pa'i mar me'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ ldasangs rgyas shes rab kyi na bza'i rgyal po thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas chos kyi mtshan nyid dam pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lasangs rgyas ri rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me 67—575

tog su ma na'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog ud pa la'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas stobs btsanatudam pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab kyi stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rab tu dga'akhu'akhrug medashe'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs dpagashemed rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas blo gros 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi rgya mtsho'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab kyi ri dang rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug⑧rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thar pa chen po'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos thams cad rtag tu gang ba'ikhurgyal po lashephyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas blun mi ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas gcig /sangs rgyas bcu/ sangs rgyas brgya/ sangs rgyas stong /sangs rgyas khri la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med pa'i 'khor ba nas sdig bgyis pa'i mi bzad pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas 'bum phrag gcig /'bum phrag bcu/ 'bum phrag brgya/ 'bum phrag stong ne/ 'bum phrag khri/ bye ba khrag khrig gang gā'i bye ma snyed grangs med dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gal te gang zag la las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med dpag tu med pa'i mtshan thos na de bskal7pa khri phrag brgyad ④cu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung ste/de bas na gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis sangs rgyas 'das pa'i mtshan/ /de la gus par phyag 'tshal na/ /sems nyid thob cing sdig kyang 'byang / /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /phyin chad mi byed sdom par nus/ /dam pa'i 67—576

chos ni rtag tu thos/ /theg chen tshul khrims ldan pa ste/ /de phyir da7ltar phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rnam pa gnyis shig ma gtogs te/ /theg chen chos la dmodakupa dang / /log spyod phyogasashesu lta ba'o/ /gang zhig sems nyid rnam dag na/ /log spyod ces su mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas dpag med rtag tu mthong / /sdig pa'i rtsa ba bzhi po dang / /mtshams med lngarasrebacas gang byas pa/ /rnam dag sems kyis 'gyod nus na/ /de ni tshul bzhin gnas pa yin/ /de yang gus par phyag 'tshal phyir/ /mi dge bcu yi las 'byang zhing / /theg chen tshul khrims thob pasalgen/ /de bas gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan de dag bshad pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /nyan thos brgyad brgyas ni theg pa chen po'i sems shesanyetsam skyes so/ /dge slong lnga stong ni dgra bcom par grub po/ /lha dang mi khri phrag bcu zhig chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob bo/ /da7ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas gsal rgyal 'bum phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser btso ma'i phye dri ma bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas snang ba dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od snang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas spos brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng〈nyage 'bum gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng ge rnam par rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun tu 'od kyi ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bde gnas rin po che'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas rin po che'i me tog rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs 67—577

rgyas dka' thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ri rab mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas ri rab rgyal po thobatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dka' thub seng ge'i nga ro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas lding khang phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zla ba'i gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal po dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas gser thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nisangs rgyas 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'brug sgra'i⑧rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi 3)snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas tsan dan me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas tsan dan 'dab ma la7phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yid mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thub zla med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zil mngar rnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla'i 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thub med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par brgyan nidang ldan pa'ilo)rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer 67—578

kun tu khyab pa'i yon tan gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i seng ge'i sgra'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'jigs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas be+e drur+ya'i0)'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ri rab rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer gtsang ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dge dpal la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas 'od zer dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzungs rnam par rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lasangs rgyas dge mthong ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bla med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ma'i gzugs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzugs 'thor la phyag 'tshal lo / /dusangs rgyas dri mtshan med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bro mtshan med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas reg mtshan med la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang phyug lashephyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i gzugs kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu sdud la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas drin dpal kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs6)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshesangs rgyas yid sgra snyan sredasnyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rab tu dga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo//67—579

sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs ①pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ri rab mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng gesnyedabyangs la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas seng ge'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprin dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rtag tu zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dbang po'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ta ma ra bar tsan dan gyi spos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ri rab kyi gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprin dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi 'jigs pa thams cad bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa 'bum phrag brgya dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig /sangs rgyas bcu/ sangs rgyas brgya/sangs rgyas stong / sangs rgyas khri la gus par phyag 'tshal na bskal pa grangs med pa nas 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas 'bum phrag gcig /'bum phrag bcu/ 'bum phrag brgya/ 'bum phrag stong ske/ 'bum phrag khri/ bye ba khrag khrig gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed grangs med dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la las da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med dpag tu med pa'i mtshan thos na de ni bskal pa khri phrag drug cu'i bar du sems can dmyal bar mi ltung ste/ de bas 0gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ltar phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal na/ /las ngan kun las rnam par grol/ /mtshams med lnga po'i 67—580

sdig kyang 'byang / /rnam dag sa la rtag tu gnas/ /shākya'i chos la 'ang bde gnas shing / / mtha' rutungan song gsum dang bral/ /sangs rgyas byams pa'ang mthong ba dang / /sangs rgyas stong yang mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bas da ltar phyag kyang 'tshal/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yangasnyemathong ste/ /rnam dag zhing du rtag par skye/ /dam pa'i chos kyang thos gyur cing / /sangs rgyas rtag pa'ang mngon par rtogs/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan bshad pa'i tshe chu bo gang gā gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' ②gzungs kyi sgor chud par gyur to④/ /lha dang mi 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas ma byon pa dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam dag sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ming dang mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'dzam bu na da'i ⑤gser 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas khyab snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas shes rab ri dang rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che rnam par bkod pashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug thob pa'i rgyal po 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo /67—581

sangs rgyas rin po che'i mtshan nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mthong dga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyi mtshan mas rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyal po nyi khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mtshan 'thun pa nya)kun tu dpal sum khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'brug sgra'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur bzhi lakhri brgyad stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zla ba rin po che'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri ma dang bral ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzugs dam pa'i 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas sgra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par bkod pa stong phrag brgyad ri cu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par bkod pa 'bum phrag brgyad cu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i me tog rnam par brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mchog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser btso ma'i 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas lung bstan pa pad+ma'i 'od lnga brgya la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas mi 'jigs sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog bzang pos rnam par brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gcig /sangs rgyas bcu/ sangs rgyas brgya/ sangs rgyas stong / sangs rgyas khri la phyag 'tshal na/ bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med pa'i 'khor ba nas sdig lci ba rnams 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas 'bum phrag gcig /'bum phrag 67—582

bcu/ 'bum phrag brgya/ 'bum phrag stong / 'bum phrag khri bye ba khrag khrig gang gā'i bye ma snyed dpag tu med/ grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gang zag gang la las thos par gyur na bskal pa khri phrag bzhi bcu'i bar du sems can dmyal bar mi ltung ste/ de bas da0)ltar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas ma byon rnams/ /de la gus par phyag 'tshal na(mi/ /log spyod rnams ni ma gtogs te/ /sgrib pa gsum dang mtshams med lnga/ /sdig pa de rnams 'byang bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos la bde gnas shing / /dpag med sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos kyang rtag tu thos/ /de bas da ltar gus phyag 'tsha'akho/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu dus gsum gyishe/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal na/ /kha na ma tho 'das pa dang / /ma 'ongs pa dang da(ltar gyidu/ /las ngan bcu po byas pa yang / /da gshe)ltar mngon du byang bar 'gyur/ /phyi ma'i dus lashesangs rgyas kyi/ /ngo bo nyid kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bas de la mos par byos/ /kha ton 'dri 'oklog phyag 'tshal na/ /tshe rabs gar byung gar skyes kyang / /lta ba log par mi skye'o/ /rnam par grol pa rgyun tu thob/ /mtha' 'khob sa ru yong mi skye/ /ngan pa'i yul du'ang mi skye zhing / /rgyal po ma rungs mthong mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa 'bum phrag bzhi khri'i bar/ /sems can dmyal bar mi skye'o/ /de bas gus par phyag 'tshal na/ /mi dge bcu yi las 'byang zhing ske/ /gzungs chen rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas ma byon pa rnams kyi mtshan bsgrags pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' lnga khris phyir mi ldog pa'i sar gnas so/ /dge slong ma bdun brgyas ni dgra bcom mar grubalgebo/ /lha dang mi 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis71ni chos kyi mig rnam 67—583

par dag pa thob bo/ /gzungs chen po dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo'inyesde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung du bstan pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ched du brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gleng gzhi'i〈sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes pa rabs kyi sde la phyag 'tshal lo / /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmad du byung ba'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtan la phab par bstan pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa chen po'i sde snod thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mdo sde bcu gnyis dang /pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi mtshan thos na ③bstod pa byas sam/ phyag 'tshal lamal/ brjod dam/ mos pa bskyed dam/ blangs sam/ 'chang bar byed na gang zag de bskal pa khri phrag nyi shu'i bar du sems can dmyal bar mi ltung ste/tshe snga phyi dran pa'i ye shes dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir gus pas phyag 'tshol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde bcu gnyis kyi mtshan bshad pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri lnga stong gisasherdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /nyan thos 'bum phrag bcus theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed do/ /dge slong dang ske/ dge slong ma stong phrag bcus dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /lha dang mi dpag tu med pa zhig gis ④chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob bo/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal 67—584

lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus rtag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyun mi gtong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sman7gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' brtson⑧la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla gang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khams gsum 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'dren mkhan⑧la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'chad mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' klu'i sdong po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan rin po che'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rnam par bkod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rnam dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sred med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag par gus la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 67—585

sngon gyi ①rgyal po'i me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbyangs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus yon tan gyi stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying po rnam dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan rnam dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsam legs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang po zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab smon lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi gzugs brnyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chenashegasal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gog spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam grol la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi snying po lasaphyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam par rtog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam7mi rtog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam mi mnyam rtog 67—586

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang phyug ginyergyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi mtshan nyid la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyis brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyan chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen lag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po che'i phyag rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag rgyun tu bteg la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gelag rgyun tu phab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtse ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga'aphuba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen sgron ma 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen blta ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bden pa'i dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dra ba snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyon⑧med rtog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gtsug phudakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i rgyal po la phyag 67—587

'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud rnam par 'joms panyel phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' glog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan gyi mtshan gyisakhurnam par brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' btang bzungakhuri bsgul ba'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che dkar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa skyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' me tog rgyanakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i dbyug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgra 4)thub med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhing gi rgyan4)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi gtsug pudashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i gtsug phudashel phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu77brgyan pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dka' rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' me tog gi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i tsan dan gyi me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos gsang71ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbang 67—588

phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi gtso la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' mig mi 'dzumasatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi dge ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' dpungasamachog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' gtsang shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs ldan sred med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge yid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum mthong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu srungashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' glog gi 'odakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i yid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab zab mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thogs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin po 67—589

che'i phyag rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i gtsug tor gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bden mos la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' shes rab mthong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po thobatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po zab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'dri mkhas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lan sdon mkhas pasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid mngon du rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges pa'i mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub semasasnyedapa' nges par brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas skyed5bul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde bar gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud skrag la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /⑤byang chub sems dpa' skyabs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab go 'phang 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa dpa'akyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dmigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab smon lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsdu ba rnam bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbyangs ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos dga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdo 'dzin la phyag 67—590

'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha dog dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan tshal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgra mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha dog dam pa'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa sna tshogs brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shākya'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' spyi bo skyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' me tog 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtso mchog la phyagasahu)'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lus kun tu mngon par ston la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sku57mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od srung5)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub semasasredapa' dri med mdzod kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthosgos)btsun dpal gyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' be+e drur+ya'im tsho'od 67—591

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa7'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rten pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rten⑧pa'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' rten pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu phan gdags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ston pa'i mkhan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' me tog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' me tog brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab rgya 67—592

mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shākya'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu snying rje can 6)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byangasachub sems dpa' nor gyi dbyig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri ngar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' char pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor lo rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ ldabyang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phyag rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin 67—593

po che'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen chu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po rnam dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug tor gyi mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i thor tshugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' hunye'od stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo rig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla pa ba rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'57rnam dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sbyin brtag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal mtshan dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyen ④pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes 67—594

rab gtsang ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' dpal btsun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho rgya0)che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yul rnam par rtog (gul phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /5byang chub sems dpa' snang thar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab tu sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzugs stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'dul ba 5)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lus sbed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gcig dang / bcu dang / brgya dang / stong dang / khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag brgya/ khri phrag nyis brgya/ khri phrag sum brgya/ khri phrag bzhi brgya/ khri phrag lnga brgya/ khri phrag drug brgya/ khri phrag bdun brgya/ khri phrag brgyad brgya/ khri phrag dgu brgya/ khri phrag stong rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba 'byang b.rasnyi'agyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'bum phrag gcig /'bum phrag bcu/ 'bum phrag brgya/ 'bum phrag stong /'bum phrag khri/ 'bum phrag khri phrag khri la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med 67—595

pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig pa mi zad pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā gcig gi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā gnyis kyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā gsum gyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā bzhi'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā lnga'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā drug gi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā bdun gyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā brgyad kyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā dgu'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā bcu'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā brgya'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā stong gi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā khri'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gā bye ba khrag khrig phragatubargya stong du ma'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan 'di dag thos na bskal pa stong phrag bzhi bcu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung zhing srid pa gsum gyi khams su mi gtogs te/ rtag tu rnam par grol ba'i khams su gtogs par 'gyur phro/ /mtha' 'khob gtu mi skye/ yul ngan par mi skye/ lus ngan pa dumi len/ log par mi ltabu/rigs ngan du mi skye/ mu stegs can du mi skye/ dbang po yan lag tshang bar 'gyur / dam pa'i chos rtag tu thos par 'gyur/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims ma mnos kyang khrims dang rtag tu ldan par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po spyod lam mdzes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ de bas gus par 67—596

phyag 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la bden paratuganas shing phyi ma'i tshe sangs rgyas grub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi mtshan bshad pa'i tshe rigs kyi bu dang ②rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /lha 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa bzhisasnyeni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /dge slong sems stor ba 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa brgyad kyis duni sems kyi bdag nyid slar rnyed de dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag bcus ni gzungs chen po thob ste/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshan nyid dad la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug phud ces bya ba de'i mtshan sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba can rnams kyis lan cig thos na 'chi 'phos pa'i tshe lhar skye'o zhes khyod nyid7kyis bshad pa dang / da yang nga la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan bshad par gsol zhing sems can kun sdug bsngal dang bral zhing 'jig rten las bzla bar 'dod pa de'i phyir ngas kyang khyod dang skye bo kun la dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan rdzogs par bshad kyis kyangashe/ don dam par na dkon mchog gcig la bkri ba'i dbang gis gsum du bshad pa gang la las7de'i mtshan thos nas sems thag pa nas dran par byas te(1/ 'chi kur dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan lan gsum du/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā 8ya/ na maḥso bhā ya zhes de skad du tsoched du brjod du bcug na mi 'di 'chi 'phos nas ngan song gsum du mi 'gro ste/67—597

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas gang du dad pa de dang der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la mthar gyis rim gro byed par 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ 'jam dpal dang kun tu bzang pos theg pa chen po'i chos thar pa chen po ༅phyogs su rgyas pa bshad pa'ang thos par 'gyur/ thos nas kyang de ma thag tu skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur romi/ /rigs kyi bu gang zag de yang bskal pa grangs med pa nas dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu bstsags pas gdod dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan thos pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na dkon mchog gsum zhes bgyi/ dngos po gcig gam/ dngos po gnyis sam/dngos po gsum du bgyi/ ci ste dngos po gcig na ni skyabs gcig tu song bas/dngos po gsum lags na ni skyabs gsum du gyur pas byaskyabs gsum du gyur na ni sangs rgyas dang chos kyang dbyings tha dad par 'gyur te/ dge 'dun yang de bzhin no/ /gal te skyabs gsum zhig lags na ni skye bo rnams rnam pa gsum du mthong bas bskal pa gsum gyi bar du gechos spyod kyang theg pa gcig tu brda mi 'jal thabar mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du bdag la bshad du gsol/ bdag 'di thos nas kyang skye bo kun la bye brag phyed par bshad par 'tshal7lo/ /bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad na gang la las mtshan thos na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gnas thob par yang 'gyur ro zhes gsol pa dang / ⑧bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu 67—598

legs so legs so/ /don chen po 'di lta bu nga la zhu bar nus pa ni shin tu 'angatulegs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyodaku'adi lta bu'i don chen po 'dri ba yang sa dang po dang / sa gnyis pa dang / sa gsum pa dang / sa bzhi pa dang / sashelnga pa dang / sa drug pa dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad pa la gnas pa ma yin te/ sa bcu chos kyi sprin la gnas pa'i skyes bu chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa la don chen po 'di lta bu 'dri ba yin no/ /khyodakyilegs par nyon cig /ngas bye'ubrag phyed par bshad do/ /rigs kyi bu skye bo thams cad ni thog ma med pa nas ma rig pas bsgribs te/ khams gsum gyi btson ra na 'khor zhing sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir te/ lam rgyud drug tu phan tshun rnam par rgyu ba la ༅skyabs dang rten pa'i gnas med nas lha ma srin la phyogs te skyabs tshol ba/ mu stegs rnams rang gi rkang lag bcings shing srog btang ste/skyabs tshol na yang sdug bsngal las thar ba med do/ /me dang mtsho'i nang du mchongs te srog btang yang 'khor ba las thar ba'i dus med deme/ de'i phyir mgon po chen po de bzhin gshegs pas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skye bo rgyun tu 'khrul pa rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan bstan cing yang dag pa'i rten gnas su bya ba'i phyir/ bslab pa dang po pa dunyan thos dang rang byang chub pa (7rnams la them skas dang 'dra bar dkon mchog gsum yang dngos po tha dad par bshad do/ /de'i 'og tu rgyun ring du tshangs par spyod ⑩pa'i skyes bu dam pa la yang dag pa mthar phyin pa'i dkon mchog gsum dngos po gcig par yang bshad de(me/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gcig gi nang na chos dang dge 'dun gyi dkon mchog kyang yod par bshad do/ /67—599

rigs kyi bu ci'i phyir dkon mchog ces bya zhe na/ dper na 'jig rten gyi rin po che sna bdun pos 7phongs pa rnams la 'tsho ba bstangs ②pa dang 'dra bar dkon mchog gsum yang 'jig rten na skye bo rnams kyi chos kyi sku bskyedasapa dang /ye shes spel bar byed pas dkon mchog ces bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos po ri tha dad pa ni sangs rgyas rgyal po'i khab tu sku sprul cing byang chub sems dpa' yin pa skad du sems can bsgral ba'i phyir brtul zhugs dang dka' thub spyadakyide/byang chub kyi shing drung du mngon par byang chub nas bdag dang gzhan gyi don mdzad ces bya ba ni sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas ni ma rig pa'i gnyid las sad pa'o/ /dge 'dun zhes bya ba ni mchod pa'i gnas so/ /ston pa las slob mas don rnyed pa'i phyir dge 'dun zhes bya'o/ /dge 'dun la rnam pakyiganyis te/ 'thun pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus ma byas pa7thob pa ni yang dag pa'i stong pa nyid kyis shes rab kyi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid grol ba ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'khrul pa bar mi chad par 'byung ba'i zag pa zad pa yang 'dus ma byas zhes bya'o/ /zag pa thams cad 'gags nas 'phags pa rnams dang gnas gcig tu 'thun te/ rtsod pa med pa ni 'thun pa ste/ don de gnyis dang ldan pa ni dge 'dun zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos ni dge sdig gi chos thams cad dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas〈rnams so/ /sdig pa'i chos ni spang bar bya/ dge ba'i chos ni 'phel bar bya'o/ /de yang sems kyis dmigs so cog chos kyi dkon mchog ces bya'o/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas dang ske/ dge 'dun gnyis dngos po yang mi gcig la/ ngo bo nyid kyang tha dad do / /chos ni dge 'dun dang sangs rgyas su dbyings 'thun te so sor 67wa 600

dbye bar dka'o/ /ji ltar so sor dbye bar dka' zhe na/ gal te sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gnyis kyi mtshan bla dgas7su btags te/ rnam par dpyod pa bas rnam par grol ba'i phung posathob pa dang / dge ba'i yon tan thams cad chos kyi dkon mchog go zhes bya bar don de lta bu yang ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba'i yon tan dang bsod nams kyi dbang gis mi lus thob pa yin no/ /chos dang bral na mi med lomi/ mi las gudakyin yang chos kyi dkon mchog ces bya ba ga la yod/ deng 'dir gleng ba ni mi dang chos su gcig tu 'thun la tha dad pa yang yod de/ chos kyi dbang gis mir grubadu/ mi'i dbang du chos 'gro bas de'i phyir rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / stobs bcu dang ske/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs te/ ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu bshad do/ /nyan thos kyi rnam par grol ba'i phung po ni dge 'dun dkon mchog tu bshad do/ /yon tan 'di rnams 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang / gtan tshigs su dmigs pa'i sbyor ba ni chos kyi dkon mchog ces bya'o/ /ye ni dbyings gcig ste/ don gnyis su bshad kyis kyang chos kyi dbyings la sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun tha dad pa yang yod de/ de yang chos kyi dkon mchog tu bsdu'o/ /de ltar rnam pa gsum du bshad nas/ sems can gyi skyabs dang rten du bya na/ khams gsum na7'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur rol/ /spyod pa thams cad kyisasdug bsngal sbom po las thar gyis kyang sdug bsngal phra mo ma zad de/ de'i7phyir yang dag pa mthar phyin pa'i dkon mchog gsum bshad 67—601

par bya'o/ /sngon bshad pa la sangs rgyas la sdug bsngal mnga'o/ /chos ni mi rtag go/ /dge 'dun yang mi rtag ste/ sdug bsngal yin pas yang dag pa'i rten gnas ma yin zhes zer na deng 'dir bshad pa ni rtag tu gnas pa stel/rnal 'byor spyod pa pa〈mirnams kyis chos nyid stong pa nyid du mngon par chud cing /phyin ci log brgyad dang bral ba/ skye 'gag med pa yang dag pa'i rten gnas su gyur pa de ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog ces bya'o/ /rtag pa'i chos rnyed do cog dmigs pa'i mthar phyin par spyadashepa ni yang dag pa'i chos dkon mchog ces bya'o / /spyod pa pa rnams kyis yang dag pa'i chos kyi chos nyid khong du chud cing rtag tu 'dus ma byas pa'i gnas su grub pa ni dge 'dun zhes bya'o/ /yang phyin ci log brgyad gtan du bral bas 'phags pa dang skye bo thams cad 'thun zhing nam du yang rtsod pa med pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ces bya'o/ /sngon dkon mchog gsum mingapadang chos su tshitha dad par bshad/ deng 'dir nilasangs rgyas dngos po gcig la chos dang dge 'dun yang der byung bas don de'i phyir ngas khyod la dngos po gcig pa'i dkon mchog gsum bshad de/ skye bo kun theg pa gcig tu phyogs par bya'o9ra/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang la rnam par rtog ste theg pa chen po bsgrub par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khams gsum mi rtag par bsams te'utheg pa chen por bsgrub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad kyis gsol pa / ji ltar na mi rtag pa la rnam par rtog par bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ mi rtag pa la rnam par rtog par bya na nyon mongs pa rnam par spangs late yang dag 67—602

pa'i dran pa mngon du bzhag la byams pa dang snying rje thog mar 'gro bar bya ste/skye bo rnams la chos bshad cing bsgral na yang lan mi re ba ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de ltar ②sems can yongs su mi gtong bar〈theg pa chen po bsgrub par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dper na grong khyer chen po gcig 'khor rgya dpag tshad gcig la/ sgo mang po zhig yod pa der 'gror ni lam na g.yang sa dang / mun nag pa dang / shin tu 'jigs pa'i sa cher yod kyis kyang /grong khyer der ④phyin na shin tu bde skyid par 'gyur bas skyes bu mi gcig la bu gcig pu zhig yod pa shin tu yang sdug mod kyi/ grong khyer de na bde skyid pa'i longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod do zhes thos pas bu sdug pa der bor nas/grong khyer ⑥der 'gro 'dod pa'i phyir thabs sna tshogs kyis ⑦lam 'jigs sa bsgralasanas grong khyer de'i sgor phyin pa dang / rkang pa ya gcig nang du bcug ste / rkang pa ya gcig ma btegashepa'i bar du bu de dran nas 'di ltar bsams so3 ske/ /bdag la bu gcig pu yod pa bdag chas pa'i khar ci ste ma khrid/ darwatesu zhig slad na gso zhig gu zhes bsams72nas grong khyer de btang ste slar bu'i thad du chas so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i byams pa dang snying rje yang de dang 'dra ste/ byams shing snying brtse ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa lnga sgom par byed rdo)/ /bsgoms te zag pa zad na spuyang mi shes7grub pa mi len te⑩/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can la snying brtse ba'i phyir zag pa zad pa dang /mngon par shes pa spong ste/ so so'i skye bo'i sar bgrod par byed rdo / /rigs kyi bu dperal)grong khyer bde skyid pa zhes bya ba ni rnam par thar pa chen po la bya'o/ /dper7 sgo mang po zhes bya ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi 67—603

stong la bya'o/ /dperatulam 'jigs sa chen po zhes bya ba ni bdud dang bgegs lta bu la bya'o/ /dper ②gong khyer gyi sgor phyin zhes bya ba ni mngon par shes pa lnga thob pa la bya'o/ /dperasarkang pa ya gcig bteg ste them pa'i nang du 'jug pa ni ye shes la bya'o/ /dper7rkang pa ya gcig ma bteg⑧pa ni byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnam par ma grol ba la bya'o/ /dper7bu gcig pu lus zhes smra ba ni lam rgyud lnga'i sems can la bya'o/ /dperakhubu la dran pa ni snying rje chen po la bya'o/ /dperakhubu'i thad du ldog7pa ni sems can 'dul zhing rnam par grol ba thob par byed pa la bya'o/ /dper lan dang 'grub pa mi len pa〈nyeni thabs mkhas pa la bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen pos bsdus te/ mi gtong ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /rigs kyi bu yang 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu dam pa dang po sems bskyedam7pa nas byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du sems can la rtag tu dge btsobacu dpog par bya'o/ /bcu po gang zhe na/ srog mi gcod pa dang / ma byin par mi len pa dang / 'dod pas log par mi g.yem pa dang / brdzun du mi smra ba dang / phra ma dang dbyin mi byed pa dang / ngag rtsub po mi smra ba dang / don med pa'i gtam tshig kyalahūpa mi smra ba dang / brnab sems mi byed pa dang / gnod sems mi byed pa dang ske/ log par mi lta ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin du byams pa dang / snying rje phun sum tshogs par spyad na byams pas ni dge ba ston cing bde ba la 'god par byed/ snying rjes ni sdug bsngal las thar ba dang / dmyal ba las sgrol bar byed do/ /skye bo rnams mya ngan las 'da' bar bsgrubashe'adod 67wa 604

pa'i sgo mnyeshes pa mthong na byang chub sems dpas7skye bo de dag la snying rje ba'i sems bsgom par bya'o/ /snying rje ba'i dbang gis sems can thams cad lasamya ngan las 'da' ba'i sgo 'byed pas bde ba'i gnas mngon par ston te/ theg pa chen po'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i spyad pa spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid dad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i dran pa zhes bgyi ba gang / bka' stsal pa/ mi skye mi 'gag pa'isnyichos spyad pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos mi skye ba ni gang / mi 'gag pa ni gang / bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sdig pa'i chos ni mi skye bar bya/dge ba'i chos ni mi 'gag par bya'o/ /de lta bu'irnyuspyod pa khams gsum du spyad pa ni 'dod pa rnam pa7lnga'i bag chags kyi dri mas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu khams gsum na bgrod cing sems can bsgral bar 'dod na chos rnamasapa bcu po 'dis khams gsum du bgrod par bya ste/ kun rdzob kyi tshig dang / yi ge'i rjes su khams gsum yod par bshad mod kyi/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ni dus gsum du mi gnas la mthar phyin pa'i byang chub rnam grangs su mi ltung na dus gsum dang khams gsum lta ci smos/ chos bcu po gang zhe na/stodashepa dang smad pa la sems skyed bri med pa dang / snyan pa dang mi snyan par thos pa la sems rnam par mi rtog pa dang / shes rab can dang / gti mug can la 'dra bar snying rje bskyed pa dang / sems can bla 'og gang yang rung ste/snyoms par lta ba dang / mchod pa gus ma gus la sems rnam pa gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / gzhan gyi nyes skyon la 'phyas mi 'dogs pa dang / theg pa 67—605

rnam pa sna tshogs su mthong na yang theg pa gcig tu lta ba dang / ngan song gsum gyi sgra thos na yang 'jigs pa dang skrag pa'i semasatumi skyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'dra bar blta ba dang / bskal pa snyigs ma can gyi dus su sangs rgyas 'byung ba la ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang bcu ste/ chos bcu po de dag dngasaldan na byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu dam pa khams gsum na bgrod pa'i tshe snying rje chen pos gzhi byas na mnol ba'i zhing der 'od 'dres kyang rdul mi gcig ste/de bas na bsam gyis khyab dka'akhuzhes bya'o/ /gang zhig 'jig rten rnam dag na / /bskal pa gcig gi bar dag tu/ /tshul khrims dam du bsrungaphub ni/ /skyes bu de ni skad cig tsam/ /byams pa spyad pasasnyedam pa mchog /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di ru ni4)/ /lus dang ngag yid sdig spyad de/ /ngan song gsum du ltung nges dgazhono /byams sems de yis〈)'phral du 'byang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'ga' zhig gis/ /'jig rten ngan par skyes na yang / /'jigs dang dogs pa ma skyed cig /ngan song ltung ba'i sdig yod kyang / /mgo bo na ba tsam gyis 'byang / /gang zhig 'ching ba gcod 'dod dam/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa spang 'dod pa/ /'jig rten ngan 'dir skyes na yang / /dam chos bsrungarwatebs shes rab 'phel/ /rnam dag zhing du bskal pa 'bum/ /tshul khrims rnam dag spyad pa bas/ /deng nas sang gi bar dag tu/ /'jig rten 'di na gnas7kyang tsho)/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngas ni mi 'khrugasaca'ajig rten dang / /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gnyis/ /shin tu rnam dag mthong ba 67wa 606

na / /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ /khams der bsod nams bya ba ni/ /dka' ba snyam du mi mdzad dzo/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di dag tu/ /rang gis mi bzod bzod bya ste/ /pha rol posayang bzod bcug na/ /de ni bsod nams dam pa mchog /de phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /'jig rten ngan 'dir bgrod5 pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs mya ngan ma byed par/ /sems can thams cad 'dren bya ste/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa'i sems bskyed na/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis deng 'dir byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi rgyu dang rkyen zhig zhu zhing mchis na/ de bzhin gshegs pas skabs dbye bar gnang na spobs pa bskyed de zhu bar bgyi'o zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod sngon sangs rgyas brgya stong du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs spyad pa la mkhas pa/④ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phyir byang chub spyod pa'i brtson 'grus brtan pa 'dri geb legs kyisasho'u'adod pa bzhin dris shig /ngas khyod la bye phrag57byed par bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye bar gnang nas bcom ldan 'das la nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na brtul zhugs dang dka' thub kyi ④sems la gdung ba ma mchis par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na nges pa'i tshig la 'gyod pa ma mchis par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci 67—607

bgyis na 'jigs pa ma mchis shing tshul mi g.yo bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na dam pa'i chos yongs su 'grub par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na sa gcig nas sa bcu'i bar du legs par 'tshal bar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na/ thabs la7shin tu mkhas par 'gyur/byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na sems can gyi ston pa ②bgyid par 'gyur/byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na tshekhutshe rabs rabs su byang chub kyi sems chud mi gzon rjopar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na sems spyod pa rnams gcig las rnam pa sna tshogs su spyod pa ma mchis par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ⑦ci bgyis na chos rin po ches legs par sgrub par 'gyur/byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na tshul khrims dang 'dul ba las ⑧bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba las 'byung bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na nyon mongs pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas 0ci bgyis na tshogs mang po kun dang 'thun par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo legs par 'byed par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na sngon gyi dbang gi mthus dge ba'i rtsa ba mi stor bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na gzhan gyis bstan ⑩pa la rag mi lus par rang bzhin gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug spyad par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin btang ste/ 'dod pa'i khams su skye bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpas ci bgyis na dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel ba dang / khams gsum du bgrod cing sems can la ston pa bgyid de/ sangs 67—608

rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid bar mi 'chad par 'gyur ro zhes bgyis pa dngatu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba rnams zhu nus pa yang shin tu legs so legs so/ /khyod legs par nyon la dran pa mngon du zhog shig② /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bka'akhubazhin du thos par smon te/ mnyan cing mnos par 'tshal lo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na brtul zhugs dang dka' thub kyis dusems mi gdung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos bzhi gang zhe na/sems can thams cad la snying rje cher bskyed pa dang / brtson 'grus bskyed cing le lo mi byed pa dang / skye shi'i 'khor ba rmi lam tsam dang 'dra bar shes pa dang / yang dag pa'i yid kyis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bsam pa dang bzhi ste/byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na dka' thub dang brtul zhugs kyis0sems gdung ba med par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na nges pa'i tshig la bar ma dor 'gyod par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ nges pa'i tshig chos la bdag med par mngon par chud ces brjod pa dang / nges pa'i tshig skye gnas so cog la dad pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa mi rigs zhes brjod pa dang / nges pa'i tshig gis theg pa chen po la rgyun du bsngags pa brjod pa dang / nges pa'i tshig gis las dge sdig gi 'bras bu mi rlagasheces brjod pa dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ tshul 67—609

khrims bsrung 3)ba dang / mang du thos pa dang / sbyin pa byin pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na 'jigs pa med cing tshul las mi g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ khe stor ba dang mi snyan par grags pa dang / smad cing smakhudabab pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis non kyang mi g.yo ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na chos dkar po yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/pha rol po la gelas dge sdig yid ches par ston pa dang / sbyin pa la lan mi re ba dang / dam pa'i chos bsrung gezhing skyong ba dang / shes rab chen pos byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston ge)par byed pa dang bzhi'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na/ sa gcig nas sa bcu'i bar du legs par shes par 6)'gyur ro/ /chos bzhi gang zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yun du bskyed pa dang / nyes skyon thams cad sel ba dang / thabs la shin tu mkhas pa dang / dge ba'i brtson 'grus ci spyad pa byang chub tu bsngo ba dang bzhi'o / /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na thabs la shin tu mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can gyi yid dang 'thun par byed pa dang / gzhan gyi bsod nams dang yon tan la rjes su yi rang ba'i sems skyed ri pa dang / sdig yod na 'gyod tshangs byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang bzhi'o / /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na sems can gyi ston pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rtag tu sems can la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub5nipar byed pa dang / rang gi dga' ba yongs su 'dor ba dang /67—610
