mnyen des byas te bzod pa bsgom ①pa dang le lo spong ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang ②chos bzhi dang ldan na tshe tshe rabs (5)rabs su byang chub kyi sems chud mi zos par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cadasnyirtag tu dran par byed pa dang / bsod nams byas so cog sems can gyi phyir bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sten rige)pa dang / theg pa chen po yongs su sgrog 67par byed pa dang bzhi'o / /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na sems spyod pa rnam pa gcig las rnam pa sna tshogs su mi spyod par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/nyan thos kyi sems spang ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems spang ba dang /chos sgrub pas skyo mi ngas pa dang / chos ci thos pa gzhan la ston par byed pa dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na chos rin po che legs par bsgrubashepar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ theg pa chen podzas chos dkon pa'i phyir rin po che dang 'dra bar 'du shes bskyed 7pa dang theg pa chen po'i chos sems kyi nad thams cad sel ba'i phyir sman dang 'dra bar lta ba dang /theg pa chen po'i chos nam yang mi rlag 13 pa'i phyir nor gyi dbyig dang 'dra bar lta ba dang / theg pa hunyachen po'i chos mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa'i phyir sdug bsngal 'gog par lta ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na tshul khrims nyams pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kha na ma tho ba las 'byung7debar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos rnams 'ong ba med pa'i phyir chos la mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob pa dang / chos rnams song ba med pa'i phyir chos la mi 'gog pa'i bzod pa thob pa dang / chos rnams rgyu dang rkyen las skye bar hu/shes 67—611

pa'i phyir chos la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bzod pa thob pa dang / tha dad pa'i sems rgyud med pa'i phyir mi gnas pa'i bzod pa thob pa dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na nyon mongs pa rnams 'gag ①par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i dran pa mngon du gzhag ②pa dang ske/ dbang po rnams7bsdam pa dang / dge ba'i chos kyi stobs bskyed nus pa dang / dben pa'i gnas su dad cing 'du 'dzi spang bar bya ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na tshogs mang po kun dang 'thun par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag chos sgrub na yang khyad par thob par mi sgrub pa dang / le lo med par rtag tu bkur sti dang gus pa'i sems skyed pa dang ske/ chos kyi phan pa 'ba' zhig tshol gyi bdag mi spyomasapa dang / gzhan la dge ba'i chos bstan kyang rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / grags pa mi tshol ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo legs par 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung ༅zhing skyong ba dang / rang gi shes rab la phan par byed cing gzhan la ston par byed pa dang / rtag tu ya rabs kyi chos spyod pa dang / rnam par dag pa dang / ma dag pa'i chos la mi rtog pa dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na sngon gyi dbang gi mthus dge ba'i rtsa ba mi rlag⑧par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ pha rol po'i nyes skyon la dbang mi bza' ba dang / zhe snang can la rtag tu byams sems bsgom pa dang / rtag tu chos thams cad rten 'brel du bshad pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub7rtag tu dran par bya ba dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan 67—612

na gzhan gyis bstan pa la rag ma lus par rang bzhin gyis7pa rol tu phyin pa drug spyod par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ rtag tu chos kyi sbyin pa gzhan la sbyin⑧pa dang / gzhan gyi kha na ma tho ba mi brjod pa dang / chos kyis bsdus te sems can gyi ston pa la mkhas pa dang / chos zab mo7chub par shes pa dang bzhi'i / /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin btang ste 'dod pa'i khams su mngon du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sems mnyen des su bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu rnyed par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad mi gtong ba dang / shes rab dang thabs mkhas pa'i mthu stobs rgyun du sgom7nus pa dang bzhi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ skye shi'i 'khor ba grangs med par myong na yang skyo ba'i sems mi bskyedasapa dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas tshad med pa la mchod pa bya ba dang / byams sems tshad med pa bsgomarnyupar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tshad med pa la mos pa bskyed7pa dang bzhi'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' yang chos bzhi dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid rgyun mi 'chadasnyepar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad kyi phyir smon lam mi gtong ba dang / sbyin pa'i spyod lam la dad pa dang / brtson 'grus chen po la 'dun pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la sems zab mos rgyunashedu spyod pa dang bzhi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum du bgrod cing spyod pa rnam pa bzhi po'i rnam grangs spyad de/ sems can la phan pa dang bde bar byas shing 'jig rten las bzla bar bsgoms na sangs rgyas kyi bdag 67—613

nyid rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe theg pa chen7po'i chos rnam pa bzhi bzhir bshad pa'i tshe na lha bzhi khrisasheni bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed dol/ /mi las nyi khri lnga stong ni chos la mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi khri brgyad stong ni chos kyi khams kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob ste sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mngon par chud do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod mdo sde 'di legs par zung shig /chongs shig ces bka' stsal nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pal/ mdo sde 'di'i ming ni thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa bdud kyi yul 'joms pa/ mu stegs kyi dpung dang bcas par gzhig pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad sel ba/ log par lta ba dang / 'dod pa rnam pa lnga'i 'ching ba 'grol ba/ khams gsum gyi btson ra 'dralasnyib/ 'khor ba las thar cing mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyogs su sgrola'ageb/ sa bon dam pa'i rgyu skams pa thonan par byed pa/ rgyu rkyen chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi chos kyi char 'bebs pa/sems can theg pa gsum gyi myu gu dang me tog rgyas shing 'phel bar byed pa/byang chub kyi 'bras bu mchog theg pa gcig tu 'grub par byed pa zhes bya bar zung shigarin /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas grangs ma mchis pa'i spyan snga 3)dang / 'dus pa grangs ma mchis pa 67—614

dang ske/ tshogs dpag tu ma mchis pa'i nang du chos rnam pa sna tshogs dang /don rnam pa sna tshogs dang / mtshan ma rnam pa sna tshogs dang / theg pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyang thos na ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos de lta bu dang / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i don de lta bu dang / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma de lta bu dang / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i theg pa chen po de lta bu ni thos ma myong ste/deng thos pa 'di da bdag gis07rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni rtag la chos dang dge 'dun ni 'gag par mi 'gyur te/khams gsum gyi sems can rang skye zhing rang 'gag par gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa ma mthong ba dang / chos dang dge 'dun ma mthong bas mya ngan las 'das te 'gag par 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs gekyis khams gsum du bgrod cing so so'i skye bo'i rjes su snyegs kyete/ mya ngan las 'da'o zhes bla dgas rgyasu brjod pa lags7so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad na/ bdag cag rnams kyis theg pa brgyad khris sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su chud par skyes bu chen po'i chos kyi7sku thob par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams la mdo sde 'di spel bar bgyi'o/ /gzung zhing 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang ske/ kha ton du 'don par rinabagyi'o/ /ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bsgom lko/dus gcig tu sangs rgyas su tso'agrub par bgyi'o/ /mi gtong bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang la las bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad na tsosnyigs ma can gyi dus su mdo sde 'di gzungs su bzung hu7zhing klog gam/ kha ton du bgyid dam/ glegs bam du yi 67—615

ger 'dritu'am/ yi ger 'drirakhu'ajug na bsod nams ji tsam zhig thob par 'gyur / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang la las stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnor bu rin po ches yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa ④bas mdo sde 'di'i ming tsam thos pas bsod nams dpag tu med par che'o/ /gang la las 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag bcu nor bu rin po ches yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas mdo sde 'di glegs bam du byas te 'chang ba tsam gyis bsod nams dpag tu med par che'o/ /gang la las phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su nor bu rin po ches yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas theg pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde7'di'i nang naphuyi ge 'bru gcig gam/ tshigs bcad gcig gam/ shu logashegacig 'dri 'am / 'drir〈skre'ajug na de bas kyang bsod nams dpag tu med par che'o/ /'jig rten grangs med pa'i khams su rin po ches yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas kyang hu)sems thag pa nas mdo sde 'di shu log ()gcig klog gam/kha ton du mibyas na bsod nams de bas kyang dpag tu med par che'o/ /stong khams yongs su gang ba'i sems can gyi srog gi skyabs byin pa bas kyang / gang gis sems thag pa nas mdo sde 'di'i don tshig gcig shes te/ gzhan la tshig gcig gam/ shu logatsogacig gi don bstan na bsod nams de bas kyang dpag tu med par che'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zang zing gi sbyin pa ni nyan thos kyi sbyin pa yin te/ tshe dang longs spyod bskyed par zad kyi 'khor ba las mi thar ro//theg pa chen po chos kyi sbyin pa ni sems can rnams kyi byang chub kyi rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi ye shes kyi srog sdud par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 67—616

mdo sde 'di klogatupa dang 'chang ba ni sngon sdig can ma rungs pa yin na yang dakhudage ba dang ldan pa'o/ /sngon sdug bsngal can yin na yang da longs spyod dang ldan pa'o/ /sngon 'ching ba can yin na yang na⑧grol thar pa dang ldan pa'o④/ /sngon ma rgal ba yin na yang da rgalar+sā)ba can7no/ /sngon blun pa57zhig yin na yang da ni slob dpon du chud pa'o/ /sngon zag pa dang bcas pa zhig yin7na yang da ni zag pa med pa'o/ /sngon so so'i skye bo'i spyod pa can zhig yin na yang da ni 'phags pa'i spyod pa dang ldan pa'o/ /sngon chos lam dang 'gal ba zhig yin na yang da ni 'phags pa'i lam la chud pa'o/ /lus77skye bo'i lus can yin na yang (nyamado sde 'di klog pa dang 'chang ba'i phyir blo ni 'phags pa'i ye shes dang 'dra ba'o8/ /sngon nyon mongs pa can zhig yin na yang da (snyemado sde 'di klog pa dang 'chang ba'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra bar mya ngan las 'da' ba can no zhes bka' stsal pa dang77/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas bshad pa ltar na/ sngon so so'i skye bo lags kyang da ni 'phags pa'i spyod pa dang ldan no zhes bgyi ba dang / sngon nyon mongs pa can lags na yang da ni mdo sde 'di klog pa dang / 'chang bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra bar mya ngan las 'da' ba can no/ /zhes byung na tshul khrims zhig pa dang / mtshams ma mchis par spyad pa dang / dam pa'i chos la skur pasnyibatab pa yang ci mdo sde 'di klog pa tsam gyis nyon mongs pa spong ste/ mya ngan las 'da' ba yidang 'thun pa zhig lags sam/ don de rig par dka' zhing hunyemachis na/bcom ldan 'das bye brag phyed par bstan du gsol zhes bgyis pa dang /67—617

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis0)legs par zhus pas ngas kyang legs par bshad par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu sems can thams cad sangs rgyas ma mthong ba'i phyir log par lta ba dang /tshul khrims nyams pa dang / dam pa'i chos la skur paskrubatab pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten du bzhugs pa na tshul khrims nyams pa dang / dam pa'i chos la skur pa btab pa yong med do/ /de ji lta ci zhe na/ dper na dra stim mi gcig la bu gcig pums)zhig yod pa de shin tu'ang phangs shing sdug na pha yod pa'i tshe na ni nyin mtshan du bstan cing bslabs pas 46)byas so cog la 'gal ba med/bu yang pha la sri zhu che ste/ pha'i ngag nyan cing nyes pa yong ma byung ngo / /re shiga'agedus gcig na pha lam ring por 'dronamadudu song ba las ring du lon te slar ma 'khor ba'i bar du bu de pha'i bstan ngag brjed nas nyes pa yang mang du byung ngo ske/ /pha ring du lon te slar ma 'khor ba'i phyir pha shi ba skad du brjod de ngud mo dag byed cing khad kyis 'chal ladu byed do/ /mya ngan gyis non te sems stor nas phas nyu )bstan pa yang brjed de chos la skur pa dang 'dra bar 'gal ba sha stag nyu1byed do/ /pha de yun ring mo zhig lon nas dus gcig na slar khyim du log pa'i tshe bu yang shin tu dga' ba dang tshim pa skyes nas sngon tu pa'i bstan ngag kyang dran te gzungs su bzung nas nyes pa yang ma byung ngo / /pha mthong ba'i phyir pha ma shi bar yang yid ches nas log par ltung ba can zhes kyang mi bya'o/ /pha'i bka' bzhin du mi 'gal bar spyad pas skur pa can zhes kyang mi bya ste/ rigs kyi bu dra hunyem zhes bya ba ni hustede bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bu gcig pu zhes bya bcani sems can thams cad do/ /phas bstan cing bslabs zhes bya ba ni tshul khrims 67—618

so/ /lam ring por song zhes bya ba ni7de bzhin gshegs pa khams gzhan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gshegs pa'o/ /pha ma mthong zhes bya ba ni tshe 'das so zhes brjod pa'o/ /mya ngan gyis non pa ni sgribasnyepas bsgribs pa'o/ /gzungs su mi 'dzin pa nini tshul khrims zhig pa'o/ /shi ba skad brjod pa'i phyir sdig spyod pa'o/ /don 'khrul pa'i phyir skur pa btab pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pas khams gzhan nas slar gshegs te/ sems can gyis mthong ba ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yid ches54pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyis chos bstan nas sems kyisnyirang bzhin slar rnyed pas tshul khrims mi nyams pa'o/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yid ches pa ni ltung ba med pa'o/ /bstan pa dang mi 'gal bar spyod cing don shes pa ni chos la mi skur pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu mdo sde 'di klog pa dang 'chang ba ni 'khor ba grangs med pa'i nyon mongs pa'i 6)sdig lci ba kun 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang mdo sde 'di thos pa ni rtso)sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos pa'o/ /gang mdo sde 'di mthong ba ni sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba'o//gang mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dzin pa'o/ /gang mdo sde 'di spyod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa spyod pa'o/ /gang mdo sde 'di bshad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bshad pa'o/ /gang mdo sde 'di'i don shes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi don shes pa'o/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi don legs par khrol ba de ni nyon mongs pa gtan med par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mdo sde 'di lag tu 'ongs pa'i ni phyir nyon mongs pa yongs su spang bar〈nye'agyur ba'os/ /rigs kyi bu bskal pa brgyad khri 31la nyin zhag gcig tu brtsi༄nyeb/ zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo 67—619

gcig tu bsgres pa'i bskal pa brgya stong bye ba khrag khrig 'das pa la sangs rgyas gcig 'byung ba dang phrad do/ /yang bskal pa grangs de dang 'dra ba 'das nas sangs rgyas gcig 'byung ba dang phrad pa bas7kyang mdo sde 'di dang phrad pa shin tu dkon no/ /gang mdo sde 'di dang〈phrad pa ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang phrad pa dang 'dra'o/ /de'i phyir blo dang ldan pas mdo sde 'di blang bshedang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du 'don pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / 'drir 'jug pa dang / gzhan la yang bstan na log par lta ba dang / ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa'i sdig pa yongs su 'byangashebar 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi zhing la gnas par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi mchod yon dpag tu med pa yang 'ju bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / nam mkha'i snying pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das rang sangs rgyas kyang 'jig rten gyi yon 'ju ba skad mi gda' na so so'i skye bo lta nizhig yon 'ju bar 'gyur ram/ zhes gsol pa dang /⑨bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang sangs rgyas yon mi 'ju mi srid de/sems can la chos bshad cing bsgral mi nus na yang bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pas ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam par sprul cing sems can rnams sgrol bar byed pas mchod yon 'ju bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde kha cig las 'byung ba lta ba log pa dang / tshul khrims zhig pa rnams dngarwanye/ khams gcig tu lhan cig gnas su yang mi rung ba dang / chu klung gcig la chab 'tshal du yang mi rung ngo 67—620

zhes 'byung ①la gso sbyong gi tshe gang zag de 'phags pa'i lam stor ba lags te/dge 'dun gyi nang du'ang mi chud ces 'byung na ci'i slad du deng 'dir tshul khrims zhig pa rnams kyang mchod yon 'ju bar 'gyur zhesalgegasungs/ gal te de dag mchod yon 'ju bar 'gyur na ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang yang tha mi dadasnyel / 'phags pa dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'dra na/ bcom ldan 'das de tsam zhig bye brag phyedasrepar bshad par smon/ bdag kyang de thos nas de bzhin du sems can rnams la bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyed la sogs pa deng 'dir byams pa dang / snying rje phun sum tshogs par ldan pas sems can rnams

'gro'o / /drin mi gzo ba dang khrel med pa ni 'chi 'phos na byol song gi rgyud0)du 'gro'o / /log spyod kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang bsod nams can gyi yon 'ju na mdo sde 'di klog pa dang / 'chang ba'i gang zag lta zhigakhuci smos/ de bas na theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thar pa chen po'i phyogs su rgyas pa'i mthu dang byin nirkubasam gyis mi khyab bo/ /tshul khrims 'jig pa dang / mtshams med par 'gro ba dang / dam pa'i chos la skur pa dang / log par lta ba dang /nyon mongs pa can gyi sdig pa yongs su 'byang bar byed pas na mchod yon yang 'ju bar nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab/thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mthu dang byin yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa'i gang zag de'i yon tan yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no⑦/ /khyod kyis bshad pa bzhin te/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' yas pa thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsol ⑧pa dang / de nas ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ngas dran pa sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba na nga de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu rtsa gnyis la mchod pa phul te/ bsnyen bkur byas na yang nyan thos kyi tshul du spyad pas nyes skyon mang du byung ba dang / tshul khrims nyams pa dpag tu med pa dag byung ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang nga la lung bstan par ma7gyur to/ /bskal pa de 'das nas bskal pa mthong bar mos pa zhes bya ba na nga ⑨de'i tshe 67—622

sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu la mchod pa phul te/ bsnyen bkur byas na yang sangs rgyas de dag gis nga la lung ma bstan to/ /bskal pa de 'das nas kyang bskal pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba na nga de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis la mchod pa phul te/ bsnyen bkur byas na yang sangs rgyas de dag gis nga lasalung mkhubastan to/ /bskal pa de 'das nas yang bskal pa sems dga' zhes bya ba na nga de'i tshe sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong la mchod pa phul te/bsnyen bkur byas na yang sangs rgyas de dag gis nga la༄lung ma bstan to/ /bskal pa de 'das nas yang bskal pa sdug bsngal skyabs zhes bya ba dang /'jig rten rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur〈peb bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa chen po zhes bya ba byung ste/ nga de'i tshe sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu la mchod pa phul te/ bsnyen bkur byas nas gdod mdo sde 'di'i ming thos tekhya/ nyon mongs pa yongs su spangs kyis kyang mdo sde 'di da dung ma mthong ste/ nga de'i tshe de'i dus na mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa sna tshogs bstsags ⑦te / mchod pa phul na yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang nga la lung bstan par ma gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu nga sngon bskal pa de snyed du sangs rgyas de snyed la mchod pa de snyed cig phul ba dang / bsnyen bkur dang bstod pa byas nas nyon mongs pa rnam par spangs te/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa dang / tshulasaphun sum tshogs pa tshangs par spyad cing sbyin pa byin pa dang / tshul khrims bslab pa 67—623

dang nga rgyal dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug spangs te/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan spyad pa dang / bzod pa dang / byams pa'i sems dang / ji ltar thos pa bzhin brtson 'grus su bshad pa dang / thos so cog thams cad mi brjid pa dang ske/ 'du 'dzi spangs te dben pa la gnas pa dang / bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa dang / bsam gtan las byung nas7chos nyan pa dang ske/ klog pa dang / kha ton du 'don pa dang / bsam pa la sogs pa byas kyang rgyal ba de dag gis nga la lung ma bstan ste④/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sdom pa mnos so cog 'jig pa dang / nyams pa mang du byung ba'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la chags pa'i phyir ro/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'di ma thos pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam spang bar bya/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa bsgom7par byas na lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ngas bskal pa gcig nas bskal pa gcig gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bshad na⑧yang rdzogs par mi nus te/ rigs kyi bu nga0bskal pa de dag 'das pa'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mi 'gyur gyis tshogs chen po dpag tu med pa la 'theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa der mthong nas nga de'i tshe de'i dus na gdod thos pa dang mthong bar gyur to④/ /rgyal ba de las blangs te 3)'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du bya bshedang / don bsam pa la sogs pa byas nas de ma thag tu chos la mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mi 'gyur 67—624

gyis nga la lung bstan pa/ khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhesatulung bstan to/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di blangs te/'chang ba dang / klog pa la sogs pa byas na sangs rgyas kyi sa yang myur du thob par 'gyur na/ 'jig rten na lha dang mir bcas pa'i mchod yon 'ju bar 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir ngas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi mthu stobs rin po che'i snying po dang 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshul khrims 'jig pa dang / dbulasaphongs pa rnams kyi tshul dang rin po che'i nor bu sbyin par byed pa la bstod7pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod par bya'o/ /theg chen dpe tshad rgya mtsho bzhin/ /theg pa chung ngu ba rjes chu/ /theg chen dpe tshad ri rab lhun/ /theg pa chung ngu grog ma'i mkhar/ /theg chen dpe tshad nyi zla bzhin/ /theg pa0chung ngu me stag tsam/ /theg pa 'di ni theg chen yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab theg pa'o/ /dper na nam mkha' dang 'dra ba/ /sems can thams cad go 'byed do/ /theg pa thams cad kun gyi nang / /theg pa 'di las 'da' ba med/ /theg pa chen po 'di nang nas/ /theg pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ske/ /dpag pa'isnyigangs shig yod na ni/ /thams cad bsgral bar mi nus so/ /theg pa bla na med pa 'di/ /sems can yongs su bsgral nus pa/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i theg chen la/ /gang gis dpag med 'di spyad pa/ /nam mkha' dpag tu med pa bzhin/ /gzugs dang dbyibs kyang yong med do/ /theg pa chen po'ang de bzhin te/ /thogs pa med cing dpag tu med/ /sems can thams cad de dag kun/ /theg pa chen po 'di zhon la/ /theg pa'i mtshan 67—625

la0)rnam rtog na/ /gtos rgyasache zhing mang du shong / /gal te theg chen yon tan dang / /theg pa gcig tu spyod pa ni / /bskal pa dpag med rab bshad kyang ske/ /mtha' ru rdzogs par yangatswami nus/ /theg pa thams cad kun gyi nang //theg pa chen po dam pa〈nyamachog /sems thag theg chen 'di blangs na/ /byang chub shing drung mngon par 'gro/ /'ching ba med cing thogs7med pa/ /bla na med pa'i theg pa 'di/ /theg pa dman pa'i mchog 'gyur bas/ /byang chub dkyil du 'dugatso)par 'ong / /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam rtag steme/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i47phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad la/ /theg chen mdo sde bshad par bya/ /gang zhig theg chen theg pa ni/ /'phel ba'am 'grib pa yong med de/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun shong bas/ /theg pa chen po bsam mi khyab/ /de phyir sems can thams cad kyis/ /brtson 'grus su ni bsgom bya ste/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dang ni/ /ye shes chen po thob par bya/ /lha yi tshogs dang lha yi03 bdud/ /mu stegs nyon mongs sel 'dod na / /theg pa chen po'i skyabs07song la/ /mngon shes drug dang ldan par byos/ /rig pa gsum dang rnam thar gsum/ /des ni bdud dang mu stegs 'joms/ /log par lta ba'ang 'jil bas /rten/ /theg pa chen po mchog tu dgos/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'jig pa dang / /dge rtsa phun sum tshogs 'gyur bas/ /theg chen mthu ni bsam mi khyab/ /de bas dpag pa'ang rab tu dka'(rte/ /'jig rten pa yisachos rnams dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i chos thams cad/ /slob dang mi slob de dag kun/ /theg pa chen por kun 'dus so/ /sems can gang zhig ngan 'gror spyod pa ni/ /log par lta ba dang ni sdig grogs bsten/ /67wa 626

gang zhig theg pa chen por ma dad pa/ /des ni nyon mongs bdud rnams 'joms mi nus/ /de rnams spangs te theg chen skyabs song ba/ /grol thar 'dod pas theg pa chen po slob/ /skyes bu gang zhig don chen tu)shes 'dod pa/ /theg chen bshad pa thos na dga' ba skye/ /de ni theg chen mi ni yin par mngon/ /zhi gnas sems ni mngon par shes dang ldan/ /de yang theg chen dbang gis rnam par brgyan/ /gang zhig theg pa chen por spyod nus pa/ /de ni dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mi 'chadage/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la phyogs pa ni / /de ni bsod nams dpag med thob pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams su phyin pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dpag med mchod pa dang / /de bzhin theg chen phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo/ /mchod na 'jig rten theg pas thub pa med/ /dpal dang gzi brjid ldan zhing 'khor ba 'joms/ /de phyir theg pa chen po bsam khyab dka'/ /byad gzugs stobs dang dbang phyug thob par 'gyur / /phun sum tshogs ldan chos sku mngon par 'grub/ /gang zhig theg chen 'di la zhon pa ni/ /bla na med pa'i dga' ba myong ba yin/ /lus kyi sbyin pas snying rje byams bsgoms na/ /de phyir theg pa bla med thob par 'gyur/ /tshul khrims brtson 'grus tshangs par spyod pa ni/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon du nyi zla sgrib kyang nus/ /de yang theg chen spyod pa'i dbang gis so/ /rang gi sems kyis brtson 'grus rgyun spyod pa/ /des ni theg pa chen po thob pa'o/ /sdug bsngal non pa'i sgrib pa yod na yang / /theg chen bsgoms pas de dag kun kyang 'byang ske/ /gang zhig theg chen chos la bde gnas pa/ /de ni tshe dang longs spyod sangs rgyas bzhin/ /yang dag dran pa brtson par ldan pa ni/ /rdzu 'phrul 67—627

rkang pa bzhi yi stobs kyang rnyed/ /dam chos yang dag don la brten pa yang / /theg pa chen po bsgoms 3)pa'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'jigs dang ni stobs bcu ldan pa dang / /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis brgyan pa dang / /rdo rje ting 'dzin ye shes thams cad kyang / /theg pa chen po bsgom7pa'i dbang gis so/ /rigs kyi bu gang la las theg pa chen po ③chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung ste/'bru gcig gam/ tshig gcig gam/ tshigs bcad gcig 'chang ngam klog na bsod nams 'di lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/gang gis mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa/ /sdug bsngal kun dang yong 'bral lo/ /nam du'ang ngan 'gror mi ltung ste/ /bde ba'i gnas su phyin par 'gyur/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di thos pa/ /phyi ma ma 'ongs dus ngan tshe/ /mtha' ru sangs rgyas 'grub par yang / /ngas ni lung du bstan par bya/ /gang gis rgyal la rtag gzhol ba/ /rgyal ba'ang rtag tu de la gzhol/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i chos

gnas pa'i mchod gnas de dag tu/ /sangs rgyas mngon sumanyebazhugs pa bzhin / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngas sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa las mdo sde 'di mnos te 'chang ba dang / bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe gzhan la rgya cher bshad pas na mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang de ltar thob bo zhes bka' stsal pa dngakhu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis bshad/ deng 'dir yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis bshad na/ las kyi rgyu gang dang gang gi dbang gis de dag 'grub par 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye zhing bstan du gsol zhes bgyis pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni yon tan dpag tu med pa bsgrubs pas mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'grub pa yin te/ gal te ngas rgya cher bshad du bskal pa'i bar du yang bshad pa du )mi rdzogs pas deng mdo tsam zhig khyod la bshad do/ /de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste sems thag0pa nas tshul khrims dag par bsrung bsnyedang / yi dam la brtan pas zhabs shin tu gnas pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bla ma la bsu skyal7dang / chos nyan pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten bsgrub shepa laphuphu dud du byas pas phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan rtsibs stong dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad la ma brnyas7pas rting pa yangs pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrungs pas7sor mo ring ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bsdu57ba rnamatshwanyebazhi goms par byas 67—629

pas phyag dang zhabs dra bas7sor mo bar 'brel ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / gos bzang po sbyin pa byin⑧pas/ phyag dang zhabs gzhon zhing 'jam pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bza' ba dang / btung bsnyezhim po dang / gtsang ma dang / nyams su bde ba byin pas/ bdun⑧shin tu mtho ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la thos par dga' bas ri dgas ge.e na ya'i byin pa lta bu'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang —/ gzhan gyi g.yo dang mtshang sbed cing bcabs pas gsang ba'i gnas sbubs su nub pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba bcu bsgoms7pas seng ge'i rolas)stod lta bu'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs te sems can la rtag tu ston pas phrag so shin tu rgyas pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / 'jigs pa rnams kyi7mgon dang skyabs byas pas phrag pa'i lhun mdzes par grub pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi 3 )gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod rten bsgrubatshwanyepa'i grogs byed par mos pa dang / slong ba rnams la bdog pa med ces ma byas pas phyag brla drang por pus mo'i lha nga la sleb 8pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur brwanyedang /rtag tu dge ba'i chos thams cad bsgrub 8pa dang / srog gi rim gro byas pas sku che zhing drang ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / na ba rnams kyi rtsi sman dang ske/ rim gro dang / nyams su phan pa'i zas byin pas ro brokheba'i mchog thob pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / yun ring po nas tshig kyal7pa spangs shing dus su smra bas seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad la sems mnyam par snyoms pas tshems 67—630

mnyam zhing bzhi bcu tshang ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rtsod pa rnams sdum pa la dga' bas tshems thags bzang ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rin po che'i sbyin pa byas pas tshems mnyam pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / lus dang ngag0)yid yongs su dag pas tshems shin tu dkar ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / ngag gi nyes pa bsdams pas ljags shin tu yangs shing srab pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang sems can rnams la rtag tu tshig 'jam po smra bas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / byams pa'i sems bsgomasang te rmongs pa med pa'i mig gis lta ①lta bas spyan dkar nag 'byes pa'i byamatshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sems thag pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsgrubasalgepas ba'i rdzi ma lta bu'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / gzhan la ⑥bsod nams dang yon tan yod pa rjes su yisherang zhing bsngags pas zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / pha dang / ma dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon la sogs pa〈bla ma rnams la tshul bzhin du rim gro 3)dang /btsun par77byas pas dbu spyi gtsug dang ldan pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang ske/ theg pa chen po'i chos bstan pa la mos pas mdog shin tu 'jam pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / stan dang / gos dang / khang pa dang /gnas bzang po byin pas gser gyi kha dog dang ldan pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi gtam sna tshogs te51smra ba 3)spangs pas ba spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes7naganyen dang / mkhan po dang / bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa'i tshig 67wa 631

yang dag par blangs 37pa dang / bzung ba mngon du spel zhing 'grib par ma byas pas yan lag gi spu gyen du 'khyil pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang /yon tan dpag tu med par bsgrubs pas zhabs legs par mtho ba'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams ting nge 'dzin bsgomakhupar bskul bas shing n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur ba ste/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de ltar dpag tu med pa'i yon tan bsgrubs na lamatshan sum cu rtsa gnyis de lta bu dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes de skad ces5gebaka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos bcom ldan 'das lasnyi'adi skad cesasnyigasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bdag gis brtags na gang yang dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub ④ste ma mchis la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la brtags na yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ku spyod lam de ma lags na ci'i slad du spyod lam rgya cher bsgrub 9ces gsungs/ dkon mchog gsum dang / bden pa bzhi dang /phung po dang / skye mched dang / khams dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang /pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos rnams la bdag gis brtags na yang phyi nang gi rgyu 'bras kun stong pa nyid de/ mtshan ma ma mchis/ smon pa ma mchis/ skye zhing 'byung ba yang ma mthong / 'gag cing nub pa yang ma mthong / sgyu ma dang 'dra ba/sprul pa dang 'dra ba/ 'bar ba dang 'dra ba/ brag ca dang 'dra ba/ chab kyi zla ba dang 'dra ba/ rus sbal gyi spu dang 'dra ba/ ri bong gi rwa dang 'dra ba/nam mkha'i me tog dang 'dra ba/ mo gsham gyi bu dang 'dra ba/ gzugs brnyan gyi gos gyon zhing sgyu ma'i glang po che la 'tshal ba dang 'dra ba/ mchis pa yang 'dra 67—632

ba① / ma mchis pa yang 'dra ba(snye/ de dag ni〈gemachis pa dang ma mchis pa/mchis pa yang ma lags/ ma mchis pa yang ma lags/ rtag pa ma lags/chad pa ma lags/ skye ba ma lags/ 'gag⑧pa ma lags/ nang du ma lags/slad rol ma lags/ mthong ba ma lags/ shes pa ma lags/ dper na nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du ngas ni spyod lam de dag spyadasaces gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bdag gis brtags na bdag ma lags/ sems can ma lags/⑥ srog ma lags/ gso ba ma lags/ skyes ⑦bu ma lags / gang zag ma lags/ shed can ma lags/ shed bdag ma lags/byed pa po la sogs pa ma lags/ mig ma lags/ gzugs ma lags/ mig dang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul ma lags/ rna ba ma lags/ sgra ma lags / rna ba dang sgra'i mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul ma lags/ sna ma lags/ dri ma lags/ sna dang dri'i mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul ma lags/ lce ma lags/ ro ma lags/ lce dang ro'i mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul ma lags/ lus ma lags/reg bya ma lags/ lus dang reg bya'i mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul ma lags/ yid ma lags/ chos ma lags/ yid dang chos kyi mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul yangasnyim lags/ rnam par shes pa ma lags/ gzugs ma lags/ rnam par shes pa dang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul yang ma lags/ gzugs ma lags/sdug bsngal ma lags/ gzugs dang sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid kyi spyod yul yang ma lags/ bdag ma lags/ bdag gi ma lags/ 'gro ba ma lags/gzugs can ma lags/ phung po ma lags/ bden pa 1)ma lags/ brdzun pa ma lags/ bsdus pa ma lags/ gtor〈nyab ma lags/ 'byung ba ma lags/67—633

'juganyepa ma lags te/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /phar bzhud pa ma lags/ tshur byon pa ma lags/ bzhugs pa'i gnas kyang mi mnga'/ sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa yang mi mnga'/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyangakhumi mnga' / gcig pa yang ma lags/ tha dad pa'ang ma lags/ 'das pa yang ma lags/ ma byon pa yang ma lags/ da ri7ltar byung ba yang ma lags/ dri ma can ma lags/ yongs su dag pa ma lags/ bdag ma lags/ sems can ma lags/ srog dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag la sogs pa yang ma lags/rtag pa ma lags/ chad ④pa ma lags/ skye ba ma mchis/ 'gag pa ma mchis/sgom du ma mchis/ spyod du ma mchis/ dor du ma mchis/ blang du ma mchis/mtha' las 'das pa/ yun du bzhugs pa la gang gi slad du spyod lam rgya cher bsgrubs zhes skoregasungs zhes zhegasol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod sngon 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas grangs ri med dpag tu med pa rnams la bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa/ yun ring po nas theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i don chubalgepar chud de/ chos so cog kun kyang stong pa nyid du mngon par shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa'i mtha' las 'das te/ yun du gnas par yang shes pas rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya7shin tu dang ba gsal ba/ 'dam rdzab kyi nang du lo stong gi bar du bzhag kyang /rang bzhin yong gis dag pas phyir phyung na yang snga ma kho bzhin te/ khyod kyang de 67—634

dang 'dra bar chos kyi mtshan nyid mngon par rtogs la/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pas/ khyed7rnams da ltar khams gsum na snyigs ma can rnam ②lnga'i 'damasardzab tu gnas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / sems can gyi don byas kyis kyang 'dam rdzab kyis ma gos pas na don 'di lta bu dag 'dri nus pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu khyod yang nyon cig /'di lta ste/ chos so cog thams cad yang dag par na dngos po med de/ yi ge yod pa'i phyir chos yod cesalgebashad / chos kyi nang du yi ge med la yi5gege'i nang du yang chos med do/ /kun tu spel ba'i phyir yi ge bstan to/ /yi ge'i nang du ni byang chub kyang med/ byang chub kyi nang du ni yi ge yang med mod kyi/ don dam par7ni yi ge med kyang kun rdzob tu yi ge yod par bshad pas sems can la sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid dang ske/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang yi ge las gud na mi rnyed do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod zer ba'ang bden te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la zad pa med/ skye ba med / mi bsgom mi spyod/ bsgom spyod rnams dang bral ba/ yang dag pa'i chos la mi 'jug /de las ldog cing 'gyur ba'ang ma yin(she/ skye ba gcig gis dga' ldan gyi gnas su yang ma skyes/ de las babs te yum gyi lhums su yang mas1 gnas / chos thams cad la 8sems mi gnas pas nga ni skye rga na 'chi las 'das so zhes kyang ma byas/ phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun yang ma bor/nga ni 'jig rten na bla na med pa'i btsun pa yin no zhes kyang ma brjod/ grong khyer mchog tu na cung5)bzang morwa dang yang ma rtse na/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba yig rtsis0nyel sogs pa yang ma bslabasatso/ stobs dang 'phong rtsol miyang ma bsgrun/sems can yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir rgan po mngon sum du bstan pa ni 67—635

lus la chags pa rnams bkag pa'o/ /nad pa mngon sum du bstan pa ni tshe la chags pa rnams bkag pa'o/ /shi ba'i mtshan ma mngon sum du bstan pa ni 'dod chags dang nga dang ngar 'dzin pa rnams bkag pa'o/ /dge slong mngon sum du bstan pa ni sems can rnams tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyinyelus su mi smon par 'jig rten las 'das pa bla na med pa'i chos brtson par bsgrub par bya ba'o②ske/ /grong khyer mchog nas byung ste gshegs pa ni khams gsum gyi btson⑧ra nas thar ba dang 'bras bu ma yin pa rnams bstan pa'o/ /slar gzigs pa ni byams sdang mi mnga' bar bstan pa'o/ /de'i phyir mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sku rnam par brgyan ④cing sems can gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bya ba'o/ /dbu spa bregasalgepa dang / rgyan rnams spangs pa dang / rta tsan ⑥ta ka zhabs ringashedad pa can la slar bskur 3)ba ni nyon mongs pa thams cad dang dbral bar bstan pa'o/ /kha spu bregs pa ni chos thams cad la mi chags par bstan pa'o/ /ka shashebur smrig gyon pa ni sems can 'dul bar bstan pa'o/ /drang srong u ta ka dang / a ran ta la chos 'dri rtog bya ba ni rang gi nga rgyal gyi sems 'joms par bstan pa'o/ /lo drug gi bar dulodaka' thub spyad pa ni mu stegs 'dul ba'o/ /zhal zas blangs pa ni 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'o//rtswa sutshwa)sti ka blangasatshwa pa ni chog shes par bstan pa'o/ /rtswa bting ba'i steng du bzhugs pa ni nyam rangs dang g.yel ba rnams 'joms par bstan pa'o/ /lha klu kun gyis bstod cing bsngags pa dang bsnyen bkur byas pa ④ni yon tan gyi 'bras bu la bkod par bstan pa'o/ /bdud rnams btulasnyib ni dpa' ba'i mthu bstan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa sa la bstan7pa ni bsod nams kyi mthu bstan 67—636

pa'o/ /sa chen po kun tu g.yo ba ni drin gyi lan ldon par bstanatupa'o/ /de ltar mtshan ma med par bsgoms pa'i phyir bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob pa yin no/ /'di ltar chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du mkhyen nas/chos kun mnyam pa nyid du bstan pasaphuni sangs rgyas zhes7bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la thub pa med de/ chos bstan to cog la sangs rgyas su 'grub pa'i don bstan pas ni de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /dus gsum gyi bya ba dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos mngon du gsal bar gzigs shing mkhyen pas na thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya'o⑤/ /bden pa dang yang dag par gsungs pa'i phyir lha dang mi'i mkhan po zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig de ltar bslab cing rtog pa ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de la log par rtog pa ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes mi bya ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad la bslurabab can zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas thams cad ni mi 'byung mi 'jug mi skye mi 'gog ste/ sems can thams cad rtsimya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir 'jig rten du 'byung ngo zhes brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da'o zhes brjod pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang yang dag par na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid ni stong pa nyid du rtogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'byung ba'am nub pa mi mnga' bas rgyal po'i pho brang du yang ma bltas)/ byang chub kyi shing drung du yang mya ngan las ma 'das/ mtha' las 'das te yun du gnas pa/ sems can yongs su bsgral par mdzad pa'i slad du dka' thub spyad cing mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan kyang yang dag par na 'gyur ba'am spros pa mi mnga' zhing de 67—637

bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul7du gnas te/ khams gsum na sku 'byung ba yang chos kyi sku rnam pa lnga 'byung ngo / /lnga po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sku yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / sku yon tan can⑧dang / sku chos kyi ngo bo nyid las skyes pa dang / sku sprul cing 'byung ba dang / sku nam mkha' lta bu dang lnga ste/ de la dusku yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid ces bgyi ba ni yang dag pa'i 'bras bu'i ④mchog mtshan masathams cad las 'das pa rang gi dbyings la yun du gnas pasalgen sku yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid ces bgyi'o/ /sku yon tan can zhes bgyi ba ni sems can mya ngan las bzla ba'i slad du spyod pa rnam 9)pa sna tshogs mdzad cing dge ba thams cad phun sum tshogs par mdzad pas na sku yon tan can zhes bgyi'o/ /sku chos kyi ngo bo nyid las skyes zhes bgyi ba ni chos kyi mtshan nyid thams cad thugs su chud de mi mkhyen pa ④mi mnga'/ spyod yul de la yang dag par mkhyen pa'i stong pa nyid las skyes te/ yang dag par rdzogs pas na sku chos kyi ngo bo nyid las skyes zhes bgyi'o/ /sku sprul cing 'byung ba zhes bgyi ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du 'byung yang lam rgyud lngar dge sdig kun la mngon par bstan cing skyabs su mi mdzad7pa ma mchis te/ sprul pa'i rdzas las mtshan du 'gyur bas na sku sprul cing 'byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /sku nam mkha' lta bu zhes bgyi ba ni nam mkha' mtha' yas pas na chos kyi sku yang mtha' yas so/ /nam mkha' la dpag pa dang gzhal du ma mchis pas na chos kyi sku yang dpag cing gzhal du ma mchis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yangs31nam mkha' chen po dang 'dra batshwa sems can yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i slad du sku rnam pa lngar ston pas na de bzhin gshegs pa la skye ba mi mnga'/ 'gag pa mi mnga' bar mngon no/ /67—638

chos thams cad kyang de bzhin te sems can yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i slad du sangs rgyas mngon du sprul cing chos rnam par spel ba lags 6)so zhes gsol pa dang ske/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'dra bar chos kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas pas spyod yul thams cad la bar〈bdu chod pa'am thogs pa med de/ rigs kyi bu khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa stong rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba dang / 'jig rten longs spyod can zhes bya ba der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sha dgasatheg pa chen po 'ba' zhig spyod de0/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i ming rna ba'i thog mar yang mi grag na ngan song lta zhig cing༄smos/ khyod bskal pa de dang 'jig rten der de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba5ge'abyung ste/ 'jig rten gzhan nas skyes bu chen po dag kyang der phyin cing theg pa chen po thar pa phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde mnyan pa dang / blangs pa dngamadu)/ bcangs par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na sems can gang la las byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos te phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa byas na 'jig rten longs spyod can gyi khams der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang la las theg pa chen po'i rtechos sgrub na yang mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di blang7 zhing bcangs pa des〈1ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba bcu ma 'das par lung bstan pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la byang chub sems dpa' nyugematshan nyid dad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad 67—639

kyi don gyi phyir zhus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis kyi mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi mtshan bstan nas yang seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs te① / seng ge'i sgra zhes bya ba ni nges pa'i tshig bstan pa'o/ /nges pa'i tshig bstan pa ni〈de bzhin gshegs pa rtag par 'tsho skyong zhing gzhes7te/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rig pa'o/ /yang sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid yod do zhes bstan pa dang / lha'i bdud dngasamu stegs la sogs pa spa gong ④ste/ skyabs kyi dbang du gyur pas na seng ge'i sgra zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bstan nas ljags kyi mtshan rgya chen pos stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi ༷khams kun khebs par g.yogs ④nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rnam pa drug tu g.yos zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ dbus mtho na mtha' dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma' ba ni sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos zhes bya'o / /ljags kyi drung nas 'od zer chen po btang ste phyogs bcur snang ba chen po byas so/ /snang ba chen po des mi rtag pa ni rtag par byas/ ma dag pa ni dag par byas/ sdug bsngal can ni bde bar byas/ ma rig pa ni rig par byasani / de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyis reg cing snang ngo cog la ri dang /nags tshal dang / yul sa dang / chu bo'i klung dang / rgya mtsho dang / lcags kyi ri khor yo)yug dang / dmyal ba la sogs pa thams cad kyang mtho dma'alge med par mnyam par gyur cing nyal nyil dang / ldan ljin med de/ kun kyang yongs 67—640

su dag par gyur nas 'di lta ste/ dper na shar phyogs na 'jig rten zla gang rnam dag yongs su brgyan dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku sprul pa ni/ nam mkha' nas bab pa ni7me tog gi char bab pa dang 'dra'o/ /sa 'og nas byung ba ni sprin dang / na bun byung ba dang 'dra bar nam mkha' yongs su gang ste nam mkha' stong pa cung zad kyang med do/ /sprul pa'i zhal so so nas tshig 'thun par de bzhin gshegs pa nibartag par 'tsho skyong zhing gzhes7te mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid yod do zhes gsungs/ yang chos thams cad ni stong pa nyid do zhes gsungs so/ /spyod lam de dag gi ④rgyu 'bras ni theg pa gcig tu zad pa las sems can gyis theg pa rnam pa ⑤gsum du mthong zhes bshad nas de ma thag tu kun mi snang bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das gdan la bzhugs pa nyi tshe snang ste/de'i tshe tshogs mang po thams cad kyis sku sprul pa de dag mthong ba ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i byin gyi rlabs7kyi mthu ste/ shākya thub pa yang byams pas 'di 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang / gzi brjid mngon par sprul pa de'i0tshe tshogs kyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i7klung bzhi bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /nyan thos brgyad khri zhig ni theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed do/ /dge slong stong phrag bcu zhig gis 3 )ni dgra bcom pa'i lam thob bo/ /dge slong ma khri brgyad stong zhig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i lam thob bo / /dge bsnyen5)khri phrag bzhi bcus ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i lam thob bo /dge bsnyen ma 'bum phrag bcu zhig ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i lam thob bo/ /lha dang mi grangs med pa zhig ni chos kyi mig rdul med pa dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag 67—641

pa thob ste/ rang gi tshe snga phyi shes pa dang 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag par mthong ngo / /de nas tshogs kyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i sgra dzo)stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisakhugong du bstan pa bzhin na ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos na yang sdig 'byang / chos kyi mtshan thos na yang sdig 'byang / dge 'dun gyi mtshan thos na yang sdig 'byang bar 'gyur ro zhes 'byung na/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu lags sam/ chos kyi mthu lags sam/ dge 'dun gyi mthu lags samakho/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu lags na ni sangs rgyas la gsol ba bgyi/ chos kyi mthu lags na ni chos la gsol ba bgyi/dge 'dun gyi mthu lags na ni dge 'dun la gsol ba bgyi ba ④lags na/gsum char la gsol brtsordo bgyi ci 'tshal/ gong na gsungs pa theg pa gcig la so so'i skye bos rnam pa gsum du mthong ngo zhes byung na/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis kyang gsum du bshad na sems can lta ci ༅zhig smos zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i〈sgra la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu sems can la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir don de lta bu 'dri ba yang shin tu legs tege / nyon cig dang57rings khyod la bye brag phyed par bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthu 'ba' zhig 1 )kyang ma yin/ chos kyi mthu 'ba' zhig kyang ma yin/ dge 'dun gyi mthu 'ba' zhig kyang ma yin te/ kun tshogs pa'i mthu bas〈nyesangs rgyas ni sems can gyi mgon 32skyabs kyi pha ma/ byang chub sems dpa' ni dge 67—642

ba'i bshes gnyen yin no/ /sems can bslad pa can sems stor ba slar rnyed de 'khor ba la ⑩skyo nas dran pa'i mthu mang pos khams gsum na nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral ②bar 'dod na phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'dis bsgral ba'i gru chen po byed do/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyang chos so/ /chos kyang dge 'dun no/ /dge 'dun ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus ma byas pa ni stong pa nyid de/ 'dus ma byas pa'i stong pa nyid dang 'dus byas kyi stong pa nyid dang / nang gi stong pa nyid dang / phyi'ishestong pa nyid dang / chen po'isnyistong pa nyid dang / chung ngu'i stong pa nyid kyang stong pa nyid du 'dra ste/ de las gzhan med do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod zerarnyub lta na/ rnam pa gcig tu bsgrubalgepa'i rigs kyi rnam pa gsum du bsgrub gci dgos zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na mi gcig cigashenam mkha' stong pas skrag ste/ gar phyin dgur cigab kyang nam mkha' dang yong ma bral lo/ /rigs kyi bu phyogs bcu'i (7de bzhin gshegs pas bshad pa dang / ngas bshad do cog dge ba thams cad kyi rgyu rkyen dang / dkon mchog gsum dang / theg pa gsum yang gcig las mi 'da'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge sgras gsol pa/ legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pas bstan pa ltar ni〈sgrubadag snga nas 'tshal te sems can rnams kyi slad du don de zhu ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa bzhin du mi gnyis mi gsum mo/ / thar pa chen po〈nyephyogs su rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni yum/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni shul chen po/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nikhemig ste/ lta ba log pa rnams sdud pa dang / sems stor ba rnams skyong ba dang /67—643

ngan song gsum gyi sgo gcod pa dang / bla na ma mchis pa'i byang chub kyi sgo 'byed pa dang / nyan thos rnams bzlog pa stel/ theg pa chen por 'dzud pa'i slad du bdag gis gzungs chen mo'i sngags kyis bsrung zhing bskyabalgepar bgyi'o/ /sdom pa ma nyams pa dang / mdo sde 'di la sgom zhing bslab par bgyid pa7de la yang bsrungs zhing bskyab par bgyi'o/ /gal te gang zag gang la las mdo sde 'di la bsnyen bkur bgyid cing dgung bdun gyi bar du spyad pa spyod pa la bdud sdig can gyis 'khrug cing / ⑤klags lta ba mchis na⑥bdud sdig can gyis glags kyi skabs mi rnyed par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mdo sde 'di la rim grosabagyis te/ yun ring por gnas par bgyi ba yang byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du gnas par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu khyod mdo sde 'di la rim gro bya ba ni dkon mchog gsum la rim gro bya ba dang 'dra'o/ /ston pa la yang rim gro bya ba dang 'dra'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' seng ge sgras bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gzungs sngags 'di skad ces smras so/ /na mo bud dhā 3 )ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mtshosang 55nyeya/a dan ti dhā ra tsā/ tar+ya thā ā kāshāgesha ni ba bīḍūdi/ sarba dharmācani ba ni/ i sha ma da/ pi pa sha na/ bi ma la su pa ri/ dharma ni kha na/ ba ra ru ni tsa ya ta ma le/ tsa le/ hu lu hu lu/ shi bi te/ man+t+ra man+t+ra/ masatsho)swā hā/sngags 'di dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing tunyemachod rten la lan bdun bskor ba tsho/)bgyi/ de ltar gdugs bdun gyi bar du mdo sde gzhan la mi bsam par gdugs gcig kyang dus gsum du phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'di la sems rtse gcig tu bgyi ste sems gzhan du mi g.yeng bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 67wa 644

'das gzungs sngags 'di ni sangs rgyas khri phrag brgyad brgyas gsungs pa ste/deng 'dir bdag gis kyang brjod pa lags so/ /gal te 'ga' zhig gzungs 'di la smod pa mchis na sangs rgyas de dag la smod par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di la smod pa ni tshe rabs du ma'i bar dushebyang chub tu bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ srid pa gsum las kyang mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/sngags 'di ni sems dran pa nyams pa rnams sems zhuslar rnyed par 'gyur ba 0dang ske/ gzungs 'di lan cig tsam rna bar thos sam/ thos nas yi ger bris te / sha dang chang mi 'tshal bar sdom pa la gnas shing bdag nyid rtsen rgya'ajo la sogs pa spangs te/ 'du 'dzi'i nang du mi 'jug la/ rgyun du byams pa chen po spyod cing bsam gtan la gces 6)par 'dzin na gang zag de dpag tu ma mchis pa'i sgrib pa gsum gyi sdig rtsi ba rnams 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu sems thag pa nas blang ba dang / bcang ba dang / nyin re zhing57klog pa dang / kha ton du bgyid pa0)dang / yi dam du mi bskyud par bgyid na gang zag de mngon par byang ma chub kyi bar du ngan song gsum du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod dkon mchog gsum gyi rim gro bya ba dang / byams pa'i sems kyis sems can rnams srid pa gsum las 'don pa dang / bslab pa mang po grangs med pa la phan pa dang / bde ba chen po bya ba'i phyir ston pa'i sgo 'byed cing log par lta ba rnams bzlog teste yang dag pa'i 3)lta ba la 'dzud pa'i phyir gzungs sngags 'di bshad pa ni shin tu'ang legs so/ /rigs kyi bu sems can thams cad gang 67—645

dgashekhyod kyi ming dang sngags kyi sgra thos nas dad pa dang gus pa bskyed de mi smod na gang zag de tshe 'di nyid la yang bde la/ 'chi 'phos na yang rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong zhing nga yang mthong la/ khyod la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya bar yang nges par rang gis rig ste the tsom med do/ /kun nas nyon mongs7spangs pa dang ske/ /dge ba kun gyi lam bsgrubs te/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin mthong ba yang ske/ /rnam dag dad pa'i dbang gis so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gang la las nyin gcig gam/ dus gcig gam/mtshan gcig gam/ skad cig ma gcig la phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing theg pa chen po tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa la bsamasasnyen gang zag de ni skad cig ma se'agegol gtogs pa tsam gyis mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang /mnyam pa nyid la skur pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las thams cad yongs su ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ dge sbyong ngam/ dge sbyong mas sems kyi rang bzhinashestor nas rtsa ba bzhi dang / sdom pa brgyad nyams pa dang /mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga byas pa dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur pa rnams phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la dad pa bskyed de phyag 'tshal na 'di lta bu'i las ngan pa kun ma lus par 'byang bar 67—646

'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal ma thag tu sngon sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur gyi dus na rgyal bu dge mthong zhes bya ba de'i tshe mi sum stong dang lhan cig tu skad cig ma der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs la mgo bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal nas tshig 'thun par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa nas kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las bgyis pa7lta zhig bshad kyis mi rdzogs te/ mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang mnyam pa nyid la skur pa'i sdigashegangs ma mchis par bgyis pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdo sde bcu gnyis la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol te/ 'gyod tshangs su gsol zhing mchis na skabs dbye b.rabaci gnang zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu 'jigs pa'i sems bskyed pa'ang dka' la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'ang dka' ste/ mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga mtholashobazhing 'chags par 'dod pa ni longasakyispyod la sogs pa yang sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid mthong du nye bas yid la dran pa bzhin du mthol zhing shogs shig /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong la sogs pa mi sum stong gis bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye bar gnang ba byams pa'i gsungashethos nas gos tshags bcos te thal mo sbyar cing phyag 'tshal nas bla gos phrag pa g.yas su gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs dunas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i chos la skyabs7su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o⑩/ /yang 'di lta ste/ shar phyogs 67—647

kyi sangs rgyas 'khrug pa (1mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o②/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo / /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /bla ma phyogs kyi sangs rgyas dri brtsegs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'og ma phyogs kyi sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan 'bum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang shar phyogs na skyes bu chen po kun tu bzang po la rtso)phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /lho phyogs na skyes bu chen po 'jin rten 'dzin la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /nub phyogs5snyen kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /byang phyogs na zla gang la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /bla ma phyogs na nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'og ma phyogs na skyes bu chen po brtan dpal la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang bdag cag gi mkhan po de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mi 'gyur ba mel yang mephyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid la〈phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /phyogs gzhan na sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /da ltar bdag cag gi mkhan po bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /skyes bu chen po dri ma med par grags pa dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la yang laphyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'phags pa dga' bo dang 'od srung la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'phags pa'i 'bras bu rnam bzhi mngon 67—648

par 'byungatub rnams la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /byang chub kyi sems dang po bskyed pa rnams la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /sde snod chen po gsung rab mdo sde bcu gnyis dang mnyam pa nyid yang dag pa'i mdo sde gzhan bzhugs so 'tshal la yang phyag 'tshal7zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /cha brgyad du bgos pa'i sku gdungasaring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ / da ltarasnyin sku gzugs bzhugs pa thams cad la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i dbang phyug dang / bar snang la gnas pa'i lha dang / sa'i lha dang / ri dang ske/ nags tshalasadang / shing drung gi lha dang / drang srong dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i spyan mnga' ba rnams dang /lha'i snyan mnga' ba thams cad kyi50snyan gyis gsan cing mkhyen par mdzod cig /kun dbang du gsol te/ sems can thams cad la ma mthol ma bshags pa zhig mchis na yang sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig /yang 'di dugeskad ces smras te④ / bdag cag thog ma matu)mchis pa nas da ltar gyi lus ngan pa 'di thob pa'i bar tu nor cing 'khrul pa'i sems kyis phyin ci log tu lta ba dpag tu ma mchis pa nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa brjod kyis mi lang stonye/ sdig pa'i tshogs bgyis tuskreso 'tshal rang gis ma tshor ma rig pas ngan sems rab tu rgyas te/ tshe phyi ma ma mthong zhing tshe 'di 'ba' zhig thenamathong bas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags la mos te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ring du gyur cing las ngan pas bar du chod nas sdig pa'i grogs po dang bsten cing dge slong dang / dge slong 67—649

ma la mi rigs mi tshul ba'i las bgyis pa dang / pha dang ma la mi rigs mi tshul ba'i las bgyis pa dang / yang bdag rang nyams kyishedabang gis dge 'dun gyi dkor nor thugs thub tu spyad pa dang / dge 'dun sde lnga la mi rigs mi tshul bar bgyis pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu dpag tu ma mchis par bshad pa'am/ byang chub kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa'i sems can bkum pa'am/ chos kyi slob dpon la skur te/ chos la chos ma lags zhes skur(ge/ chos ma lags pa ni chos lags zhes brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ni mi rtag ces bgyis/ dam pa'i chos la yang mi rtag go zhes bgyis / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang mi rtag go zhes bgyis/ sbyin pa dang shes rab la ni ma mos/ log pa'i chos la dad cing 'dzin pa de dag gi slad du deng 'jigs shing skrag pa dpag tu ma mchis/ khrel zhing ngo tsha ba yang dpag tu ma mchis te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni byams pa dang thugs rje mnga'amatshe ste/ phyogs su snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyenakhulags na bdag cag gi sdig pa bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa'i⑧'khor ba nas bgyis pa mthol zhing bshags par 'tshal na gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol zhing slan chad kyang mi bgyid par smon to/ /yang 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa tshun chad mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i bslab pa zhig par bgyis pa dang ske/ log spyod kyi spyad pa spyod pa dang / ngag rtsub mo gtong ba dang /dam pa'i chos la skur pa'i nyamalas ngan pa de dag 'gyod cing mthol ma myong ste/67—650

sems la gnong ba'4) ngo tsha ba ma mchis par mi dge ba bcu dang /mtshams ma mchis pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las lci ba nges par bgyis par rang gis 'tshal kyang nongs pa bcabasalgenasashe'ajigs shing skrag pa dang ske/ gnong zhingasrengo tsha ba'i sems thog ma nas ma mchis par dad pa can gyi mchod pa blangs nas mthol zhing bshags ma myong ste/ dam pa'i chos yun du btsugs7te rim gro bgyi ba'i sems ma mchis par rtag tu smos shing57brnyas pa dang / ngag gi sgo nas kun nas nyon mongs pa'i nongs pa mang po bgyis pa dang /ched na dkon mchog gsum yang med do zhes brjod pa dang / mi dge ba bcu dang ske/ mtshams ma mchis pa'i sdigatso)de dag bgyis pa'i slad du deng 'jigs shing skrag pa dpag tu ma mchis/ gnong zhing7khril pa dpag tu ma mchis te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni byams pa dang thugs rje mnga'7)ste phyogs su snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags na bdag cag gi sdig pa bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bgyis pa mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags par 'tshal na/ gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/slan chad kyang mi bgyid par smon to0/ /yang 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa tshun chad phyin ci log tu lta lta ste/ rtsa ba bzhi ni sbom por bshad/ sbom po ni rtsa ba bzhir bshad/ zhig pa rnams ni ma zhig par bshad/ ma zhig pa rnams ni zhig par bshad/ lci ba rnams ni yang bar bshad/ yang ba rnams ni lci bar bshad/ dag pa rnams ni ma dag par bshad/ ma dag pa rnams ni dag par bshad pa dang / yang log par lta 67—651

bas 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lagashel bstod cing bsngags nas chos dang mdo sde la ni ma gus te smre ngan gyi gtam rtag tu gleng zhing brjod pa dang / ma brtags pa'i norabarnam pa brgyad po 'chang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'aphuyang dag pa ni/ bdud kyi tshig go zhes bgyis pa dang / bdud kyi tshig yang dag pa ni ④de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'asnyizhes bgyis pa dang / mu stegs mkhan gyi tshig la yid ches par 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthar mya ngan las 'das te med pas dkon mchog gsum yang mi rtag7go zhes bgyis nas lus dang sems 'khrul cing phyin ci log tu lta ba dpag tu ma mchis pa'i slad du deng 'jigs shing skrag pa yangaphyedapag tu ma mchis/ gnong zhing ngo tsha ba yang dpag tu ma mchis te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni byams pa dang thugs rje mnga' ste/ phyogs su snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshesasheganyen lags na bdag cag gi sdig pa bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bgyis pa de dag mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol7zhing bshags par 'tshal na gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/ slan chad kyang mi bgyid par smon to/ /yang 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas tshe lus 'di la thug gi bar du dge 'dun spyi'i nor ram/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi nor ram/ /dasngom/ltar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyi nor ram/dge 'dun sde lnga'i nor ram/ dge slong gang zag gi nor ram/ yon bdag thams cad kyi nor rdzas la brkusarwa pa'am/ rang nyam du spyod pa dang / yang rang smos te/ bdag dam pa'i chos bsam gtan bzhi'am/ 'bras bu bzhi ma 67—652

thob par thob bo zhes smras ①pa la sogs pa rkyen de lta bu'i las ngan pa mi dge ba'i rgyu rkyen du gyur te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na yang pham pa bzhi dang ske/ sdom pa brgyad dang / drug dang / dge 'dun gyi lhag ma bcu gsum dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang / spang ba'i ltung ba sum cu dang /lhung ba dgu bcu dang / so sor bshags pa bzhi dang / bslab pa mang po dang ske/ bdun shin tu lci ba'i chos rnams te/ tshul khrims de dag re re la nyes byas nas pham pa la thug gi bar du nyams pa dang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis pa dang / dam pa'i chos dang / mdo sde zab mo la skur pa dang / log spyod kyi spyad pa spyod pa nas nongs pa bcabs te 'gyod cing mthol ma myong bas nyin mtshan du 'phel zhing skye ba sngon rgyal ba dag gis ②bshad pa las thos pa ni dam pa'i chos la skur pa'am/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis pa'am/ rtsa ba bzhi pham par gyur pa rnams ma bshags ma mthol na sems can dmyal bar nges par ltung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyabs mdzad par mi 'gyur/ dge 'dun dang / pha ma dang / lha rnams dang / mi rnams kyis kyang skyabs dang 'or ba bgyid mi nus so zhes byung bas na de'i slad du deng 'jigs shing skrag pa dpag tu ma mchis/ gnong zhing ngo tsha ba dpag tu ma mchis te/ de'i slad du deng dkon mchog gsum dang / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang dang /ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas stong dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das7ni byams pa dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ste/ phyogs su snyoms pa'i yab yum 67—653

lags / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags na bdag cag bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa tshun chad kyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / shes bya'ilcesgrib pa dang / pham pa bzhi dang /mtshams ma mchis pa dang / mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa'i sdig lci ba rnams mthol zhing bshags par 'tshal na gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/ yang 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das deng bdag cag gis〈sems can rnams dang /bdag cag rang rang gi slad du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i spyan sngar da dumathol zhing bshags par 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad kyis bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa tshun chad de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / pha ma'i drin glo bar ma chud pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i chos ma 'tshal7te/ mi dge ba sna tshogs bgyis pa dang / rang gi rigs snyems te/ dregs shing rgyags pa'i tshe kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las nyam bag ⑤tu bgyis kyang nongs par ma mthong bas skye bo blun po'i las bgyis pa dang / sdig pa'i bshes gnyen la bsten cing nyon mongs pas7sems 'khrugs pa dang / 'dod pa lnga'i yon tan la chog ma 'tshal te/mi dge ba'i las rnams bgyis pa dang / 'gro ba bzang mos bslus te 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi nyon mongs pas gzir cing sems 'khrugs te/ spros pa dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid gsum gyi sgo nas bstsags7pa'i las mi dge ba bdag rang gis bgyis pa dang / gzhan bgyid du stsal pa dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad deng so sor 'chags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ma bgyis pa'i sdig pa yang deng7so sor 67—654

shags7so mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas la yang bsnyen bkur ma bgyis pa'i sdig pa yangashedeng so sor 'chags sol/ /mthol lo mi 'chab bo/ /ma rig pa'i dbang gis dam pa'i chos la skur pasabatab pa dang / pha ma dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi drin glo bar ma chud pa'i slad du bsnyen bkur ma bgyis pa'i sdig pa de dag kyang deng so sor 'chags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /blun zhing rmongs pas bsgribs te/nyam rangs dang rgyags pas mi dge ba sna tshogs bgyis pa'i sdig pa de dag kyang deng so sor 'chags so/ /mthol lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la bdag cag gis7yon phul zhing mchod pas ni ma lus pa'i sems can de dag kun sa bcu la 'khod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal bu dge mthong la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /legs so skyes bu chen po rang gi las legs nyes kyi ⑤rtog pa la mkhas te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las la 'jigs pa dang skrag pa skyes nas nyes pa rnams mngon par mthol ba'i steng du sems can gyi sdiganyemang po yang khyod kyis mthol zhing bshags57pa'i phyir khyod ni skyes bu dam pa yang dag pa zhes bya'o/ /rang gi nyon mongs pa spong ba'i steng du sems can kunasnyenas nyon mongs pa7yang ring du dbral bar byas pas de'i phyir khyod ni skyes bu dam pa yang dag pa zhes bya ba yin te/ rang gi don du smon pa ma yin gyi0/ thog mar sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar smon lam 67—655

btab pa'i phyir khyod ni skyes bu dam pa yang dag pa skyes bu dam pa yang dag pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong la sogs pa mi sum stong gis 'gyod tshangs bgyis pa'i 'og tu bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de 'di skad ces bstod do/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig gtso bo mchog① /khams gsum pha ma thams cad mkhyen/ /thams cad mi mnyam mnyam pa nyid/ /bcom ldan dkon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye bo sbyin gtong rang gi phyir/ /nor rdzas byin cing lan yang re/ /byams chen rgyal ba de min te/ /dgra gnyen byams dngakhuphan snyoms mdzad/ /rkang gnyis nang na rgyal ba btsun/ /shes rab spyan gyis mkhyen gzigs la/ /brtson 'grus che bdag skyabs su mchi/ /lha gzhan shes rab de ma 'tshal/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun la bdag phyag 'tshal / /de bzhin rgyal la7skyabs gsol pa'ang / /dus gsum rgyal ba mchod pa bzhin/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong la tshigs su bcad de bstod pa/ gang zhig sangs rgyas 'grub 'dod pal/ /mang du thos la 'brang bar byos/ /slob dpon dge la bkur byas na/ /sangs rgyas 'grub la yun mi ring / /gang zhig tshul khrims rnam dag spyodam / /de ni dge slong yang dag yin/ /gang zhig stong par sgomanyenus pa/ /de ni ting 'dzin thob ces bya/ /gang zhig brtson 'grus spyod nus pa/ /de ni byang chub spyoda'akhyapa'o/ /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' 'gyur ba/ /de ni dga' ba yang dag pa'o/ /tshul khrims 'dzin pa'i dge slong dang / /rnam dag khrims 'dzin dge slong ma/ /zla ba phyed cing gso sbyong byos/ /chos gos rnam pa lus gyon te/ /lhung bzed gsog tsogashang thogs nas su/ /rnam dag bsod snyoms 67—656

'gro byas na/ /lha rnams kun kyang dga' 'gyur bas/ /thal mo sbyar cing gus phyag 'tshal/ /ngas kyang lha dang mi rnams kun/ / de yi7bya ba byed du gzhug②dper na lha bran thams cad kyis/ / lha yikhudabang po brgya byin la/ /rim gro gus par byed pa bzhin/ /da ltar 'phral du'ang lan thob ste/ /phyi ma'i dus su 'ang dpag tu med/ /rab tu byung zhing khrims 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas drin lan lon zhes bya/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /nga dang sems dpa' ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten pa yi7mi kun kyang / /rnam dag dad pa'i sems bskyedakyido/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag kun/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs/ /chos dang dge 'dun de bzhin te/ /de ltar mngon par shes pa ni/ /sangs rgyas drin lan lon zhes bya/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /'jig rten pa yi7mi dag kun/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i sems med cing / /theg pa gcig la ma mngon par shes/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs pa/ /phyogs bcu dang ni da lta'i rnams/ /sangs rgyas theg chen gcig pu la/ /gnyis sam gsum zhes bya7med par/ /de ltar yidashel bskyed nas su/ /sems nyu1kyis rnam par mi rtog na/ /de lta bu yi mi rnams ni/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan lon zhes bya / /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /gang zag la la 'ga' zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das phyi na/ /rtag tu dad pa'i sems bskyed de/ / sems can5)kun la sangs rgyas kyi/ /bdag nyid yod par bshad pa ni/ /de lta bu yi〈nyegang zag rnams/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan 8lon zhes bya/ /gang zhig skad cig dge spyod cing / / lha yim8'bras bu mi re ste/ /cig car bla med lam bsgrubs na/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan lon zhes bya/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /67—657

sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das phyi na/ /gal te gang zag 'ga' zhig gis/ /yud tsam mdo sde 'di bklags7te/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus byas shing / /mkhan la sridabazhu mchod byas na/ /de lta bu yisnyigang zag rnams/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan7lon zhes bya/ /gang zhig nor rdzas sna 'ga' 'am/ /kha zas dang ni gos kyi rnams/ /kun la khyab par sbyin byas na/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan lon zhes bya/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /nga yi chos rnams 'jig pa na/ /gang zhig 'ga' la blo bstan ⑦nas/ /yud tsam mdo sde 'di mnyan na/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum brgya la/ /mchod pa phul bas de lhag go/ /theg chen mdo sde 'di dag kyang / /sangs rgyas byang chub kun gyi yum/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /mdo sde 'di la dran byas te/ /snyoms sems phan tshun gnyis med na/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan⑧lon zhes bya/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /gang zhig chos 'di 'jigashepa'i tshe/ /rgyal ba'i drin lan blan 'dod pas/ /skad cig yud tsam sgom byed pas( )/ /stong khams gang ba'irwatesems can gyi/ /srog gi sbyin pa byin pa turtebs/ /bsam gtan bsgomatshwanyepa yon tan che/ /gang zhig bsgom cil skur pa dang / /dge 'dun 'khrugs par byed pa ni/ /stong khams gsum po gang ba yi/ /mi rnams kyi ni srog bcad dang / /srog chags thams cad bsad dang 'dra/ /de sdig yang ni de bzhin no/ /gang zhig dge spyod mthong ba la/ /skur pa 'debs shing ma dad pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs gcod pas/ /des〈nyeni rgyal ba'i lan mi ldon/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong po bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bstan par gnang ba dga' bas tshim nas bstan nyu3pa nyid spyi bos7blangs te/ tshigs su 67—658

bcad pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi7bstan pa la/ /gang mang lags shing gang mi mang / /mang dang mi mang gnyi ga yang / /dngos po dmigs su yong ma mchis/ /yang dag mtshan nyid de lta bu/ /chos rnams kun dang mi 'gal lo/ /sems can kun la byams slad du/ /thabs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'phags pa gang nas byon pa nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang de nas byon/ /yang dag mtshan nyid ji'ulta bdu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /'phags pa⑥kun gyi bden tshig ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang de bzhin bshad/ / de yi7slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /de bzhin gshegs zhes bgyi ba lags/ /bzod pa'i go cha brtan7pa'i sems/ /sra ba'i gzhu stobs gebartson 'grus che/ /rno ba'i mda' ni shes rab mgyogs/ /le lo'i dgra rnams 'joms mdzad cing / /'jig rten lha dang mi rnams kyi/ /mchod yon phul ba bzhes pas na/ / de yi7slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /dgra bcom zhes ni bgyi ba lags/ /rab tu sdug bsngal mtshan nyid mkhyen/ /sdug bsngal rgyu yang shin tu mkhyen/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i mtshan nyid la/ /zhi ba'i tshul yang rab tu mkhyen/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi mkhyen pas na/ /'gyur ba ma mchis bden par nges/ /de bas phyogs bcu'i nang na yang / /mtshan ni yang dag rdzogs zhes bgyi/ /rig pa gsum po mchog brnyesamatshepas/ /spyod lam rnam dag dang yang ldan/ /de slad mtshan ni bcom ldan 'das/ /mkhyen dang zhabs su ldan zhes bgyi/ /chos rnams thams cad kun mkhyen cing / /dam pa'i chos nyid rab brnyesamanyepas/ /thams cad kun la byams slad du/ /dus skabs sbyar zhing thabs kyis7)bshad/ /skye rga na 'chi rab bsal cing / /bde 67—659

ba'i gnas su phyin par mdzad/ /de yi slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /bde bar gshegs zhesatubagyi ba lags/ /'jig rten gang nas mchis pa dang / /'jig rten bas pa'i mtha' yang mkhyen/ /de yi slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'jig rten mkhyen zhes bgyi ba lags/ /thugs rje chen pos sems can bsgral/ /mnyenabades dge ba bstan cing btul/ / de yisaslad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyuradu/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab spyan⑤/ /thub cing bla ru 'da' ba med/ / de yi slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /bla na med ces bgyi ba lags/ /nyon mongs mi mnga' shes rab ldan/ /rnam grol dam pa mchog bshad pas/ / de yi7slad du rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /lha dang mi yi ston zhes bgyi / /dus gsum g.yo 'am mi g.yo ba/ /bas sam ma bas chos kun yang / /byang chub shing drung kun mkhyen pas/ /de yi slad du mtshan sangs rgyas/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams rdzu 'phrul chen po'i〈nyeting nge 'dzin du zhugs nas sku spunam mkha' la 'phags te zhal so so nas tshig 'thun par 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong po khyed rnams kyi sdig gi rang bzhin ni nang na yang mi gnas/ phyi rol na yang mi gnas/ bar na yang mi gnas so/ /sems brtan pa'i phyir dge ba'i mthu yang brtan sko)/ /sems〈nyernam par grol ba'i phyir sdig gi rang bzhin yang rnam par grol lo/ /shes rab stong pa nyid kyi phyir sdig gi rang bzhin yang stong pa nyid do/ /dad pa'i mthu che ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi mthu yang che'o/ /de bzhin du mthol bshags te 'gyod tshangs nus pa ni nged rnams mthong ba'i steng du sangs rgyas rin chen mang dang / sprul pa'i sku thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'gyod tshangs 67—660
