kyis sdig sbyangs pas rgyun du nga yang mthong la/ deng byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan bcos pa dang 'dra bar de bzhin du 'gyod tshangs byas pa ni nga dang sprul pa'i sku0rnams dang / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang la sogs pa thams cad kyang dgyes par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang dgyes par 'gyur te/ theg pa chen po'i mimado sde 'di'i rjes su byang chub tu chud ②par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor zhabs ringasreb rnams la bka' stsal pa / sdig can rnams kyis sdig bshags par 'dod na/ rgyal bu dge mthong bzhin du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la/ re re nas dmigs te phyag 'tshal ba nga dang phrad pa dang 'dra ba'am/ mthong ba dang 'dra bar 'du shes bskyed de/ sangs rgyas gcig gam/ sangs rgyas gnyis sam/ sangs rgyas bcu'am/ sangs rgyas brgya'am/ sangs rgyas stong ngam/ sangs rgyas khri'am/sangs rgyas grangs med pa'i 'du shes su bskyed de/ mthong ba dang 'dra bar dmigs la/ de bzhin du re re nas dmigs te ④sems kyis phyag 'tshal na de dag gis bsod nams dpag tu med pa yang thob par 'gyur la/ 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba thams cad kyang sel bar byed do/ /bskal pa grangs med pa'i bar du ngan song gsum du ltung bar mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la bde bar gnas par 'gyur bar ④yang nges te the tsom med sno/ /de'i phyir sdig pa rnams mthol zhing bshags par byas la sems thag pa nas dad pa bskyed na gdon mi za bar sdig pa byang7bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong 67—661

gis cig car du skad bskyed de/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de bstod pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan byams shing thugs rje che/ /shākyikya'i gdung rigs chos kyi rje/ /tshogs kyi nang na seng ge'i sgras/ /khyab par sems can bsdus pa ni/ /pha la gzigs pa bu gcig bzhin/ /rnam par 'byed pa yongasam mchis/ /de lta bu yi bla med pa/ /mthong nas de slad gus phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag khyed rnams 'di ltar 'gyod tshangs ④byas te/ mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags pas da ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /khyed rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas su 'grub bo/ /rigs kyi bu yang 'di lta ste/ nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gang zhig sems thag pa nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams〈snyel phyag 'tshal bar nus pa ni dkon mchog gsum gyi drin gyi lan lon zhes bya ba ⑥ste/ de ma thag tu mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur〈pepa'i sdig byang bar gyurasnyinas rgyun tu zhugs par 'os pa ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sbyin no/ /lan cig phyir 'ong bar 'os pa ni lan cig phyir 'ongasheba'i 'bras bu sbyin no/ /phyir mi 'ong bar 'os pa ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sbyin no/ /dgra bcom par 'os pa ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu sbyin no/ /rang sangs rgyas su 'os pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu sbyin no/ /byang chub sems dpar 'os pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'bras bu sbyin no/ /da ltar mdo sde 'di'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' sems 67—662

dpa' chen po rnams skye ba gcig gis yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid thob pa yang phyogs bcu dus gsum7gyi sangs rgyasaphul phyag 'tshal ba'i yon⑧rna/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gnyis kyis chos kyi dbyings thob pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa'i mthar phyin pa'i ye shes thob pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la las don dam pa'i bden pa khong du chud pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no / /byang chub sems dpa' la las dpa'akhubar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa duyang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la lasalgenam mkha'i mdzod kyilating nge 'dzin dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin khyadang ldan pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la las phyir mi ldog pa'i bzod pa dang / chos sbyin gyi bzod pa dang / chos bzhin gyi dbyings tunyeldan pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no / /byang chub sems dpa' la las gzungs dran pa chen po'i sems dang /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i〈nyesangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la las seng ge'i sgra'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes lnga'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la las mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /67—663

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam dang ldan pa yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i ①sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i yon no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rje 'jam dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad nor cing 'khrul pasnyesems 'khrugs te/ mi dge ba dang mtshams ma mchis pa bgyis pa rnams ji ltar bgyis na sdig 5)rnamyo/sa 'byang bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal la bka' stsal pa/ gong du bstan pa yin te / gang lakhulas phyogs su rgyas pa'i chos kyisnyernam grangs 'di dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan thos nas dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba bskyed la dad pa dang gus pa dpag tu med pas blangs sam/ 'changarkyangam/ klog gam / 'don tam/ yi ger bris sam/ kun chub par byas te/ dben pa'i gnas khang phyagacig gi shinang du dkyil 'khor byas la dri chus chag chag btab ste / 'phan gdugs bzang pos brgyan cing pog spos zhim po bsregs nas rgyal ba rnams spyan drang 7zhing gshegs su gsol ba mang yang rung / nyung yang rung spyan drangs nas bdag khrus dag par byas la/ gos gtsang ma gyon cing lan cig phyi rol che chung du 'gro na khrus lan gcig byas te seng ge'i khri btsugs te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du bsgoms la/ chos kyi mtshan nyid la bdag dang /gang zag dang / sems can la sogs pa'i lta ba med par mngon par rtogs par bya ste/ dang po pas bye brag phyed cing gsal bar brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dri spos zhim po bsregs hunyel 'khrug sems bsal cing dran pa yang dag pa 67—664

dang bsam pa yang dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa la sems rtse gcig tu bsam mo/ /de ltar spyod pa rnams 'thun zhing 'dum7pa ni mchog ste/ de la mi 'thun zhing rtsod pa ni mthol tshangs su mi 'gyur ro/ /khro ba des kun 'jig par byed de spyod lam dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po dran zhing don dam pa bsamasakhul nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du nyal zhing gnyid log tu mi rung ngo ske/ /nyin gcig kyang dus gsum dulamado sde 'di kha ton nam/ klog pa nyin mtshan dus drug tu byas la dri bsung gis byamachod cing phyag 'tshal nas mthol tshangs su byas te/ mdo sde 'di nyan na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis kyi mtshan brjod cing sems thag pa nas mi 'khrugs pa dang / sems thag pa nas mi nor ba dang / sems thag pa nas mi g.yeng ba dang / sems thag pa nas dus kyis 'grus pa dang / sems thag pa nas nyin gcig pas nyin gcig 'grus pa dang / sems thag pa nas dad pa bskyed pa dang / sems thag pa nas dga' ba bskyed pa dang / sems thag pa nas rim pa bskyed pa dang / sems thag pa nas rgyun mi bcad ⑤pa dang /sems thag pa nas gzab pa yidang / sems thag pa nas mi 'bral ba dang /sems thag pa nas sdig7mi bsams phya)pa dang / sems thag pa nas sangs rgyas dran pa dang / sems thag pa nas chos dran pa dang / sems7thag pa nas dge 'dun dran pa dang / sems thag pa nas tshul khrims dran pa dang /sems thag pa nas gtong ba dran pa dang / sems thag pa nas don dam pa'i lha dran pa ste/ de dag de bzhin du klog pa dang / de bzhin du phyag bya bakhedang /de bzhin du sems thag pa nas so sor 'chags shing mthol ba thog ma'i nyin par 67—665

nas zhag drug tu lon pa'i nang par dri chus yang chag chag btab ste/ lus kyangatuspos chus bkru bar bya'o/ /pog spos bzang po bsreg cing sems thag pas mchod pa mibyas pa de dag de lta bur sems thag pa nas so sor mthol zhing bshags pas phyogs bcur bskulasapar gyur te/ nga de'i tshe de'i dus na sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi ⑤bye ma snyed dang 'grogs te dusgra dbyangs kyi rjes su khang bu de'i nang du phyin cing mngon du grub pa'i dbang bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du byas na gdon mi za bar sdig 'byang bar 'gyur ro / /ji ltar sdig 'byang bar shes she men/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyi don dam par da dung ma grub pas rmi ltas kyi mtshan ma la brtag tu ④byas te/ rmi lam rnam gcig rmis na mtshams med pa rnam gcig 'byang ngo / /rmi lam rnam lnga rmis na mtshams med pa rnam lnga 'byang ste/ des nub mo'i mi lam na chu klung chen po brgal bar 'dod de zam pa chen po'i steng du 'gro bar rmis na de ni nges par rnam par grol ba thob pa yin no/ /gal te de'i mi lam na gzhan gyis bdag la khrus byas pa dudang / lus la char bab par rmis na de ni nges par rnam par dag pa thob pa yin no/ /gal te de'i mi lam na bdag dge 'dun mang po'i nang du zhugs te/ gral du 'dug par mis na de ni nges par sangs rgyas kyi slob ma yang dag par gyur to/ /gal te de'i rmi lam na bdag mchod rten namanya/ gtsug lag khang du zhugs te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan mthong bar mis na de ni kyichos kyi sgo mo dam par zhugs par gyur to/ /gal te rang gis shing thog rnyed57cing za bar rmisalgen de'i tshe 67—666

'di nyid la yon tan gyi 'bras bu 'grub par mngon no/ /yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal la bka' stsal pa/ gal te dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am / dge sbyong ngam/ dge sbyong ma'am/ byang chub sems dpa' dad pa can gang la las dran pa nyams te/ nor cing 'khrul pas sdom pa'i tshul khrims re re nas zhig pa'am/ nyams pa de bzhin du so sor 'chags shing mthol na sdig mi 'byang mi srid de/ sems thag pa nas ma byas pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das cho ga 'di ltar bgyi ba'i tshe mi mang na rung ngamanyemi rung / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi gcig yan chad nyi shu man chad rung ngo / /cho ga 'di ltar ②spyod pa'i tshe mdo sde gzhan mi bsam mo/ /de ltar mthol tshangs ③bgyis pa'i 'og tu phyin chad nyes pa mi byed na de ni mthol tshangs zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dran par gyis shig /bdag cag rnams da ltar 'chi ba las slar 'tsho ba dang 'dra bas da ④ni bdag tshul khrims bsrung ⑤ngo / /da yini bdag brtson 'grus su spyod do/ /da ni bdag theg pa chen po'i mdo sde klog pa dang / kha ton bgyi'o zhes de'i tshe de'i dus na dran pa de ltar gyis shig /bdag deng nas sdom pa bzung ba ni rdo rje dang 'dra bar sran thub par smon to/ /des de ltar dran pa'i tshe skyes bu dam pa dri ma med par grags pa yang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang lhan cig tu de'i mdun du 'greng ste dbang du byed do/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang po yang 'gyod tshangs kyi mkhan po byed do/ /'phags pa 'od srung yangashezhu gnas kyi rten7byed do/ /'jam dpal 'di ni sdig pa sbyangs pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rnam par grol ba zhes bya'o/ /'di ni tshul khrims 67—667

dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni gnas thob pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gang la la zhig gis rtsa ba bzhi dang / sdom pa brgyad dang ske/ sdom pa phyed can dang / khrims bcu dang / gsum la skyabs su song ba dang / khrims lnga dang / dge ba bcu dang / tshul khrims dang 'dul ba re re nas zhig pa'am/ nyams pa'am/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'am/ mnyam pa nyid la skur pa'i sdig byas pa zhig yod pa de log spyod ma gtogs par so sor ma bshags ma mthol na mi de tshe 'phos ma thag tu gdon mi za bar mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du mnar ma mchis7pa'i dmyal ba zhes bgyi②/ de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad kyi don gyi slad du de ci'i rgyu gci'i rkyen gyis nyung ba dang / dmyal ba'i dbyibs griche chung dang / rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsngal bskal pa'i grangs ji tsam gyi bar du gnas par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol zhes bgyis pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal shin tu'ang mkhas so/ /shin tu'ang mkhas so/ /don 'di lta bu 'dri ba yang shin tu mkhas te'u/ legs par nyon la phal mang po rnams kyang legs par soms shig /ngas bye brag phyed par bshad do/ /ji ltar nashemanar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba zhes bya zhe na/ skad cig kyang mnar zhing bstir med pa'i phyir mnar med pa'i dmyal ba zhes bya'o/ /gcig tu na dgag pa'am/ 'orashebar bya ba yang med/ 'gyur ba'ang med de/ tsha ba ni rab tu tsha/ sdug bsngal brkyani shin tu'ang mi bzad pa skad cig kyang mi dal/ skad cig kyang mi sdod 67—668

cing bar skabs med pa'i phyir mnar med pa'i dmyal ba zhes bya'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ me chen po 'bar ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ kun tu 'bar①/rab tu 'bar zhing / mched pa khong du zhugs pa'i phyir mnar med pa'i dmyal ba zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yangakhu'ajam dpal la bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa'i dbyibs ni gru bzhi lham pa dpag tshad brgyad khri yod de/ lcags kyi ra ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor cing steng du yang lcags kyi dra ba rim pa bdun gyis g.yogs te/ 'og tu bar chad bcwasabargyad yod do/ /de'i kho ra khor yug tu ral gri'i tshal rim pa bdun gyis bskor to/ /lcags kyi ra ba rim pa bdun gyi nang logs su nags tshal ral gri ⑤lo ma can yod do/ /lcags kyi khang pa bar chad bcwakhebargyad po brtsegashemar 'dug ste/ rim pa brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /de'i ga⑧bzhir zangs kyi khyi chen po bzhi 'dug pa lus kyi bong tshad ni 'phang du dpag tshad bzhi bcu la/mig ni klogashegi 'od bzhin/ mche ba ni ral gri'i 1 )sdong po dang 'dra/ so ni spu gri gtams5)pa'i ri dang mtshungs/ lce ni lcags kyi mchil ba bzhin/ sder〈nyemo ni lcags kyi gsal〈nyeshing dang mtshungs/ mjugatsom ni lcags kyi sbrul dang 'dral/ spu'i bu gu 8re re nas 'bar ba'i me shin tu mched cing kun tu 'bar rab tu 'bar ba 'byung ste/ de'i dud pa mnam pa ni 'jig rten gyi rdzas mnam pa gang dang yang bsgrun du med do/ /dmyal ba de'i sgo bzhi la5)sgo re re na dmyal ba'i srung ma bcwa5)brgyad 'dug go/ /mgo ni srin po'i mgote/ kha ni srin po'i kha dang 'dra ste/ mgo la rwa bcwa brgyad yod pa/ lag na lcags kyi gsal shing thogs so/ /ra ba rim pa bdun gyi nang logs su lcags kyi rgyal 67—669

mtshan grangs med pa zhig yod de①/ rgyal mtshan gyi mgor me byung ba ni chu mig dang 'dra bar 'byung ngo / /lcags 'ju ba'i khu ba 'bab pa ni kun tu khyab par 'bab ste/ dmyal ba'i sgo bzhir sgo re re'i steng na zangs po che bcwa ②brgyad ③yod pa'i nang na lcags khol ba'i khu ba khar lud cing sgo bzhir bab pa/ dmyal ba'i nang du gang bar 'bab bo/ / khang pa bar chad re re'i nang na yang lcags kyi sprul chen po brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pas khar gdug⑧pa'i me skyug cing ra ba kun tu gang bar gtong ngo / /sbrul gyi sgra sgrogs pa ni 'brug sgra chen po zer ba bzhin no/ /lcags kyi thu lum chen po'i char bab pa yang mnar med pa kun tu gang ngo / /der sdug bsngal mi bzad pa ni 'bum phrag brgyad khri ste7sdug bsngal gyi nang na sdug bsngal mi bzad7pa'i nang na mi bzad pa kun kyang der 'dus te dpe zla med do/ /mnar med pa'i dmyal ba de'i sgo bzhir sgo re re'i phyi rol tu 'bar ba'i me shin tu mched cing 'bar ba lho byang shar nub bsnol zhing phyad yi par rgyu'o/ /'bar ba yang lcags kyi ra ba kho ra khor yug dpag tshad5nyebargyad khri nas steng lcags kyi dra ba la thug gi bar du yar〈gethal mar thal zhing bla zarwanye'og dang ske/ phyogs bzhir kun tu 'bar/ rab tu 'bar bar gyur ④te/ sdug bsngal cig car ldang ba ni gong du smos pa bzhin no/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang / sdom pa brgyad 'jig pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur pa 'debs pa rnams mdo sde 'di las 'byung ba bzhin mthol tshangs ma byas la(nye/gnong bskur ba'am/ khrel ba med na mi de tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu stobs tshan 8po che'i dpung pa brkyang zhing tunyebaskums pa tsam gyis mnar med pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyang de'i nang du gang dze+e/ tsha ba'i 67—670

gzir bas phongs nas kha gdangs mig btsums mig gdangs kha btsums7kyang kha 'thams pas smra ma nus so/ /de sdig mang ba'i phyir ral grisa'akhor lo grangs med pa du ma zhig nam mkha' nas char bzhin 'bab ste/ klad5snyepar phog cing rkang par byung ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad ni sngar gong du bshad pa bzhin brgyakyistong khri phrag tu bsgyur ba'o/ /gang la la rtsa ba bzhi po tshang bar zhig par gyur na sdug bsngal chen po nyams su myong ba ni bskal pa chen po lnga rdzogs kyi bar du'o//sdom pa brgyad 'jig pa ni de las gyur cig gis mang ngo / /mtshams med pa lnga yang gyur nicig gis mang ngo / /mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo sde la skur pa 'debs pa yang gyur7cig gis mang ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la dmed〈kye pa dang / dge 'dun gyi nor brkus07pa dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma tshangs par spyad pa la dri ma can du spyod pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la dbang za tunyeb dang / ma la g.yem pa rnams gong ma dag las kyang gyurarwa cig gis bskyed do/ /log spyod kyi rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba gtan chad pas nams kyang 8mnar med pa'i dmyal ba nas mi thar ba ni der ma gtogs so/ /de la sogs pa'i sdig can rnams sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i tshe 'bar ba'i me shin tu mched pa khong du zhugs te rmugs nas 'chi'o8/ /de nas srin po dmyal ba'i srungasalgems lcags kyi gsal shing sa la brdabs te/ sos sos zhes bos pa dang / bos pa'i sgra bzhin du yang sos yang sos hunyenas nyin mtshan gcig la lan khri ni 'chi/ lan khri ni 'tsho ste/ sdug bsngal mi bzad pa chen po nyams su myong ba ni gong du bstan pa bzhin no/ /nam zhig mnar med pa'i dmyal ba nas slar phyin na yang tshul khrims bshigatshwanyepa dang / yon bdag dad pa can gyi yon blangs pa'i las kyisalge67—671

yang dmyal ba chung ngu rnams kyi nang du 'jug ste/ de la dmyal ba grang zabasatupa dang / dmyal ba mun nag pa dang / dmyal ba rab tu tsha ba dang / dmyal ba spu gli⑧so gtamasalgepa dang / dmyal ba ral gri 'khor lo dang / dmyal ba me'i shing rta can dang / dmyal ba phyi sa'i 'dam dang / dmyal ba chu tshan dang /dmyal ba me mur klung dang / dmyal ba nags tshal ral grikhulo ma can dang /dmyal ba lcags kyi 'khrul7'khor can dang / dmyal ba lcags kyi shalasnyem ri ka ba can dang / dmyal ba lcags kyi khri can dang / dmyal ba lcags kyi 'khor lo can dang / dmyal ba lcags kyi phug dang / dmyal ba lcags kyi thu lum dang /dmyal ba bsdus 'joms thug ri can dang / dmyal ba zangs khu lud7dang /'di rnams so sosngo) re re'i nang du yang lo khri phrag brgyad brgya'i bar du nyon mongs nas gzodasngonathar te/ 'on kyang rtag tu ma rabs su skyes la/ tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra mi thos so/ /brgya la dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad na ni byang chub tu sems bskyed kyang srid/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma phrad na ni slar yang dmyal bar ltung ngo / /nyes byas kyi ⑩sdig pa rnams ma mthol ma bshags na dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong ba yang rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha'i lo grangs lta bur lo khri phrag brgyad brgya'i bar du nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la ltung ba rnams kyi sdig pa ni de las nyis gyur du bskyed do/ /dge 'dun gyi lhag ma yang de las nyis gyur du bskyed do/ /sdig can de dag gis7sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i tshe tshig gzhan mi phyin te/ ā pa pa/ zhi ta ta/ 45nyel la/ 〈〈sheb ba 'ba' zhig0 zer zhing 'dug go/ /de bas na sdig can rnams rings par so sor mthol zhing bshags la/ dkon mchog 67—672

gsum gyi7skyabs su song bar gyis shig /'jam dpal yang 'di lta ste/ sdig pa myur du bsal cings/ ci 'byang bar 'dod na mdo sde 'di'i nang nas 'byung ba bzhin du so sor mthol bshags te 'gyod tshangs byos shig /cho ga nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du nyin gcig zashegacig tu byas la/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang /yang dag pa'i dran pas de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas su 'grub pa'i tshe mi chen po'i mtshan dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i mtshan dang / mi g.yo ba'i mtshan dang / rnam par grol ba'i mtshan dang / 'od zer can gyi mtshan dang / ye shes yongs su rgyas pa'i mtshan dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang ldan pa'i mtshan dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mtshan rnams bsam par bya'o/ /yang gcig tu na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i yidakyidam pa'i7ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ yid 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin du 'jug par bya'o/ /yid 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin las langs te slar dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug par bya'o/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin las langs te shes rab sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /shes rab sgron ma las langs te chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid las langs te mtshan ma 'od zer can gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /mtshan ma 'od zer can las langs te seng ge'i nga ro'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug / seng gesheng rosnyilas langs te seng ge sprug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /seng ge sprug pa las langs te rgya mtsho yid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /rgya mtsho yid las langs te kun tu ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /kun tu ye shesashelas langs te gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i 67—673

ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /gzungs kyi phyag rgya las langs te kun tu snang ba'i lus gzugs can gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /kun tu snang ba'i lus gzugs can las langs te chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /chos kyi dbyings nyid las langs te seng ge'i rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /seng ge'i rgyal po las langs te chos kyi rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /chos kyi rgyal po las langs te bdud rnams kyi mtshan ma 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /bdud rnams kyi mtshan ma 'gog pa las langs te stong pa nyid kyi shes rab kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /stong pa nyid kyi shes rab las langs te stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du shes pa las langs te chen po stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /chen po stong pa nyid kyi ye shes las langs te gnas thams cad du khyab pa'i lus gzugs can gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /gnas thams cad du khyab pa'i lus gzugs can las langs te sems kyi mtshan nyid la rnam par rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /sems kyi mtshan nyid la rnam par rtog pa las langs te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i mtshan nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i mtshan nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las langs te rdo rje'i gtsug tor gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /rdo rjeshegatsug tor las langs te rgya mtsho thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /rgya mtsho thams cad las langs te gzungs thams cad kyi rgya mcho'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /gzungs thams cad kyi rgya mtshokhulas langs te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul gyi rgya mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /sangs rgyas 67—674

thams cad kyi spyod yul rgya mtsho las langs te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i rgya mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i rgya mtsho las langs te gdod thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' med mu med pa'i rgya mtsho'i sgor 'jug par bya'o/ /mtha' med mu med pa'i rgya mtsho'i sgo nas langs te yid 'gog pa dang zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug /yid 'gog pa dang zhi ba las langs te rdo rje gdon mi za ba'i rnam par grol ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug par bya'o/ /'jam dpalatung mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la las dad pa skad cig ma'i sems bskyedabade/ mdo 'di yi ger 'dridza ba'am/ klog pa'am/kha ton du skad cig mar dran te/ bsam pa'i 'du shes dang / dran pa'i 'du shes dang / rtogs pa'i 'du shes su dad pa'i sems grub na skad cig mar bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu'i gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi 'khor ba'i sdig phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /ma rig pa'i sgrib pa yang gtan bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu 'tsho skyong zhing gzhes te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar mngon no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po rnams la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ yi dgasalgemathu chen thams cad dang / /dud 'gro glang po ma rungs dang / /bud med g.yem dang ma rungs klu / /dpag tu med pa'i ma rungs rnams/ /ba su dang ni ma skyes dgra/ /lha sbyin dang ni sor mo'i phreng / /lus dang sems kyis sdig spyad pas/ /dmyal ba mnar med ltung 'os kyang / /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba la/ /dad pa 67—675

bskyedanyede phyag 'tshal phyir/ /thub pa mya ngan 'da' ba'i khar/ /bskal pa grangs med phyir bshol lo/ /ma ga dhā ②yi skye bo dag /kun kyang byang chub sems bskyed pa'angs / /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba la/ /gus par phyag bya'i dbang gis so/ / kau di n+ya la sogasasnyedang / /nyan thos lnga brgya rnam dag gis / /ma 'ongs dus su 'tshang rgya ba'ang / /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba la / /gus par phyag bya'i dbang gis so/ /mu stegs dang ni bram ze dang / /sngags 'chang chen po drang srong bcu/ /da ltar dgra bcom grub pa yang /'das pa'i phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba rnams la phyag bya'i yon/ /dam pa'i don la chud pa dang / /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing rnams la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad/ /tshe dpag med par skyes pa yang /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba la/ /gus par phyag bya'i dbang gis so/ /rgyal bu dge mthong 'di lta ste/ /sngon nga rgyal por byed pa'i tshe/ /drang srong chen po sbyin zhes bya/ /de tsheraskusangs rgyas ma byung ste/ /bram ze lnga brgya rnams zhigashel//kha zas dang ni gos rnams dang / /khang khyim dang ni mal cha'i bar lo grangs nyi shu tshang bar du/ /⑧rab tu byung ba'i mchod pa phul/ /ngas 0ni de tshe bsgo ba tunye la/ /khyed rnams byang chub sems bskyed cigatunye /bram ze lnga brgya de dag gis/ /mchod pa phul ba blangs kyis kyang / /dkon mchog gsum le ma dad pas/ /mod bzhin nga7la slar smras pa/ /'jig rten nang na byang chub dang / /rnam par grol ba med do zhes/ /de skad smras par ngas thos nas/ /mnyam nyid mdo sde bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bram ze lnga brgya'i srog bcad do/ /bram ze de dag tshe 'phos nas/ /dmyal ba mnar med lhung bar 'gyur8/ /sems 67—676

can dmyal bar lhung nas su/ /dran pa rnam gsum g.yos nas kyang / /cadus gsum rgyal la phyag byas so/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo sde dang / /byang chub dge 'dun dad bskyed de/ /dran pa rnam gsum byas pas na(nye/ /mod la dmyal nas byung ste dongalomi/ /'jig rten zil mngar ngone ru skyes/ /tshe ni bskalam④pa chung bcu thub45)/ /de yang gus pa'i sems kyis su/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal la phyag bya'i yon/ /bram ze de dag thams cad kyis/ /thog mar 6skur pas dmyal ltung yang ske/ /phyis ni dad pas mod la thar/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams ni//khrel dang ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /sdig gi rang bzhin thog ma nas/ /med pas sems can rnams kyi phyir/ /rtsa ba bzhi po'i77)sdom pa dang / /mtshams med lnga po'i sdig rnams dang / /log spyod bar du mthol bshagasam so/ /so so'i skye bo la la zhig /de lta bu yi sdig byas pa/ /de bzhin mthol tshangs byed nus na/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang mtshams med lnga/ /log spyod bar du sdig 'byang ste/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'ang gdon mi za/ /ma dad pa ni der ma gtogs/ /gang zhig dad pa'i sems skyes7)te/ /rgyal ba rnams la phyag byas na/ /chos lam mi 'grub mi srid do/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang / /sum stong po yi mi rnams kyis/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshig 'thun par/ /'di skad gsol te bdag cag rnams/ /sangs rgyas grub nas kyi )skye shi las/ /'khor ba'i rnam dag bsgral bar smon/ /lha mi'i57nang na btsun bzhugs pas/ /bye brag phyed par bshad du gsol/ /de la gzungs su bzung ba dang / /yi ger bris shing klog 'chang ba/ /de yi bsod nams ji tsam mchis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bye brag phyedasngo par ngas bshad kyis1nye/ /rgyal bu dge mthong legs 67wa 677

par nyon/ /gang zhig rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /stong khams gang ba'i sems can la/ /sbyin pa byas shing yon phul nas/ /de yi steng du chos bshad cing / /dgra bcom 'bras bu thob byas pas/ /la la zhig gis rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /thos nas dad pa'i sems bskyed de/ / skad cig dus su phyag byas na①/ /de yi bsod nams de bas 'da'acha/ /yi ger bris shing klog 'chang btso/ /dad pas phyag 'tshal smos ci dgos/ /de yi bsod nams dpag tu med/ /gang gis yi ger bri ba3)dang / /klog pa dang ni 'don pa dang / /dus su phyag 'tshal sems bskyed na/ /mchod rten stong khams chub pa na⑤/ /brtsigs pa'i bsod nams pas ni che/ /de nas 'od srung7chen po dang / /shā ri'i bu dang kun dga' bo/ /'jig rten bsrung ba mthu bo che/ /tshangs lha rnams dang lha dbang po/ /'khor los sgyur0byedang rgyal chen bzhis/ /bcom ldan zhabs la mgos btud nas/ /tshig 'thun par ni 'di skad gsol/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das slad na/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bsems can la/ khyab par spel zhing bstan par bgyi/ /lus sems rtag tu bde ba'i phyir/ /phyag 'tshal rnams la bsrung bar bgyi/ /gang zhig sdom pa zhig pa dang / /mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa dang / /mnyam pa nyid la skur pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas de dag mtshan thos pas/ /rnam dag sa ru bde bar gnas/ /dper na rgyal bu dge mthong bzhin/ /da dung ma 'ongs phyi dus la/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin mthong bar 'gyurathote/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas tshogs chen po rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed rnams legs par nyon cig /khyed rnams la sngon byung ba'i las kyi rgyu rkyen bshad par bya'o/ /nga sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i sngon rol na de 67—678

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mdzes pa'i 'od ces bya ba las gyephyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos nas shin tushedaga' ba'i sems skyes te/ thal mo sbyar cing spyi bos blangs so/ /blangs nas kyang sems can gang nas gang du gnas pa de dang der dpag tu med pa mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la rgya cher spel zhing bstan te sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos par byas so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na tshogs rnams kyi nang du mi sum stong nyi tshe zhig nga'i chos kyi don dang 'thun te dad pa'i sems dpag tu med pa skyes nas nga'i thad du sangs rgyas de rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag byas pas / da7ltar phyogs bcur snang zhing mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu dag rtsa ba bzhi dang / mtshams med pa'i sdig lci ba dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur pa dang / log spyod kyi bar du sdig 'byang bar 'dod na dad pa'i sems kyi dbang du 'gro bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu yang 'di lta ste/ gang la las ma dad cing ma gus pas mdo sde bcu gnyis la skurarnyucing dbang bzas0pa dang /rdo rje'i sku dang / skyes bu dam pa 'jam dpal dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la skur cing dbang bza'aphub rnams gdon mi za bar sems can dmyal bar ltung ste/ brdzun7pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ma dad pa'i phyir ro/ /dam pa'i chos la skur pa'i phyir ro/ /bla ma rnams la brnyas pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la smad pa'i phyir te/ nges par dmyal bar ltung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan de dag la dad cing sems thag pa nas phyag 'tshal na mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur pa'i sdig lta zhig⑧mi 'byang mi srid de ma dad pa dang / ma gus 67—679

pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyun chad pa dang / log spyod rnams ni der ma gtogs so/ /rigs kyi bu dag shākya hu)thub pa'i sku 'bum phrag brgyar sprul pa yang 'jig rten re re na ston pa mdzad cing bzhugs te tha ma'i sku ni nga yin no/ /de'i tshe nga dang 'grogs pa'i mi sum stong po kun da ②ltar sangs rgyas su grub ste/stong dang po'i gtso bo ni sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'od ces bya/ stong bar ma'i gtso bo ni sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sku zhes bya/ stong tha ma'i gtso bo ni sangs rgyas byams pa zhes bya'o/ /de bas na khyed rnams kyang de bzhin du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba'i rigs so/ /khyedasarnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na tshogs mang po rnams la ston pa rgya cher byed cing mtha' med pa'i sems can rnams la phan gdags te/ khams gsum nas bzlas shing zhi ba dang dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor gyis la nga dang 'dra bar byos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 'dzin stan las langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 0te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de stilogs su thal mo sbyar cing phyag 'tshal nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ ji ltar bsgom zhingasnyispyad par bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ni sdom pa lci ba rnams la phan gdags pa'o zhes bya bar zung shig⑨ /rdo rje rin po che'i snying po zhes bya bar zung shigatso /sde snod kyi sgo dpag tu med pa'o zhes bya bar zung shig⑩ /thams cad kun tu bsdus pa'o zhes bya bar zung shigatso /rgyan7chen po dpe zla 67—680

med pa'o0zhes bya bar zung shig② /mi sum stong sangs rgyas su grub par rnam par bkod pa zhes bya bar zung shigal /'gyod tshangs kyis4bsdig sbyangs dekyibasod nams thob pa'o⑧zhes bya bar zung shig⑦ /thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa zhes bya bar zung shig⑧ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 'dzin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa ltar na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa rnams la sman pa dang / bde ba chen po mdzad pa'i slad du sdig sbyangs pa dang / sangs rgyas su 'grub par mdzad pa'i mdoshe'adi ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni yum mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ni lam mo//nyan thos rnams kyi ni mig go/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi ni khang khyim lags te/ de lta bu'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don dang ldan pa bdag gis gzungs su gzung ⑩bar bgyi'o/ /lha dang mi gang nas gang du gnas pa de dang der rgya cher spel bar bgyi'o / /rgyun mi 7'chad cing yun du gnas par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /khyod ni skyes bu dam pa yin te/sde snod chen po dpag tu med pa thams cad gzungs su 'dzin pa lags ྅nyete/khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na nga 'gro ba'i gnas su khyod 'gro shigatuge /nga 'dug pa'i gnas su khyod 'dug shigs /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa zhig phyir mi ldog pa dang mi 'gyur ba'i sar gnas so/ /nyan thos brgyad khri7zhig theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed do/ /dge slong stong phrag bcu zhig dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /lha dang mi brgyad khri bzhi stong zhig chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob 67—681

bo / /sems can stong phrag brgya zhig ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7mdo sde 'di bshad zin nas/ shing sā la ga la ba de logs su gshegs so/ /gshegs nas gser gyi me tog rin po che'i lardzing bu dang bcas pa yang dumi snang bar gyur te/de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyang bsdus nas/ mi mjedasnyikyi 'jig rten gyi khams mthotho dman dngakyi/ gtsang sme'uyang sngon spubazhin no/ /mi rnams nyes byasalgepa'i phyir dmyal ba yang sngon bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad cesarwar+ghabaka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang / lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs tehurte/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyi hunyesdig sbyang ba steX ske/ sangs rgyas yongs su grub pa bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs somi// //rgya nag gi 'gyur sh+lau kya the'ubadun brgya rtsa bcu gnyis te bam po gnyis dang blo ka hurtebargya bcu gnyis/67—682

༄ga /'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang 'gyod tshangs kyi le'u nyi tshe/hu1༄༅gi /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las②/ phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang / mtshan nas brjod pa'i yon tan gyi gleng gzhi dang /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan dang / mdo sde bcu gnyis dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang ske/ bshags pa'i le'u rnams 'byung ba nyi tshe bcos shing bsgyur ba/ de nas phyogs bcu nas lhags ①pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ④lhan cig tu thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa⑤/ bdag cag rnams phyogs bcu'ikyisangs rgyas de dag gi mthu dang byin gyi rlabasam༅kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mchis te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong la/ theg pa chen po'i chos thos nas bdag cag dang / lha dang mis mdo sde gsung rab 'di len cingashe'adzin 67—703

pa dang / 'chang bar gsol te/ gnang bar 'tshal na bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad na yul khams 'di dang / phyogs gzhan du ri dang / tshal dang / shing drung gi rig sngags 'chang ba'i gnas dang /grong dang / grong khyer dang gnas dang / khyim dang / dgon pa'i gnas dang /dur khrod dang / shing drung dang / bla gab med pa dang / mchod rten dang /gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / mi mang po 'du btuchos bshad pa'i gnas dang / mi phal gyi gnas dang / mir gyur pa thams cad la rgya cher khyab par bstan te rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na / dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas na ngan 'gro rnams kyangashegatan du bkag pa'i slad du'o/ /dekhuji lta zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pas sems can dmyal ba'i sgo bkum0zhes thos te/ chos kyi gzhung 'di las tshig 'bru gcig tsam kha ton du bton na lha rnams kyang dga' zhing mgu ste/ rtag tu bsnyen zhing mchis nas rang yang dge ba ⑤spyod parachu)bgyid lags so/ /mi la la dag kyang rtogs ⑦pa chen pos yongs su rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhung 'di thos ninas ⑨dga' zhing mgu la mos shing gus te yi ger 'dri kyil 'don cing klog pa dang / 'dzin cing 'chang la phyag 'tshal te chos kyi gzhung 'di las bstan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'ga'i mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa' hu)'ga'i ming nas brjod na yang mi des da ltar gyi〈nyetshe 'di la bde zhing skyid7pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba mi 'byung la/ nam 'gum pa'i tshe na yang bdag cag byang chub sems dpa' rnamasacadang / lha rnams kyis de'i sngon7du shul 'dren cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag mthong la/ dad nas gnas gcig7tu skye bar 67—704

'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos kyi gzhung 'di len cinganyeyongs su bzung ba'i slad du'o/ /mdo sde 'di len cing yongs su 'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su 'dzin pa lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yongs su 'dzin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' lags te/ de bas na bdag cag dang slob pashegacig ste/ rgyu de'i slad du chos kyi gzhung 'di yongs su bzung bas gnas gcig tu skye zhing gcig gis gcig mi spong zhing mi 'bral bas smon lam gcig pa lags so / /de nas yang lha marnyusrin rnams kyi rgyal po dang tshangs pa chen po'i rgyal7po dang sum cusartsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / 'jig rten skyong ba phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / phyag brnyan lag na rdo rje dag dang / sde dpon chen po la sogs pa dang klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang bsnyenashedaga' bo dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po dang / bu dgu ma'i lha dang / ri'i lha dang / shing gi lha dang / 'bab chu'i lha dang / mtsho'i lha dang / sa'i lha dang (kye/ me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyal po dang de dag la sogs pa tshad med grangs med pa dag dang /lha chen po rnams dang 'khod pa las langs te/ gdong dang spyi bos phyag 'tshalashenas thal mo sbyar te rjes po/nye dang gus par bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la gsol57pa / bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas slan chad rtag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rtogs pa chen pos yongs su rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhung 'di yongs su bzung〈nyeste/ mdo sde 'di gang na steganas par bdag cag lha'i rgyal po rnams rtag tu de'i mdun du mchis te/ gtsang zhing dag par bgyis la/mchod rten gyi nang ngam/ mi phal gyi gnas sam/ dben pa'i phyogs gangacan 67—705

gnas sam/ yang na mdo sde 'dishegatsang sbra ma phyed pa'i yan lag gis 'dzin kyangasarung / bdag cag gis mi de la mi rigs pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs par bgyi'ol/ /desnyemachis pa'i gnas khyim gyi rim gro yang bgyi'o/ /bdag cag lha'i rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad kyis de phan tshun mchi na yang de'i mdun du 'drenasrecing shul sel ba dang / ci 'tshal ba bsgrub ⑤par bgyi'o/ /de phyogs bzhi dag tu mchis na yang sgrib cing chags pa ma mchis la/ rtag tu dge ba'i chos mthong zhing tshe rjes na lha'i nang du skye ba dang / de'i bsod nams kyis sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang mjal zhing theg pa chen po las mi nyams par bgyi'oni/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dgashedang ske/ lha ma srin rnams kyi rgyal po la sogs pa de〈nyedag la bka' stsal pa/de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ khyod kyis smras pa de bzhin te/ chos kyi gzhung 'di lta bu 'di thos par yang dka' na rtogs par lta smos〈nyekyang ci dgos/chos kyi gzhung 'di len cingacha'adzin la 'don cing klog par byed na/ gtsang spra dang khrus kyis dag cing dad par byasakhel/ gos gtsang ma bgos te gnas gtsang mar byas la/ dar gyi bla re 8dang ba dan la sogs pas gnas kyi nang bzang por byas te brgyan la/ spos mchog tu dri zhim pa tsan dan dang / phye ma dag gis7)byug pa dang / spos rnamatshwanyepa mang po bsregs nas phyag 'tshal te/nyin zhag gcig la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du de lta bur/ nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du chos kyi gzhung 'di klog cing 'don te sems dang yid mi g.yeng ba dang / dran pa mi g.yel zhing gcig tu brtanasngortepa dang / bsam pa drang bsnye dang ske/ dran pa nye bar gzhagatshu 1cing 'gro ba dang len cing 'dzin pa ma 'khrul pa 67—706

dang / spyod lam brtan ①pa dang / 'don cing zlos pa phyin ci ma log pa de lta bu'i tshul du mdo sde 'di las bstan ②pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang /mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing klagasaphul/ mos shing gus pas de ltar phyag 'tshal zhing 'chang ba ni mdo sde 'di las bshad pa bzhin du sdig lci ba thams cad yang dag par bsalasnyibar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rtogs pa chen pos sa)yongs su rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhung 'di ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang spyad cing sbyangs la / byin gyis brlabs nas yongs su bzung ba ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni yum mo/ /mdo sde rnams kyi ni rgyal po'o/ /mchog gi gzhung gi ni mdzod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni lam mo/ /rtogs pa chen pos yongs su rgyas pa 'di mchog tu zab pa'i chos kyi gzhung gi snying po'o/ /gcig tu dper na 'jig rten na chen po bzhi la sogs pa rnam pa drug dang mtshungs shing bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ drug gang zhe na/ sa chen po dang / chu chen po dang / me chen po dang / rlung chen po ste chen po bzhi dang / nyi ma dang stong pa ste drug go/ /de la mdo sde 'diwoni dper na sa chen po dang 'dra bar gtsang smekhudang / bzang ngan che chung thams cad theg pa yin no/ /yang mdo sde 'di ni dper na chu chen po dang 'dra bar mi gtsang ba'i ljan ljin dang / dri ma thams cadasnyedag par 'khru ba yin no/ /yang mdo sde 'di ni dper na me chen po dang 'dra bar las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma mi gtsang ba'i sbar sbur thams cad sregayo)pa yin no/ /yang mdo sde 'di ni dper na rlung chen po dang 'dra bar las dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma mi gtsang ba'i phyag dar thams cad 'thor zhing 'bud pa yin no/ /67—707

yang mdo sde 'di ni dper na nyi ma dang 'dra bar ①ma rig pa'i mun nag thams cad kun tu snang bar byed pa yin no/ /yang mdo sde 'di ni dper na nam mkha' stong pa dang 'dra bar dngos po ma lus pa thams cad go 'byed cing shong bar byed dol/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rtogs pa chen pos yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo sdesa'adi rgya che ba ni zla med pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' man chad nyan thos dang ske/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang / gzugs med pa la thug pa thams cad shong bar byed do/ /de bas na khyed kyis mdo sde 'di longakhul yongs su bzung ba dang ske/ rgya cher spel zhing khyab par gyis shig /mdo sde 'di la mos shing gus par gyis7te/ khyed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis rtag par sangs rgyas kyi ye shes khong du chud la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid mthong bar gyis shig /khyed lha'i rgyal po dag mdo sde 'di len cing yongs su 'dzin pa rnams kyis rtag tu nga dang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mngon parakherdzogs par byang chub ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor bsremathong bar gyis shig /de nas 'khor mang po 'dus pa'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i mtshan zhes bya ba stan ⑧las langs te/ gos legs par bgos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas skye bo mang po la sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du gsol zhing zhu na gnang ba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i mtshan la bka' stsal pa/ mos pa'i mtshan khyod kyis skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhu ba zhus pa legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis ci dang 67—708

ci zhus pa nyon cig dang ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /khyod kyis zhus pa yang dpag tu med pa'i skye bo la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i mtshan gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dran pa sngon 'das pa'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das0)rin chen gtsug tor can zhes bgyi ②ba de'i mtshan lan cig⑧thos pa tsam gyis kyang lhar skye ba thob bo/ /slad kyis yun mi ring ba zhig na/ rgyal po lha'i dbang phyug 'od ces bgyi ba'i yul khams dgon pa'i nang zhig la lu ma chen po zhig mchis pa'i chab skams ④te de'i nang na chab nya stong phrag bcu zhig gdugs kyisa'ugadungs nas 'gum du nye ba zhig mchis pa la/ tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs zhes bgyi ba zhig gis chab nya de dag mthong ba dang / snying rje ba'i sems skyes te/ chab dang zas kyi sbyin pa stsal nas dgung mang po mi thub cing 'tsho ba yun mi ring bar 'tshal te/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs kyis bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug tor7can gyi mtshan lan gsum brjod pas nya de rnams kyis thos pas tshe 'phos ma thag tu sum cu rtsa gsum gnam gyi lhar skyes so/ /de lta bas na bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di dag dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams la sman pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan bstan cing bsgragasalgepar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan kyang thos na dpag tu ma mchis shing ske/ brjod du ma mchis pa'i skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / bde ba thob cing rtag tu longs spyod phun sumashetshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / dpag tu ma mchis pa'i bsod nams kyi gter rnyed cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid kyang mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba'i slad du gsol pa dang / tshul khrims 67—709

kyi rtsa ba nyams shing nyon mongs pasatu'akhrul pa'i sems can rnams yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba'i slad du bstan par gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i mtshan la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gal te ngasasnyephyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan rdzogs par bstan na bskal pa khri phrag brgya stong gi bar du bstan kyang rdzogs pa'i mtha' med do/ /chu thams cad kyi thigs pa'i grangs ni bgrang zhing shes par rung gi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan ni bgrongashezhing shes par mi nus so/ /ri rab lhun po rnams kyang srang la gzhal zhing bgrangasrebar rung gi/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi mtshan ni brjod cing phyeshes par mi nus so/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi rdul thams cad ni bgrang zhing shes par rung gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi mtshan ni brjod cing7shes par mi nus so/ /nam mkha'i khams dngashematha' ni shes par rung gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi mtshan ni brjod cing shes par mi nus so/ /de lta bas na ngas khyod la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan mdo tsam zhig bstan te/ desnyigang zag la la'i rna bar lan cig tsam khyathos na mi de tshe 'phos ma thag tu lha'i gnas su skye'o / /thos nas mos pa dang / gus pa byas la yi ger bris sam/ mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal na/ 'khor ba dpag tu med pa'i sdig lci ba 'byang ste / bsod nams tshad med pa thob pas gang zag de dus zad na'ang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du yid la smon pa bzhin du skye ste/ nga yang mthong la masa'ongs pa'i bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyed la 67—710

sogs pa rnams chos thos par 'dod na/ tshul bzhin du gos legs par bgos pa/ lus bsrang ste sems mi g.yeng zhing / dran pa mi g.yel bar shin tu yid la byos te/ sems rtse gcig tu bsdus la phyag tshol cig① /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mar me'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal ba la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /②de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad bsdus shing 'dzin pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo / /dpag cing gzhal ba las 'das pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla dang dpe med pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos mu med pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam dpag dka' ba la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs kyisastobs la gnas pa'i stobs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum na btsun pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad kyi lam ston pa chen po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba thams cad gcod par mkhas pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo//pha rol gyi mthar phyin pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten rnams las thar cing grol ba la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi 'pho ba'i lam dang yongs su bral ba la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par grol ba mngon du brnyes pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' ltar ci la yang mi gnas pa 67—711

la0gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang po'i nang na chos kyi rgyal po chen po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu gcig pa'i pha ltar byams pa chen po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo tshe rabs gar ⑧byang gar skyes kyang sangs rgyas thams cad mthong zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin mngon par rtogs la ②mya ngan las 'das pa chen po nyid du phyin par smon to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lus can thams cad gang la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod pa'i phyir ro/ /⑤'khor mang po rnams sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te/ sems rtse gcig tu gus par mchod cing / legs par nyon la yid la zung shiganye /ngasamatho)phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan brjod pas/ mtshams med lnga po'i sdig las kyang / /rnam par grol bar sems bskyed7cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba med pa yi/ /mi de'i phyir yang ngas bshad de7/ /de yis rtogs par ma 3) nus kyang / /sa bon tshig par rang 'byung ngo ske/ /yang dag bden pa 'ba' zhig yod/ /theg pa chung ngu'i mtshan bsalanyen / /theg pa chen po de nyid yod/ /theg pa rnam gnyis bsalarwanyebs na/ /theg pa gcig pu kho na yod/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba med pa'i mis/ /tshig 'di thos par mi 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas grangs med sngon mchod pas/ /da ltar bcom ldan mtshan thos so/ /len cing 'dzin pa'i gang zag ni/ /phyogs tsam las ni rnam grol te/ rnam dag sa la'ang bde bar gnas/ / da ltar nga yi chos7'di la / /len 'dzin klog cing 'don pa dang / /bcom ldan mtshan la phyag byas shing ske/ /sangs rgyas mdzad la bsgrubs pa yis/ /bdud tshogs las dang bral bar 'gyur/ /phas pham bzhi dang mtshams med lnga/ /'dod 8chen po yang 67—712

byang gyur nas/ /ma 'ongs dus na mi de dag /byang chub 'tshang rgya gdon mi za//gang zhig mos par mi byed na/ /ngan song gsum du nges par ltung / /phyag 'tshal brtson zhing mos bskyed na/ /sangs rgyas grangs med mthong 'gyur bas / /rtse gcig sems kyis7phyag 'tshal rigs/ /sdig pa thams cad byang 'gyur te/ /de bas gus shing mos par gyisal/ /de nas 'khor mang po rnams thal mo sbyar te/ lus dang sems nan tan du bsdus shing bzungakhunas mi g.yo zhing mi 'gyur bar lus kyi yan lag lnga sa la gtugasaphunas sems rtse gcig gis shin tu legs par nyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤mtshan nas brjod de bka' stsal pa/ snga ma 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa rnams la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla mar me snang stong phrag nyi shu la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad stong phrag sum cu la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu rtogs chen ye shes rgyal ba la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bu bcu drug la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dbyangs kyi rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin dbang mar me'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od grangs med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa'i sku thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan nyi zla ltar 67—713

dang zhing snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo rnam dag yongs su mkhyen pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsang mas brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'ikhusprin gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra sprin dbyangs sngon gyi rgyal po ye shes pad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shing sā snola'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mchog rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang rnam dag57rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za ba'i 'od 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od༄rgyang ring la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zlasa'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge ri'i ri'urgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab lha'i dbu rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang mdzad ri rab lhun mnyam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /⑦de bzhin gshegs pa chags pa7med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo ba'i sa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(9)de bzhin gshegs pa bai drur+ya pad ma'itshwa )mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser mdog la phyag 67—714

'tshal lo/ ljade bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi50snying po la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam grol pad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang brgyanasal phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgya mtsho mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma50bral la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa skyo yid spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug mchog la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal gyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab yon tan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla'i 'od zil gyis gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla be+e drur+ya'isnyi'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla7bo drur+ya'i9)'od bla na med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchog dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'odasasnang zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /she)de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i mdog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu zla'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa the tsom rmugs pa sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 67—715

sdug bsngal spyod 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa dge ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hu)de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byin gyis rlobashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ka la ping ku'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten na bzhugs pa dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zla med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mi gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpag med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhal med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla 'od las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan bzangasasregaser mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ring du snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi bro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—716

gshegs pa klu'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'itustobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dam pa'isnyiri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla med dam pa gepad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i gzi brjid rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzangs nyamadog tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan bsungane'od la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa yid bzhin rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog brtsegs rab dga'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus bla ma chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yid bzhin rgyal mtshan mar me'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab sgron ma snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'od snang7la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sra brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od kun tu 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i brtson 'grus che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—717

de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje'i stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i snying po rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan dpung rgyan7rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzang po'i gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i blo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser ri rin chen gdugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi pad mo'i 'od ②'bar mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang sgron chenasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mkhas snang mnga' byamadzad stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi pad mo'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' rin chen pad ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa be+e drur+ya〈nyebakod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku mdog kun tu ston pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa bdud kyi rgyal po rnams btul ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa shes rab rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa 'od gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten rnam dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa rab zhi zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin 67—718

gshegs pa mchog btsanatuye shes rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen bla resamar me'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i gdung bla ma'i ye shes gtso bo'i ⑧rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla'ikhu'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab ba dan bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi 'od 'phro snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi 'od snang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra dbyangs dbang phyug sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i gsung mchog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od rtag rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal thabs brnyesasnyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab rgyal thabs brnyes pa'i na bza' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi mtshan nyid kyis dgongs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sum ban da'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ud pa la'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson pas rgyal ba stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab dga' 'khrugs med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung dbyangs tshad med rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 67—719

mkhas pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi rgya mtsho'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab ri dbang rgya mtsho thogs med rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen thogs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad thogs med rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad rtag tu rgyas pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rmongs mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa'i sku thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa grangs med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba rnams bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag khrag khrig bye ba ②gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de rnams la phyag 'tshal na/ bskal pa grangs med pa nas 'khor ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro / /dugal te gang zag la las snga ma 'das pa dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mtshan thos na/ mi de bskal 67—720

pa khri phragatubargyad kyi7bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung ngo / /de bas nasagus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams la/ /gang zhig gus par phyag 'tshal na/ /sdig 'byang sems kyi rang bzhin thobadu/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga / /phyin chad 'di dag mi spyod deX/ /yang dag chos thos rgyun mi 'chad/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul khrims rdzogs/ /de phyir da ltar gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang zag gnyis ni ma gtogs te/ /gcig ni phyogs snyoms chos la skural/ /gnyis po de ni 'dod chen po/ /gal te la la sems dag na/ /de ni 'dod chen ma yin te/ /sangs rgyas grangs med rtag tu mthong / /la las rtsa ba bzhi nyams shing / /mtshams med lnga por bcas pa dag /mos pa rnam dag bya nus na/ /des kyang chos bzhin gnas par7rung / /kun gyis gus par phyag byas pas/ /mi dge bcu yi las rnams bsa'akho / /kun gyis theg chen khrims thob ste/ /de phyir da ltar gus phyag 'tshal/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi mtshan bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcus mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa so sor thob bo/ /nyan thos brgyad brgyas kyang theg pa chen po'i sems cung zad skyedarwanyedo/ /dge slong lnga stong gis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /lha dang mi 'bum ni chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag go/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'isngonasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po snang 'bum phrag bcu rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med gser phye mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'khor lo 'od snang rgyal po la phyag 67—721

'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge mthong ku'i mtshanaturgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga rokhul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od yon tan ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge gnas yon tan rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen pad mas brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bar dka' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab gnon pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga rokhurgyal bar dka' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pasrebakod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i bla re la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub la phyag 67—722

'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi snying po nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrul stobs chos chen mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsan dan lo ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yid dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi lnga la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'di las lhag med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod mipa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od snang gsal bsod nams kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgrasasabadud bzhi bcom pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bai drur+ya'i bya'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang rnam dag rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyis (me rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jug pa'i stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par gzigs 67—723

pa'i bsam gtan dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams bla na med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ljade bzhin gshegs pa rdzu 'phrul mnga' mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi mtshan ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan ma'i spros pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra'i mtshan ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i mtshan ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ro'i mtshan ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa reg bya'i⑧mtshan ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jug pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mtshan nyid mnga' mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sdud pasal phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ldan kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungasnyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rol pa'i sgra brnyan snyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu dga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrugs med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo /67—724

de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang phyug sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtso bo'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad sgrol7ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zangs mdog tsan dan dri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang phyug sprin gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'jigs pa spangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da7ltar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal na⑧bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i dus na 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe sdig lci ba byas pa yang bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khrag khrig gang gā'i bye ma snyedasnyedang mnyam pa dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—725

gal te gang zag la las da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa'i mtshan thos na gang zag de bskal pa khri phrag ①drug cu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung ngo / /de bas na da gusakhupar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis da ltar phyogs bcu yi/ /bcom ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal na/ /mi dge'i lam las rnam grol zhing / /mtshams med lnga la sogs pa 'byang ge/ /rnam dag sa la rtag gnas shing / /shākya'i chos la bde bar gnas/ /ngan song gsum ni yongs su spangs/ /sangs rgyas byams pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas stong yang mthong gyurasrete/ /de phyir da ltar gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun mthong ste/ /rtag tu rnam dag zhing du skye/ /dam pa'i chos kyang thos pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag par rtogasal / /phyogs bcu na da7ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi mtshan bstan pa'i tshe/ gang gā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi byang chub sems dpas57gzungs kyi sgor 'jug pa thob bo/ /lha dang mi 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kun tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ming dang mtshan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam gling gser 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos snang ba la phyag 'tshal 67—726

lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab ri'i rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med mnga' dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po ches brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag brgya mnga' mdzad pa'i rgyal thabs brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong na dga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtshan khri phrag gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khri phrag gsum mtshan mthun kun tu yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi khri brgyad stong 'od mi 'gyur btul phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdog dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang dam pa'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bgegs7kyi tshogs thams cad bcom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong phrag bcu'i 'od snang bas brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag brgyad cus brgyan 67—727

pa'i 'od snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen pad mas brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gtso bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi mdog 'od snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lung bstan pa lnga brgya pad ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu bo che mi 'jigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma bzang pos brgyan pa la phyag 'tshatsha lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i7ting nge 'dzin mnga' dbang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da dung ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgya la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'chi 'pho'i sdig lci ba kun bsalashebar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag la la zhig gis da dung ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa'i mtshan 'di thos na mi de bskal pa khri phrag ④bzhi bcu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung ngo / /de bas na dasnyigus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi sangs rgyas la/ /la las gus 67—728

par phyag 'tshal na/ /sgrib pa gsum dang mtshams med lnga / /'dod mngasatudag ni ma gtogs par/ /kun kyang bsal cing 'byang〈bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos la'angasnyebade bar gnas/ /sangs rgyas tshad med kun kyang mthong / /yang dag chos kyang rtag tu thos/ /de bas da ltar gus phyag 'tshal/ /la las phyogs bcu7dus gsum gyi/ /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal na/ /'das pa'i kha na ma tho bsal/ /ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi/ /mi dge bcu yi las byas pa'angasnyi/ /da ltar sngon du bsal cing 'byang / /ma 'ongs pa na chos nyid mthong / /de bas yang dag mos par bya/ /'drikyiklog kha ton phyag 'tshal na/ /de dag tshe rabs gar skyes kyang / /mi dge log pa mthong mi⑧'gyur/ /rtag tu yang dag rnam grol 'thobakhya/ /mtha' khob7yul du yong mi skye/ /rgyal po ngan pa yong mi mthong / /bskal pa 'bum phrag bzhi khrir yang / /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mi mthong5)ngo / /de bas da ltar gus phyag 'tshal/ /mi dge bcu yi〈nyelas byas bsal8/ /gzungs su 'dzin pa chen po 'thob/ /da dung ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag girwanyematshan de bsgrags pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag lnga bcus phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas so/ /dge slong ma bdun brgyas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu rnyed do/ /lha dang mi 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag go/ /mdo sde gzungs su 'dzin pa chen po gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la mdo'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo//lung du bstan pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo / /dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ched du brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gleng gzhi'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde 67—729

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ltar dang 'das pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes pa rabs kyi sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo chos rmad du byung ba'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtan la phab par bstananyepa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdzod chen po bzhugs so 'tshal la phyag 'tshal lo pa rol tu phyin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gang la lasalgemado sde bcu gnyis kyi mtshan dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams thos nas klog pa dang / 'chang ba dang /kha ton tu 'don cing phyag 'tshal ba dang / dad cing mos pa dang / len cing 'dzin par byed na/ mi de bskal pa khri phrag nyi shu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung la/ tshe snga ma dran pa'i shes pa dang ldan par 'gyur rol/ /de lta bas na dasngonagus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo ste bcu gnyis kyi mtshan de bsgrags pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri lnga stong gis rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /nyan thos 'bum phrag brgyad cus theg pa chen po'i sems cung zad skyes so/ /dge slong pha dang dge slong ma stong phrag bcus dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /tshad med pa'i lha dang mis chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag go/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtson la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyun mi gtong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—730
