byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khams gsum 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lam ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bshad par mosatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' klu'i sdong po la phyag 'tshal lo// // bam po gnyis pa②/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen tsan dan pad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bla ma'i⑧spyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' mu med spyodakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdzad pa rnam par dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi smodakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' rtag par mi smod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /④byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi rgyal po ye shesasnyopad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga'aphrol phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbyangs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang 67—731

chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus yon tan stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bshad par mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad7pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang ba'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul pad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od rlabs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' le'ushes rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang po zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab smon lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog rlabs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbu mar gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa bkag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sde snod la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' mnyam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi mnyam gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam mi mnyam gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin dbang phyug rgyal posal phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbang phyug 67—732

rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi7mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyis brgyan paphul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkon⑧mchog brtsegs pakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phyag la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phyag rgya'i phyag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag par phyag bteg⑧la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag par phyag phab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtse ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i sgron ma 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mthong la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' bden pa'i dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud bcom la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' klogakhugi yon tan la 67—733

phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi mtshan gyis brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri btang bzung bskyod pa'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang poshedakar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa skyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i rgyanaphul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phyag dkar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dmigs pa med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhing gi bkod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od rgyan gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkarasnyergyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen tsan dan pad mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos gtsang dang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos7kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems 67—734

dpa' spyanatumi 'dzumasalgepa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug gi yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yongs su dge ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i phyag la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' dge bar spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen pa rnam par dag0pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu bo che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yid dge ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bsrungakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' glog gi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yid dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zadamanyapa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab zab mo la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ma zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thogs7med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i spyan⑧la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /⑨byang chub sems dpa' yon tan snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—735

byang chub sems dpa' rin chen phyag rgya'i phyag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug na nor bu'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bden mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mar me'i rgyal7po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zab mo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdog dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par 'dri la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' legs paraphulan ldon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid mngon du chud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges pa'i mtshan nyidaphul phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' nges pa'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༷byang chub sems dpa' brtsegs par nges lakhuphyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga'abaskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud skrag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo//byang chub sems dpa' skyabs grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab mar me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bar sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab smon lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhis sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ston pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' chos dga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems 67—736

dpa' chos lam khyad par can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub phyogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzugs dam pa la7phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan tshal la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdog dam pa'i dbyibs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sna tshogs brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shākya'i⑧rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug nas byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsungashebartsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtso bo'i bla ④la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzugs kyi sku kun tu bstan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul phyedakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sku mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sman pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dri med snying po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems 67—737

dpa' thams cad gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtho btsun dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' be+e drur+ya'i7'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra dbyangasashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa chen 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtogs pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /④byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rten7pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rten pa'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun nas skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun nas sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin gyi 5ge'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(6)byang chub sems dpa' kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od 67—738

'phro rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' lam ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo brtanatul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shag gis7phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bla med chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyigashel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'irnyu'od la phyag 'tshal lo/byang chub sems dpa' shes rab ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi gzungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i zomasnyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal thabs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri7rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal mtshan ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' char pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'brug gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mchog la 67—739

phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mgotul phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen ting nge 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen phyag rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bkod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen chu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen brtan⑧la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mdzadakhul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen chos mos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsang ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug gi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo dbyibasasnyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gtsug tor la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /⑤byang chub sems dpa' 'od stong dmigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngos gzar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam dag 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /67—740

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan gyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i zla btul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' dang ba'i shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i⑧rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod yul dmigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams snangakhul phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mngon du rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab tu sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzugs kyi stobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kha lo sgyurakyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 67—741

gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'akhukhri phragashebargya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag nyis brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag sumachubargya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag bzhi brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag lnga brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag drug brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag bdun brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag brgyad brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag dgu brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag stong gi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba yang bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'bum phrag gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag khri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag 'bum la phyag 'tshal lo/⑥ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba yang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub 67—742

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khrag khrig phrag gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag brgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag khri la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig phrag 'bum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la phyag 'tshal na/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdigaturtsi ba yang bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā gcig gi byesam snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'aphugang gā gnyis kyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā gsum gyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā bzhi'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā lnga'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā drug gi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā bdun gyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā brgyad kyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā dgu'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā bcu'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā brgya'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā stong gi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā khri'i bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā 'bum phrag brjod kyis mi lang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal na bskal pa dpag tu med 67—743

pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig lci ba yang dag par bsal bar 'gyur ro/ /gang zag la las 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyi mtshan thos na/ mi de bskal pa 'bum phrag bzhi bcu'i bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal du mi ltung zhing / khams gsum gyi 'khor ba la mishegatogs te/rtag tu rnam par thar pa'i rgyal po'i khams su gtogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' 'khob yul du yongasakhumi skye/ /dge med yul du'ang de bzhin te/ /lus ngan len par mi 'gyur zhing / /log par lta ①bar mi skye'odu/ /ma rabs rigs su mi skye ste④/ /mu stegs can du'ang mi skye zhing / /lus kyi yan lag kun dang ldan / /dam pa'i chos ni rtag tu thos/ /dka' thub sdom pa ma blangs kyang / /'di dag rtaganyetu ldan 'gyur te/ /theg pa chen po'i spyod lam mdzes/ /rtag par sangs rgyas bdag nyid mthong / /de phyir gus par phyag 'tshal te/ /bcom ldan chos la bde bar gnas/ /ma 'ongs dus na sangs rgyas 'grub/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyi mtshan bsgrags pa na rigs kyi bu phoshedang / rigs kyi bu mo 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis lan cig7phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyurasheto/ /lha dang mi 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa dgus phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /sems stor ba'i dge slong 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa brgyad kyis ⑩sems kyi bdag nyid slar rnyed tu)de dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen posnye'abum phrag bcus gzungs chen po rnyed nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang chub kyi snying por mngon par rdzogs paratso'atshang rgya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge ④sgras 'di skad ces gsol 67—744

to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ltar na theg pa yang gcig tu bas te gnyis dang gsum du ma mchis so/ /rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i 'gyod tshangs kyi mdo 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi yum/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ni la ma chen po'o①/ /rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi ni mig /lta ba log pa thams cad kyi ni sdud pa/ sems nyams pa rnams kyi ni skyong ba②/ ngan 'gro gsum gyishesgo ni gcod pa/ bla na med pa byang chub pa'i sgo ni 'byed pa/ nyan thos rnams ni rim gyis theg pa chen po la gzhol bar 'gyur ba lags te/ dkyibadag gis kyang gzungs sngags chen po 'di gzung zhing bskyab par bgyi'o/ /gang zag la las tshul khrims kyi sdom pa dang / mdo sde 'di la sgom zhing klog par byed na de la yang de bzhin du bsrung zhing bskyab par bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig mdo sde 'di la mchod cing rim gror byed pa dang / zhag bdun gyi bar du spyod cing sgom par byed pa la/ bdud sdig to can dkrug pa'i skabs tshol ba zhigashemachis na yang / bdud des kyang 'khrug pa'i skabs mi rnyed par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mdo sde 'di yun du gnas pa dang / byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid mthar thug pa'i bar du yang bskyang bar7bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mdo sde 'di srung7ba ni dkon mchog gsum srung ba yin no/ /yang nga'i bstan pa yang srungatshwanab yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgras bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gzungs sngags smras pa/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsang :sngo)ya/ a dan te/ dha ra rtetunye/ tad ya thā/ ā kā 8sha ni/ swa bhā 8ba/ sarba 67—745

dharmā ṇi0swa byukhub/ i sham da/ pi ba sha na/ bi ma la su pa ri/ dharma a ti kun/ gshel ni sh+tsa/ ya tha ma le/ tsā le tsā le/ hu lu hu lu/ bi sha de/bi sha deche/ man tra man traḥXswā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di0dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing mchod rten laphulan bdun bdun⑧bskor ba dang /de bzhin du zhag bdun gyi bar du mdo sde gzhan la mi bsam par rtogs pa chen pos ⑨yongs su rgyas pa'i 'gyod tshangs kyi mdo sde 'di la ⑩sems rtse gcig tu bya'i gzhan du mi g.yeng bar bya'o/ /gzungs sngags 'di sangs rgyas 'bum phrag brgyad brgyas gsungs te/ bdag gis kyang bshad do/ /gal te la las gzungs sngags〈nya'adi la skur cing smad pakhebagyid na sangs rgyas de snyed7la skur cing smad 8pa lags so/ /gzungs sngags 'di la skur ba'i gang zag ni tshe rabs su yang bsgrubasalgepa'i 'bras bu mi 'grub par 'gyur te/ khams gsum las kyang mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na8/ gzungs sngags 'di ni sems stor ba las slar rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / gzungs sngags 'di lan cig tsam thos pa'am/ thos nas yi ger 'dri nyezhing sha dang / chang bcad de/ za gcig par bgyid cing / khrims bsrung7ba dang / bag ma mchis pa'i rtsed mo g.yeng 33 ba mi bgyid pa dang / 'du 'dzi'i nang du mi 'jug pa dang / rtag tu byams pa la sgoms tezhing / bsam gtan la dam sapar lta ba'i gang zag de ni bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas sogs sogs ( nyepa'i sgrib pa gsum dang /sdig lci ba la sogs pa yang gzungs sngags 'di thos te/ sems thag pa nas zlos shing 'dzin pa dang / nyin gcig bzhin dus 3klog cing kha ton bgyid pa dang ske/ yi dam du mi brjed par bgyid na gang zag de mngon par byang chub pa'i 67—746

bar du ngan song du mi lhung ngo / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i sgra la bka' stsal pa/ khyod dkon mchog gsum skyong btudang ske/ skye bo mang po la yangakhuphan par sems shing / srid pa gsum las bsgral zhing gdon pa dang / slob pa grangs med pa la phan pa chen po byed pa dang ske/ log par lta ba thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gzungs sngags phye zhing bstan pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyodasakyi ming dang / gzungs sngags kyi sgra 'di sems can la las thos nas mos pa dang gus pa bskyed7de ma skur pa'i mi de ni tshe 'di la yang bde bsnyenas shi 'phos nas kyang / rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong zhing nga yang mthong la/ khyod dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de thams cad kyis7de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po so so rang gis rig pa mngon par 'tshang rgya ba the tsom mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs shing / dge ba thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i lam grubashepa ni kun kyang mos pa dang / dang ba'i dbang gis sol/ /nga 'das pa'i phyi na rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang 31la la zhig gis nyin gcig gam/ mtshan gcig gam/ dus gcig gam/ skad cig la phyogs bcu na dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / gsung rab mdo sde bcu gnyis dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal nus shing theg pa chen po tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa ji bzhin par yid la byed pa'i gang zag de ni thang cig hu)yud tsam cig 8gis mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las thams cad kun ma lus par byangasabar 'gyur ro/ /67—747

yang dge slong pa'am/ dge slong ma'am/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ dge tshul pha'am/ dge tshul mas ngo bo nyid kyishesems stor bas rang gi rtsa ba bzhi gzhig⑧pa dang / sdom pa brgyad nyams pa dang / lci ba drug dang / mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga byas pa dang / mnyam pa nyid la skur ba yang phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams7kyi mtshan la mos pa bskyed de phyag 'chal na de lta bu'i las mi dge ba kun ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal ma thag tu de nas sangs rgyas 'od nges pa zhes bya ba de'i drung nas 0de'i tshe rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong po rnams blo bur du skad cig gcig gis dus der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ phyag 'tshal nas mgrin gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas mi dge ba'i ⑦las bgyis shing bsags pa ni brjod kyis kyang mi rdzogs te/ la las ni mi dge ba bcu bgyis/la las ni mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis/ la las ni mnyam pa nyid kyi chos la skur pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab cingasnyibarjod kyis mi rdzogs pa'inyesdig pa bgyis pa de dag dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi mdo sde la brten nas/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i mdun du mthol zhing bshags par 'tshal na de gnang bar gsol lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jigs pa'i sems bskyed dka' ba dang ske/ dge ba'i sems bskyedarwanyedaka' ba las bskyed pa ni legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis mi dge ba bcu bshags pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga bshags pa dang /67—748

'dod chen la sogs pa bshags nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de mthong bar 'dod pa de legs kyis7yid la sems pa bzhin mthol cig /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang mi sum stong gis bcom ldan 'das kyi7byams pa'i gsung thos nas chos gos tshul bzhin du bgos nas thal mo sbyar te spyi bos btud nas phrag pa g.yas pa chos bzhin du phyung / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag lasasogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /phyogs bcu'i chos la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrugs mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ldan la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang steng gi 0phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa spos brtsegs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /yang 'og gi phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum gzugs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /shar phyogs na 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /lho phyogs na 'phags pa 'jig rten gzungs la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /nub phyogs na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /byang phyogs na 'phags pa zla rgyas la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 67—749

gsol lo/ /steng gi phyogs na 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'og gi phyogs na 'phags pa yon tan brtan7pa la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /thog ma'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mi 'gyur ba la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo//ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /da ltar bdag cag gisaston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo//bcom ldan 'das dri ma med par grags pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la yangashephyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /kun dga' bo dang 'od srung la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /'phags pa'i lam bzhis mngon du byung ba rnams la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /sems bskyed pa dang po pa rnams la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /mdzod chen po gsung rabasremado sde bcu gnyis dang / yang dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo sde la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /chos kyi mdo sde gzhan ji snyed bzhugs pa la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /sku gdung brgyad du bgos pa'i gzugs rnams la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi don la yang phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gnam gyi lha dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / bar snang gi lha dang /gnam gyi steng dang / sa'i steng dang / sa'i 'og gi lhasadang / ri'i lha dang /67—750

tshal gyi lha dang / shing drung gi lha dang / rig⑩sngags 'chang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i mig dang ldan pa dang / lha'i rna ba dang ldan pa de dag thams cad kyis gzigs shing gson te kun gyis dbang mdzad par gsol lo/ /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad la ma mthol ma bshags pa zhig mchis na yang sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur ②cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i khams tshun chad nas/ da ltar gyi lus ngan pa 'di thob pa'i bar du rmongs shing bslad pa'i sems kyis log par mthong ba dpag tu ma mchis pas las dang nyon mongs pa dang ske/ mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa ni brjod kyis mi rdzogs te sdig pa mang po ci bgyis pa rnams bdag nyid kyis ma tshor ma rig pas mi dge ba'i sems rab tu rgyas pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten pha rol ma mthong zhing / tshe 'di 'ba' zhig mthong ba la gnas te/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags la mos pas dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ring du gyur cing mi dge ba'i las kyis bar chad du gyur cing bsgribs pa'am/sdig pa'i grogs7po la brten pas dge slong pha dang / dge slong ma la mi rigs shing tshul ma lags pa'i las bgyis pa'am/ pha dang ma la mi rigs shing tshul ma lags pa'i las bgyis pa'am/ yang rang nyam gyi byadabang gis phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi nor dang / yo byad la sogs pa spyodamasapa dang dge 'dun sde lnga la yang mi rigs shing tshul ma lags pa'i las bgyis pa'am/ 'jig rten gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu dpag tu med pa snyed (thubashad pa dang / byang chub kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sems can la 'ang ngan du smad ⑦pa dang / chos kyi mkhan po la skur ba'am/ dam pa'i chos ni〈)chos ma lags par bshad pa'am/67—751

chos ma lags pa ni dam pa'i ①chos lags par bshad pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni7mi rtag cesaltebagyis pa'am/ dam pa'i chos kyang mi rtag gokyizhes bgyis pa'am/ dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang mi rtag go zhes bgyis pa'am/phan pa'i sbyin pa la ma dad pa'am/ chos log pa la dad cing 'dzin pa de lta bu'i slad du/ da 'jigs shing skrag pa ni dpag tu ma mchis 'dzem7zhing gnong badzobasam gyis mi khyab ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs rje dang byams pa'i sems mnga' bas༄kun la snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags na/ bdag cag la sogs7pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas srid pa na 'khor ba'i tshe/ sdig lci ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad 'gyod cing bshags pas tshangs〈kye pa gnang bar gsol te/ slan chad kyangalomi bgyid par gyur cig /yang bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis pa'amatunye/'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sdom pa dang / tshul khrims nyams pa'am/ 'dod chen pa'isnyilas spyad pa'am/ mi dge ba'i tshig rtsub po smras nas dge ba'i chos la skur ba'i sdig lci ba'i las bgyis pa yang slar 'gyod cing bshags ma myong ba dang / yid la 'dzem 8pa dang / ngo tsha ba ma mchis pas mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams ma mchis hunyepa lnga'i dngos po sdig lci ba la sogs pa bgyis pa'am/ thog ma nas yid la 'jigs5nyeshing 'dzem pa ma mchis pas de lta bu'i sdig lci ba bgyis par7bdag nyid kyis nges par 'tshal kyang / nongs pa bcabs shing dad pas byin pa 67—752

blangs pa mthol shingatubashags ma myong ba'am/ dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bgyi zhing / rim grorasamachod pa'i bsam pa ma mchis te/ de la mi snyan par smadakhucing yang log par bltas pa'am/ ngag gi sgo nas kun nas nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mang po bgyis pa'am/ yang 'di skad ces kyang smras te/sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun gsum ma mchis zhes bgyisalgepa la sogs pa mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig lci ba de lta bu bgyis pa'i slad du/ da 'jigs shing skrag pa ni dpag tu ma mchis/ 'dzem zhing gnong ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs rje dang byams pa mnga' bsarnyukun la snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags pas na/ bdag cagashel sogs pas 'gyod cing mthol bshags pas tshangs pa gnang bar gsol te/ bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas srid pa na 'khor ba'i tshe sdig lci ba bgyis pa rnams bsal cing slan7chad kyang mi bgyid par gyur cig /yang bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas log par mthong bas lci ba bzhi ni sbom por bshad/ sbom po ni lci ba bzhir bshad pa'am/ zhig pa ni ma zhig par bshad/ ma zhig pa ni zhig par bshad pa'am/ lci ba ni yang bar bshad/yang ba ni lci bar bshad pa'am/ gtsang〈nyeb ni mi gtsang bar mthong mi gtsang ba ni gtsang bar mthong ba la sogs pa log par mthong ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag ni bshad cing bstod(rte/ sangs rgyas kyisabastan pa la ni gus par ma bgyis shing mi dge ba'i don rnams la gzhung bzung zhing bsams pa (ste67—753

dang ske/ ma brtags ①pa rnam pa ②brgyad 'chang ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa ni bdud kyi tshig ces bgyis/ bdud kyi tshig yang dag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' zhes bgyis pa'am/ bar 'ga' ni mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gis rnam par bshad pa la mos shing bzung ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par bzhugs te/ dkon mchog gsum la rtag pa ma mchis snyam sems la 'khrul pa byung ba la sogs pa lta ba log pa dubasam gyis mi khyab ste/ de lta bas na da 'jigs shing dogs pa dang 'dzem zhing gnong ba yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni kun la snyoms pa'i yab yum lags / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags te/bdag cag la sogs pas 'gyod cing 'thol ④bshags pas tshangs par duganang bar gsol te slan chad kyang mi bgyid par gyur cig⑦ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa las gal te rtsa ba bzhi'am/ mtshams med pa lnga'am/ yang dag pa'i chos la skur pa btab pa ma mthol ma bshags na nges par sems can dmyal bar lhung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / ⑧byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / nyan thos rnams dang / rang rgyal bshernams kyis kyang de la skyabs mdzad par mi spyod do/ /dge 'dun dang / pha ma dang / lha rnams dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi mis kyang de las 7skyabs byed mi nus so zhes thos pas nanyede'i phyir 'jigs shing dogs0)pa dang / 'dzem zhing gnong ba yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang dang / ma gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas stong dang / da ltar gyi 67—754

sangs rgyasatusprul pa'i bcom ldan 'dasakhushākya thub pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams ⑧cad ni thugs rje dang / byams pa'i mnga' bdag lags teX/ kun la snyoms pa'i yab yum lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags na bdag cag la sogs pas 'gyod cing mthol bshags pas tshangs pa gnang bar gsol te/ bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'am/ las kyi sgrib pa'am/ rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa'am/ lci ba bzhi dang / mtshams med pa4)lnga dang / mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa'i sdig lci ba rnams bsal bar gyur cig /yang bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas srid pa na 'khor ba'i tshe sdig lci ba rnams bsal nas ⑦slan chad kyangs mi bgyid par gyur cig /yang bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la sogs pas bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas da ltar gyi tshe 'di'i bar du dge 'dun gyi spyi'i 6)nor dang /phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi spyigatsonor la thugs thub tu spyad hu7pa'am/ da ltar gyi dge 'dun gyi nor la thugs thub tu spyad pa'am/ dge 'dun sde lnga'i nor dang /dge slong ngo cog gi nor la thugs thub tu spyad7pa'am/ yon bdag5)thams cad kyi rdzas la thugs thub tu spyad pa dang / bdag gis yang dag pa'i chos dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'bras bu bzhi ma thob par thob bo zhes smras pa de lta bu'i las ngan pa'i rgyu des kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyur gyur te/ khyim nas rab tu byung nas rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom pa zhig pa dang / lci ba'i chos brgyad dang /sdom pa drug dang / dge 'dun gyi lhag ma bcu gsum dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang / spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu dang / lhung byed 8dgu bcu rtsa gcig 67—755

dang / so sor bshags pa'i chosatubazhi dang / bslab pa'i chos mang po rnams dang / shin tu lci ba'i chos bdun rnams dang / nongs pa bgyis nas phas pham pa bzhi dang / mtshams med pa lnga la thug gi bar du re re nas bgyis pa'am/yang dag pa'i chos nyid dang / mdo sde zab mo la skur pa'4/ 'dod chen pa'i⑧las bgyis pa yang bcabs shing gsangasalgenas nyin zhag re re zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ba de dag dul sogs pa de during skye bo mang po la sman pa'i slad du/bdag cagashenyid kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'gyod cing bshags par 'tshal lo/ /so so'i〈skye bo thams cad kyis bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas / sangs rgyas dang / pha ma'i drin glo bar ma chud cing rnam par byang ba'i chos ma 'tshal bas mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs bgyis pa'am/ bdag gi rigs snyems pas dar cing rgyags pa'i tsho7mi dge ba'i las rnams bsams pa bzhin du bgyis kyang / nongs par〈nyem mthong bas byis pa lta suPROBPROBPROBPROB pa'i sug las bgyis pa'am/ mi dge ba'i gshesalgeganyen gyi drung du nye bar mchis shing nyon mongs pas sems dkrugs pasatunye/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la chog ma 'tshal te/ mi dge ba'i las rnams bgyis pa dang / 'gro ba bzang mos bslus pa'am / 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi mdud pas sems dkrugs shing bskyod pa dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid la sogs pas rnam par bsdus pa'i sdigatsomang po de rnams 'gyod de da ma lus par bshags so/ /yang sangs rgyas dang / dam pa'i chos dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la gus pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen bkur〈nyem bgyis pa de lta bu'i sdig mang po de dag kun 'gyod de mthol zhing so sor bshags so/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 67—756

rnams7dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams la gus pa'i tshul gyisasnyerim gro ⑧ma bgyis pa de lta bu'i sdig mang po de dag kun 'gyod de mthol ④zhing so sor bshags so/ /gti mug pas rmongs shing bsgribs te dregs shing le lo dang rang nyam gyis mi dge ba rnams bgyis pa de lta bu'i sdig mang po kun 'gyod de mthol zhing so sor bshags so/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dkyibadag gis ma:da nas sems can ma lus pa thams cad sa bcu la gnas par bgyis te/kun gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i yang dag pa nyid thugs su chud pa dang ldan parasnyebagyis par gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal bu dge mthong la bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rgyal rigs dra ma chen po rab tu legs so/ /rgyal rigs dra ma chen po bdag nyid kyis ⑨dge sdig gi las la rtog pa mkhas te/ 'jigs shing skrag pa chen pos 'gyod nas sdig pa'i las rnams mngon par bshags kyi steng du/ sems can thams cad kyi phyir yang mthol zhing so sor bshags pa de bas na khyod ni rgyal rigs dra ma chen po nyid yin te/bdag sdig pa mi dge ba dang bral gyi steng du/ sems can thams cad kyang sdig pa dang bral bar byas pa dang / bdag nyid kyi phyir smon lam ma btab pas sngar sems can thams cad kyi don du smon lam btab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa nyid 0thugs su chud pa dang ldan par bsngos pas na khyod ni rgyal rigs dra ma chen po yang dag pa nyid5)yin no/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang / mi sum stong gis mthol zhing7bshags zin nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa/ bcom ldan nyag gcig rab kyi mchog /khams gsum rgyan lags yab yum dang / /thams cad snyoms pa'i ye shes lags/ /67—757

kun la snyoms pa'i dpe ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas dkon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byis pas shes rab bdag phyir spyad/ /nor rdzas byin la lan 'dod phyir/ /byams chen sangs rgyas de min te/ /dgra sdang nye byams snyoms mdzad pa'i/ /brtson 'grus che la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rkang gnyis kun la sangs rgyas gtso/ /shes rab spyan ldan mkhyen gzigs khyab/ /lha rnams shes rab de ma 'tshal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /bdagatucag kun gyis gus phyag 'tshal//de bzhin sangs rgyas bdag skyabs mchi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod byas 'dra / /de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rgyal bu dge mthong dang / mi sum stong la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas chos ni tshogs〈'dod na/ /thos pa mang po'i mi phyir 'brangs②/ /dge bas mkhan po bzhin du bkur/ /sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshul khrims rnam dag srung byed na/ /ming ni dge slong des pa yin/ /stong nyid gang gis brtags ⑤nus na/ /de ming rnal 'byor sgrub pa yin/ /brtson 'grus la las bsgrub7nus na/ /de ming 'phags lam spyod pa yin/ /la las mya ngan 'das bsgrubs na/ /de ming yang dag bde ba yin/ /tshul khrims sdom pa'i dge tshul dang / /rnam dag khrims 'dzin dge slong dag /zla ba phyed cing gso sbyong bya/ /chos gos brtags pa rnams gebagos te/ lhung bzed 'khar gsilasasogs bkur zhing / / dag pas57bsod snyoms gtsang blang bya/ /lha rnams thams cad dga'algemagu ste/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal thal sbyar nas/ /lha rnams nged kyis mi 'di dag / de yi〈nyemangag gzhug bsgrub par bya/ /dper na lha dbang brgya byin la/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha gzhan rnams/ /rim gro〈nyegus pa 67—758

byed bzhin bya/ /tshe 'dir legs pa nyid 'thob stedzo/ /tshe rabs gzhan gyi'ang dpag mi khyab/ /rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims sdom/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin lan bsgrubs yin/ /rgyal bu dge mthong da7yang nyon/ /nga dang byang chub ma gtogasalgepar/ /'jig rten mi rnams thams cad kyis/ /mos pa rnam dag sems bskyed de/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs par/ /mya ngan 'das par mngon par shes/ /chos dang dge 'dun de bzhin te/ /de lta bu yikyimi rnams ni/ /bcom ldan drin la ⑥lan bsgrubs yin/ /de⑩yang rgyal bu dge mthong nyon/ /'jig rten mi rnams thams cad la/ /bye brag dbye ba'i sems med par/ /theg pa gcig chos mngon shes te/ /phyogs bcur sngalgem 'das pa dang / /da ltar ma 'ongs dus rnams la/ /sangs rgyas theg chen gcig pu las//gnyis dang gsum zhes bya med par/ /bye brag dbye ba'i sems med de/ /de ltar mos sems bskyed⑥nus na/ /de lta bu yi mi rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin 'tshob 7pa yin/ /rgyal bu dge mthong da yang nyon/ /da ni 'das te gshegs phyi na/ / mi yi7)nang na la la zhig /sems can rnam pa thams cad la'ang / /sangs rgyas snying po nyid yod ces/ /rtag tu mos pa'i sems bskyed na/ /de lta bu yi7)mi rnams ni/ /bcom ldan bka' drin lan bsgrubs7yin/ /la las thang cig7dge spyad de/ /'bras bu srid pa mi bsgrubalgel / /bla med 'bras bur sngo hunyebyed na/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin 'tshob pa yin/ /da yang rgyal bu dge mthong nyon/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og na/ /mi yi nang na la la dag /dkon mchog gsum la rim gro gus/ /skad cig mdo sde 'di bklags〈nyete/ /mkhan la sri༄)zhu yon phul na/ /de lta bu yi mi rnams ni/ /67—759

bde gshegs drin latulan bsgrubs yin/ /la las nor rdzas sna 'ga' dang / /gos dang kha zas bdog rnams kyis/ /kun la khyab par sbyin byas na/ /bcom ldan bka' drin 'tshob pa yin/ /rgyal bu dge mthong da yang nyon/ /nga yi chos 'di tha ma'i tshe/ /la las mi 'ga' gros btab cing / /thang cig⑧mdo sde 'di nyan na/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bum brgya la/ /yon phul bas ni 'di don che/ /theg mchog mdo sde 'di lta bu/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yum yin pas//sangs rgyas byang chub dad bsams shingasnye/ /'di la rim gro gus bskyed la/ /gnyis med phan tshun sems snyoms na/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin lan bsgrubs yin/ /rgyal bu dge mthong da yang nyon/ /la las chos 'di tha ma'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin bsgrubs bsams te⑤/ /thang cigakyisangs rgyas thunakhuzhugs na/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /srog byin pas ni 'di don che/ /dge 'dun bsam gtan dkrugs skur nin/ /khams gsum gang ba'i mi rnams dang / /sems can thams cad bsad dang mtshungs/ /bsam gtan dge 'dun dkrugs skur na/ / de yinyesdig kyang de bzhin no/ /la las dge ba spyod mthong nas/ /dpyas ⑩shing skur te ma mos na/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs kyang gcod/ /bcom ldan bka' drin bsgrubasnyepa min/ /de nas rgyal bu dge mthong dang / mi sum stong la bcom ldan 'das kyisalgeganang ste/ chos bstan zin nas dga' mgu yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs spyi bos blangs so/ /'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho gtsodang / 'gyod tshangs kyi le'u nyi tshe rdzogs sotsho// //67—760

༄ga /'phags pa me tog gi tshogs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ku su ma sañca ya nā ②ma ma hā ān sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa me tog gi tshogs zhes7bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyisaphung po'i ri la dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po brgya phrag phyed gedang bcu gsum gyi dge slong dang thabs cig ⑦tu bzhugs te/de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ④ri'i bu stan las langs nas bla gos phyogs gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha dung sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /yang bcom ldan 'das da hu )ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs la7)'tsho zhing gzhes te chos kyang ston pa ji snyed cig bzhugs/ de skad 67wa 770

ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu de'i phyir legs par shin tu nyon la yid la zung shigatudang bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs su bye ba brgya phrag stong gi yang7tha ma na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mar me can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ shā ri'i bu yang de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyi mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba dang / dad pa yang skyedasapar byed pa de dag thams cad yang dag pa'i⑧byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che bdun rnams yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa drug cur 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams mar me can gyi mi'i nyi ma sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas de'i mtshan thos par dga' ba ni bskal pa drug cur 'khor bar mi 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de la sogs pa shar phyogs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi mtshan rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhesakhul chos kyang ston to/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya'i yang tha ma na⑧'jig rten gyi khams rin po che dang ldan pa zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen dam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa 67—771

rin chen dam pa'i mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba dang dad pa yang skyed cing thal mo sbyor bar byed pa ni yang shā ri'i bu gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ①rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu gang bar byas te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la nyin gcig bzhin du7sbyin pa phul ba de bzhin du bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po des bsod nams kyi phung po 'di'i⑧brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /grangs su'am / cha'am/ dper ram/ rgyur yang nyekhubar mi 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che dang ldan pa na sangs rgyas rin chen dam pa gtso bo bzhugs te/ de'i mtshan thos pas 'dir sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin no/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag drug cu na 'jig rten gyi khams spos ldan zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba'i mtshan gang dag gis thos pa de dag ni bskal pa bcwasalngar 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gi yang tha ma na 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba'i mtshan gang dag thos pa dang dad pa bskyed dupa de dag ni ngan song gsum du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong lnga brgya bas ches ring ba 'jig rten gyi khams tog gi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin 67—772

chen tog ces bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gi mtshan gang dag thos pa dang / dad pa bskyed cing de bzhin gshegs pa de la rjes su dran par byed pa de dag thams cad dkon mchog dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gnyis kyi ches pha rol na 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan thams cad rab tu snang ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rab snang zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rab snang gi mtshan gang dag thos pa dang / thos nas kyang lhag pa'i bsam pas mos par byed cing yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de dag ni bskal pa nyi shur 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong bas ches ring ba 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs7pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa de'i mtshan gang dag thos pa dang dad pa bskyed par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing bdud sdig can rnams kyis kyang mi 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ /②yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa7de'i mtshan dang yon tan brjod pa bshad pa na/ bdud sdig can gyis thos nas dpung gi tshogs thams cad dang bcas te nga'i drung du 'ongs nas tshig 'di skad du smras so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan yongs su brjod pa ni mi dngo'iX/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan ni de lta ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 67—773

bdag gi yul du 'gyur ba ma lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan/gang dag nyan paratu'agyur ba de la yang bdag gis bar chad bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdig can khyod kyis gang zag gang dag la bar chad bya ba de dag gang yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa chen po la zhugs pa gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan thos par 'gyur ba de dag lags te/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gang bcom ldan 'das de'i mtshan dang yon tan yongs su brjod pa bgatsotsha zhing yongs su gdungs so/ /'on kyang bdag gis mtshan nyan ④pa de rnams la bar chad bgyi ba'i slad du go bgo bar bgyi'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gang gang zag gang dag gis thos pa bdag gi dbang du mchi bar 'gyur ba de nakhumachis so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdig can khyod go bgo bar ma byed cig /khyod kyis ni skyes bu dam pa de dag la bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de dag ni ngas de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la gtad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan dag la yang gtad pas/ de dag7de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pas dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdud sdig can de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan snga na ⑦sngar mchis nas/'di skad du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan thos la bdud sdig can 'di'i dbang du mchi bar 'gyur ba gang dag la bar chad 67—774

bgyi ba'i slad du bdud sdig can gyis go bgos pa'i gang zag de dag gang lags/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa de dang de'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa sems can gang dag gis thos nas danyeltar spong bar byed pa rnams sems can dmyal bar 'gyur ba'i chos dam du 'dzin par 'gyur ba ngas mthong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su spong bar bgyid pa'i sems can du zhig mchis pa legs par bshad du gsol / bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu phyogs bcur7de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan thos par 'gyur ba dang / de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na ①de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis de dag las brtsams te chos ston na sems can de dag ni shes rab che zhing shes rab rgya che bas de'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs ④pa bshad kyang ngoms par mi 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu gang dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa5bde dag gis de'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa la spong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas ma yin skabs med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma'i dus su 'byung ba ni gnas ma yin no/ /'di lta ste dper na da ltar snyigs ma lnga'i dus su nga byung na mi mjedakyikyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams shes rab rab tu zhan pa de 'dra bdagashegis kyang ngas bshad pa'i yon tan khong du chud na/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pas ⑧shes par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ shā ri'i bu de lta med kyis7yon tan 'di yongs su brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni mthar gyis byang phyogs su 'gro 67—775

b.ratu'agyur te/ de na skyes bu dam pa gang dag theg pa chen po la zhugs pa de dag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ②rgyas par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de na shā ri'i bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan to/ /thos nas kyang spong bar 'gyur te skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa de dag ci'u'adra ba nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das lagasakyiso zhes phyigasol nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang phyogs na yul khams gan dha ⑦ra zhes bya ba ⑧de na lo 'bum du mnar med pa'i las yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba yod do/ /byang phyogs kyi rgyud de7nyid nas kha che yul gyi ljongs kyi phyogs gang na dam pa'i chos 'di ches ⑩shin tu stobs dang ldan par 'bar bar 'gyur ba de na spong bar byed pa khri phrag lnga 'byung ngo / /spangs nas kyang rigs kyi bu de dag gang du gnod par 'gyur ba'i mtshams med par 'gro bar r+shanya'agyur ro/ /gang du phal cher tshogs nas mdo 'di la mngon du smod par byed pa de dag thams cad mtshams med par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogs su mdo 'di la bye ba phrag brgyad dang lnga 'bum spong bar 'gyur te/ spangs nas mnar med par rab tu ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /shar phyogs na ni dad par 'gyur ba nyung〈nyezad cig yod de8/ mnar med pa'i las phal cher 'dzin par 'gyur zhingatshwanyede na brgya stong phrag mang po mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs su sems can nyis 'bum gyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong bar 'gyur te/ spangs tunyenas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /nub phyogs nas sems can 'bum rnams kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spangs nas mnar med par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /shā 67—776

ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos ni rang sangs rgyas7rnams kyis kyangasam yin na nyan thos rnams kyisalta ci smos/ so so'i skye bo 'khor ba 'phel bar byed pa lta yang ci smos/ shā ri'i bu 'di dang 'tsham pa ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid kyis durab tu mkhyen gyi bdag gis7mi shes so/ /mi shes parasheni spang bar7mi bya ste/ mdo sde'i7tshul 'di lta bu'i tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tsam la yang spang ba byas na de snga ma ji tsam du gyur pa de tunyebazhin du bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos spang bar mi bya'o/ /dga' bar bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di lta bu la gang bdag gis ma spangs pas bdag bskal par gnas pa'i las las grol bar gyur5)te/ dam pa'i chos spong bar byed pa sems can dmyal ba pa tunyede dag gi drung du ni bdag gnas par mi bya'o snyam du sems te/ gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi gsungachadabyangs rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu na 'jig rten gyi khams dpag 8med ldan zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu 'od chen po'i mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba dang / dad pa yang skyed pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur zhing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag drug na 'jig rten gyi khams me tog can zhes bya 67—777

ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbyangs dpag med ces bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i7bu de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs dpag med kyi mtshan gang dag nyan pa dang / thos nas kyang dad pa skyed cing de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes ched du brjod pa lan gsum brjod pa de dag 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs dpag tu med pa'i dbyangs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bzhin 'jig rten gyi khams rdul med ces bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdud rtsi dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi dbyangs kyi mtshan gang dag thos par gyur ②la thos nas kyang mos par byed pa de dag ni/ bskal pa bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag nyi shu'i pha rol na 'jig rten gyi khams gdul dka' zhes bya ba de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa chen po'i mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba dang yongs su sgrogs shing 'dzin pa ni bdud sdig can gyis rab tu gdul dka' bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu gnyis na 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa mtha' yas de'i mtshan gang dag nyan pa dang / thal mo sbyor zhing de 67—778

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig tu smra ba de dag ni bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa dang ldan ①par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che'i phung po ri rab dang mnyam ②pa lo brgyar sbyin pa byin pa'i bsod nams snyikyi phung po 'dis snga ma de'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag gsum na 'jig rten ④gyi khams man shel can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen snang zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snang 'di'i mtshan gang dag 'dzin pa de dag ni bskal pa bcur 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /yang gang dag dad par mi byed pa de dag ni bskal par mtshams med par gnas pa'i las yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcwakhelnga na 'jig rten gyi khams 'od gsal zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde ba chen po thob pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa bde ba chen po thob pa'i mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis sems can thams cad bde bar sgrol bar byed do / /bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa yang yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro//'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bdun na 'jig rten gyi khams nor bu snang ba zhes bya ba na ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skar ma mar me snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de 67—779

bzhin gshegs pa skar ma mar me snang ba de'i ①mtshan gang dag nyan pa dang /dad par gyur pa de dag gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i stobs de dag rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas7zhing stong phrag brgyad na 'jig rten gyi khams bde ③ldan zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bden pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i dbyangs de'i mtshan gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag nyi shu na 'jig rten gyi khams gser can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri med mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri med mtha' yas kyi mtshan nyan cing dad pa yang skyed par 'gyur ba de dag ni de bas ches dubasod nams 'di mang du 'phel lo/ /bsod nams chung ngus ni de bzhin gshegs pa dri med mtha' yasakyikyi mtshan thos par mi nus so/ /gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dri med mtha' yas kyi mtshan thos pa de dag ni sangs rgyas gcig la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa ma yin / gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga nas bcu'i bar du ma yin gyi sems can de dag gis ni sangs rgyas brgya la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin no/ /de dag ni bskal pa lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag dgu na 'jig rten gyi 67—780

khams dbyangs can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba ltar dkar ba'i mtshan gang dag ①han pa de dag thams cad kyi chos dkar po yang zla ba lta bur 'gyur zhing thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gi tha ma na 'jig rten gyi khams nyi ma can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par ⑤rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla 'od ces bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od kyi mtshan gang dag nyan cing thos nas kyang pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes ched du brjod pa lan gsum du brjod pa dang / yang gang dag gis ched du brjod par bya ba rjod7par byed na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag sum cu na 'jig rten gyi khams dri ma med pa can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi ④mtshan lha'am klu'am mi gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de dag log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang dogs par mi bya'o/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyis stong lnga brgya na 'jig rten gyi khams be+e drur+ya'i ⑤snang ba can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dag pa zhes bya ba 67—781

bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dag pa'i mtshan lha'am/klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am/ mi 'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po'am/mi'am / mi ma yin pa gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad mir 'gyur ba 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags dang zhe snang dngatugati mug kyang yongs su spyod par7byed do/ /shā ri'i bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dag pa de'i mtshan thos pa dad ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba lasade dgakhudad par mi byed cing yid ma ches pa las byung ba mi dge ba'i las kyis de lta bur ga la 'gyur zhes tshig tu'ang smras na/ lo stong phrag drug cur dmyal ba chen po 'o dod 'bod pa zhes bya bar btso bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya srid na 'jig rten gyi khams legs par thob pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi 'od ces bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyi 'od lasherjes su dran par byed na de dag thams cad kyi chos dkar po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur 'gyur ro/ /bdud kyi sde thams cad kyang rnam par 'jig par byed do/ /mu stegs gzhan yang pham par byed0do/ /bskal pa sum cur 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag drug cu bas ches ring ba 'jig rten gyi khams byang chub kyi yan lag rab tu brgyan pa zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mtha' yas kyi mtshan gang dag nyan pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub kyi yan lag 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can yang dkon mchog dam pa 67—782

la 'god par byed do/ /de dgasanyunyin mtshan du yang bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga brgya snyed na 'jig rten gyi khams pad mi⑧can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad mo'i bla ma zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i bla ma'i mtshan gang dag nyan pa dang /dad pa yang skyed ni 'jig rten na de dag thams cad pad mo dang 'dra bar 'gyur te / dge ba'i chos kyisamangon par 'ephags par 'gyur ro/ /pad mo chu'i nang nas skyes kyang chu mikhuchags pa bzhin du bskal pa lnga bcu rtsa lngar 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya phrag stong bas ches ring ba 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan dang gnod pa thams cad las 'das pa zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yan lag bla ma zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag bla ma'i mtshan ④gang dag nyan par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyis sred ⑤pa'i chu'i rgya mtsho chen po las 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan dang gnod pa thams cad las sgrol ba zhes bya bar sgrol bar byed do/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi sbyin gnas su yang 'gyur ro/ /gang dag thos nas dad pa skyed pa de dag thams cad me tog dang 'dra bar gyur ni te/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /mthu bo che'i lus ltar mkhregs par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang phyir ldog par mi 'gyur rol/ /yang bud med gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag bla ma'i mtshan nyan ⑦cing thos nas kyang dad pa skyed pa ni des bud med las bsgyur ⑧bar 67—783

'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos phan yon 'di dag 'dod pa dang sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams dgrol ①bar bya ba'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par byakun/ de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag gi bla ma'i mtshan mnyan par bya'o/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag nyi shu na 'jig rten gyi khams snying po can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od dam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od dam pa'i mtshan gang dag nyan cing thos nas kyang dad pa skyed pa de dag thams cad kyis 'od 'thob par 'gyur te②/ gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi 'od dang stobs rnams kyang rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams dang /sangs rgyas kyi phan yon rnams kyang rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la dad par bya ba dang / bsod nams rgya chen po yang bya'o/ /bsod nams chung dus ni 'di la re bar mi bya 0ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan ⑤pa 'di 'dra bas rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed nas byang chub par bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems skyed par byed pa ni mtshan 'di thos par mi dka'o/ /bskal pa bcu gnyis su 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcotubargyad na 'jig rten gyi khams mu tig gi dra ba yongs su dag pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i mtshan gang dag thos par 'gyur zhing thos nas kyang dad pa rab tu 'thob pa dang / thal mo sbyar ⑧67—784

bar byed pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur zhing de nas7'khor los sgyur〈ba'i rgyal po byed par 'gyur te/ thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag nyi shu na 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser ltar snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa gser ltar snang ba'i mtshan gang dag thos par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad tha na mi lam na yang chos kyi rang bzhin mig yor dang 'dra bar rgya cher ston par 'gyur ro/ /log par ltung bar yangs mi 'gyur te/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sems can tshad med pa rnams la yang bde ba dang yid bde bar byed par 'gyur/ 'jig rten 'dzin par byed/ theg pa chen pos kyang nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dusangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i tha ma na 'jig rten gyi khams me sgron zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser gyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi 'byung gnas kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sems can gang dag skye bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag gi sems can gang dag gis bdag gi ming thos par gyur pa rjode thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyiral/ de ltar bdag gis7sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 67—785

bya'o zhes de snyam du bsams so/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcwatubargyad na 'jig rten gyi khams sbrang rtsi ②can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya bsnyebazhugs te/yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po de'i mtshan gang dag thos par 'gyur ba ni klu rnams kyis gang gi tshe na/ grong ngam phyogs su lce 'babasrepa de'i tshe na/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te 'di skad du smra bar bya'o / /bden pa gang dang bden pa'i tshig gis de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na klur gyur pas/gang klu rnams kyi nyam nga ba las byung ba de dang de las thar par byas0/ klu mang po dang / klu mang po brgya dang / klu mang po stong dang / klu mang po brgya stong rnams nyam nga ba las thar bar byas pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas gnas pa'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang rung ste/ 'jig rten gyi ④khams gzhan dag tu yang klu gang dang ⑨gang dag gis lce 'bebs pa'am/gnod pa'i ser ba ⑩'bebs par 'gyur ba'am/ 'jigs pa'am/ nad dam/gnod pa'am/ nad 'go ba gtong ba der bdag gi ming brjod na gnod pa de dag thams cad med par gyur cig /bden pa'i tshig des bde bar gyur cig5)ces smon lam btab ste/ shā ri'i bu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des sems can de rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang bde ba la gzhag go/ /klu rnams lce gtong ba yang mtshan brjod pa tsam gyis med par 'gyur te/ klu'i skye gnas de las shi 'phos nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar 'gyur zhing bla na med pa yang dag 67—786

par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag yang mos pa dang mngon par dad par byed pa de dag kyang nyin mtshan du bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnyed dka' ba ma yin no/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya phrag stong gi pha rol na①/ 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba lta bu zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ②sangs rgyas me tog thams cad kyi dri'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa me tog thams cad kyi dri'i dbang phyug rgyal po de'i mtshan thos par 'gyur ba de dag ni 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'di lta ste/tshul khrims kyi spos kyi ngad ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs sam/ mya ngan las 'das kyang rung / de'i mtshan gang dag thos par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad de dag gi chos 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thobalgepa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gang 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam yin no/ /de bas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la lhag pa'i bsam pas dad par bya'o/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la dad par byed pa ni don chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sems dad pa gcig gis gang 'dod pa de thob par 'gyur te/ gang 'di 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dag btams pa 'dzin par mdzad pa rnams la gang dag sems dad palogacig gis thal mo sbyar te/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig tu smras nas byams pa la gnas par byed pa ni bla na med7pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir 67—787

mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas sems dad na chos 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rgyun mi chad7par brjod par bya'o/ /theg pa des 'gro bar 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa de'i yon tan rjes su dran par byas na⑧bskal pa bcu bzhir 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag nyis stong na 'jig rten gyi khams skar ma'i rgyal po dang ldan pa zhes bya ba na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sārnyula'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa 〉kyila'i rgyal po'i mtshan gang dag thos nas dad par mi byed cing 'phya ba dang / steng pa de dag ni lo stong phrag drug cur sems can dmyal ba chen po bsdus gzhom du btso bar 'gyur/ ma dad do zhes tshig tu smras pas lo stong phrag bdun du yi dgasalgeme mdag za ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga bcu rtsa lnga na 'jig rten gyi khams stobs ldan zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon chas nyon mongs pa sel ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon chas nyon mongs pa sel ba'i mtshan gang dag thos par 'gyur ba ni tha na gyermi lam gyi tshe na yang rdo rje lta bur 'gyur/ bdud dang bdud kyi 'khor gyis gdul dka' bar 'gyur/ g.yul chen po las kyang sgrol bar byed pa dang gang 'di thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang 'thob bo/ /yang shā ri'i bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan dran pa tsam gyis dad pa skyed pa dang / dga' bar byed pa'i rigs kyi bu'am 67—788

rigs kyi bu mo de dag byang chub kyi phyiratuspyad pa spyod pa na/ bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / mthar phyin par shes par bya'o/ /yang de dag gis byang chub kyi sems 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/ bdag cag gi⑧bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bya/ rgya cher sems yang dag par rab tu dga' bar bya'o/ /gang dag las bdag cag gis mtshan 'di rna lam du grag gcing thos pa dang / dga' ba yang dag par bskyed nas sems can mang po'i donatswabyed par 'gyur te/ de ltar rdzu 'phrul che'o/ /yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gang dag nyan cing thos nas kyang mos par byed pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po ci yod pa de'i phyogs tsam zhig bshad par bya'o/ /gang la la zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'idzanyaklung gi bye ma snyed rin po ches rab tu gang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i 0klung gi bye ma snyed la nyin re zhing sbyin pa phul ba de ltar gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang ⑦mnyam pa'i bskal par phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po des/ mtshan thos pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'di'i cha 'ga' tsam du yangaltebarjod par mi bya'o/ /gal te la la zhig gis mtshan 'di mnyan par bya'o snyam nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu gang bar byas te sbyin pa byin na/ de yang bsod nams ma byas pas de thos par mi nus so/ /de ci'i7phyir zhe na/ ji ste bsod nams ma byas par thos par 'gyur na ni sems can dmyal ba pa ⑩dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa rnams dang / lha tshe rings〈nyepo rnams kyis kyang thos pa dang / yon tan brjod pa 'di shes par 'gyur te/ de dag 67—789
